title: Residence Program Specialist
description:
Why Join ADAPT?

It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.


For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.


SUMMARY

Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
  • Ensures the safety, health, and well-being of the people we support at all times.
  • Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self-help, social, and community living skills.
  • Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
  • Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
  • Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
  • Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
  • Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
  • Follows all OPWDD-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
  • Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
  • Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
  • Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
  • Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
  • Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
  • Promotes dignity, respect, and person-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
  • Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
  • Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
  • Valid New York State Driver’s License, maintained in good standing
  • Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
  • Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


COMPENSATION: $20.17/hour (after probation) + Industry-Leading Benefits for all full-time employees.



At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging. We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.


ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

title: General Interest Application
description:
Join Our Talent Network

About Us

In 1929, Kahuku Medical Center opened its doors to care for local sugar plantation workers. Nearly a century later, we remain the same family-oriented medical center, dedicated to serving the North Shore. Working at KMC means joining an organization rooted in serving the underserved.

We are a not-for-profit 501(c)(3) Critical Access Hospital and Rural Health Clinic. As the only hospital on the North Shore, KMC is the emergency safety net during a health crisis and the area's leading provider of primary care.

Our long-standing mission statement reads: "Friends and Family Taking Care of Friends and Family". This reflects the many community members on staff who often find themselves providing medical care for those they know and love, and for the patients who describe KMC as a medical hale, a place closer to a loved one's home than a hospital.

We are committed to keeping quality healthcare close to home for the people of the North Shore. Our services aim to support our patients through every stage of life.

Why Join?
Don't see an opening that fits you right now? Share your information with us anyway. When a position opens that matches your background and interests, our HR team will reach out to you directly.

We hire across many areas, including:

  • Nursing and patient care

  • Administrative and business office
  • Dietary and support services

Who Should Apply?
Anyone interested in working at KMC, whether you're a licensed professional, a recent graduate, or someone looking to start a career in healthcare. If you live on the North Shore or are planning to, we'd especially love to hear from you.

Please Note
Submitting your information here is not an application for a specific job. To be considered for a current opening, please also apply directly to that posting. We'll keep your information on file and contact you if a good match comes up.

title: Senior Director, Pricing Escalations
description:
The Senior Director, Pricing Escalations will lead the development and execution of ABM’s centralized pricing escalation function, overseeing the strategy, communication, negotiation, and implementation of client price increases across the organization. This leader will build and scale a new team, redesign processes, leverage financial and operational data to drive pricing decisions, and partner closely with Operations to balance client relationships with business objectives while leading enterprise-wide change management.

Operating Model Transition & Redesign

  • Lead the redesign of the Pricing Escalation Management SOP to reflect centralized FP&A ownership, re-anchoring final approval authority and escalation decision rights that currently sit with Operations roles (Industry Group President, Branch Manager/RVP, COO) to the centralized team and FP&A leadership.
  • Define a clear operating model for how Operations stays involved going forward: participating in client delivery/negotiation where relationship history or local context adds value, and continuing to own day-to-day client relationship management — while cost analysis, pricing strategy, and final decisions sit with the centralized team.
  • Stand up the centralized team's intake, case-management, and approval workflows to replace the field-led decision process end-to-end, including for escalations currently in flight under the legacy model.
  • Determine, in partnership with the Head of FP&A and executive leadership, the revised approval matrix and thresholds (including resolving the open question of percentage-based vs. revenue-dollar-based triggers) now that approval sits centrally rather than in the field.

Centralized Execution

  • Own end-to-end execution of pricing escalations company-wide: pulling and analyzing ERP cost data, client notification, negotiation strategy, objection handling, and final documentation — directly, rather than solely supporting a field-led process.
  • Directly own client-facing negotiation strategy for escalations that meet defined thresholds, bringing in the local Account Manager or Operations leader for relationship context and, where warranted, direct participation in the client conversation — while the centralized team retains decision authority on terms.
  • Track every active escalation nationally against the required timeline (T-65 internal approval through T-60 client notification, T-45 conditional meeting, T-30 negotiation, T-15 documentation, T-0 go-live, and T+30 review), owning the schedule directly rather than monitoring it from the sidelines.
  • Manage the expedited process for unplanned cost events (regulatory changes, supply chain shocks, force majeure), securing executive approval and documenting any deviations from standard timeline.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Pull and analyze cost and pricing data directly from ERP systems, with support from the broader FP&A team, to identify and prioritize which accounts the centralized team should pursue for escalation — replacing the field-supplied cost inputs in the legacy SOP.
  • Build the cost-justification package for each escalation (CPI, labor, materials, and supplier cost trends) using ERP and FP&A analysis rather than data routed through Operations.
  • Determine on a case-by-case basis when to bring Operations into client delivery — client meetings or negotiations — based on relationship history and local context, while retaining central decision authority over strategy and final terms.
  • Partner with Legal/Contracts to confirm escalation-clause compliance, CPI/index caps, and required notice periods, and ensure cases meeting mandatory legal-review triggers (increases above 7%, CPI-capped clauses, active disputes, or regulated-industry contracts) are routed at least 15 business days ahead of client notification.
  • Coordinate with RSS and Contract Set Up teams to submit new pricing ahead of billing cutoffs and confirm written sign-off before any escalation is considered closed.
  • Maintain a close, collaborative working relationship with Operations and field leadership, who continue to own client relationships and support delivery even as cost analysis and final decision authority sit with the centralized team.

Reporting & Enablement

  • Build and maintain company-wide reporting on escalation pipeline status, approval-cycle time, timeline adherence, concession activity, and revenue protected/at risk, for the Head of FP&A and executive leadership.
  • Own documentation and audit trail across all required milestones (approval, notification, meeting, concessions, final terms, billing update, post-implementation review).
  • Train Account Managers, Branch Managers, and RVPs on their role under the new centralized model, along with the notification, objection-handling, and negotiation standards the centralized team will apply.

Team Leadership

  • Hire, develop, and manage the performance of the centralized Pricing Escalations team, including evaluating whether any pricing-related headcount currently in Operations should transition into the new team.
  • Present regular updates on escalation trends, risk, transition progress, and resolution performance to the Head of FP&A and other senior stakeholders.

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.

    • 8+ years of progressive experience in pricing, revenue operations, FP&A, or a related finance/commercial function, including 3+ years of people leadership.

    • Demonstrated experience leading a major operating-model change — ideally centralizing or re-owning a function previously run in the field or by another department — within a large, multi-business-unit organization.

    • Strong working knowledge of pricing structures, contract escalation clauses, CPI/index-linked pricing, and billing/revenue processes.

    • Hands-on experience pulling and analyzing cost and pricing data directly from ERP systems (e.g., SAP or similar) to inform pricing decisions.

    • Proven ability to lead through organizational change and influence senior stakeholders — including Operations leadership, Legal, and executive leadership — particularly where decision rights are shifting between functions.

    • Direct experience leading or closely supporting client-facing pricing or contract negotiations, not just overseeing a process from a distance.

    • Excellent analytical skills, with experience building reporting/dashboards (Excel required; Power BI, Tableau, or similar a plus).

    • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership.

Preferred:

  • MBA or relevant advanced degree.

    • Experience in a services, facilities, or field-based industry with a distributed branch/account-management structure.

    • Six Sigma, process-improvement, or project-management certification.

title: Customs Clearance Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customs Clearance Specialist based in Canada.

This is a fully remote customs operations role supporting high-volume ecommerce and parcel-level clearance across Canada. You will prepare and review customs documentation, process entries, determine duties and taxes, and ensure shipments comply with applicable customs requirements. The role combines detailed operational work with frequent communication across clients, carriers, freight forwarders, customs authorities, and internal teams. You will help resolve complex clearance issues while maintaining accurate records and meeting time-sensitive service requirements. Working within a technology-enabled environment, you will also support modern automated brokerage workflows and ecommerce clearance solutions. This is an opportunity to build your customs expertise within a fast-moving, collaborative environment where learning, ownership, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

Accountabilities

  • Independently review and prepare customs documentation for processing and entry releases, ensuring files are complete, accurate, and compliant with applicable policies and regulations.

  • Process B3/CAD customs entries in accordance with Canadian and applicable U.S. customs compliance standards, and correct rejected Canadian customs entries when required.

  • Determine appropriate duties, taxes, and HS tariff classifications while ensuring accurate processing and documentation for each shipment.

  • Respond to internal and external inquiries by phone, email, Slack, or other designated communication channels, providing clear and timely support to clients and stakeholders.

  • Communicate effectively with clients, the Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA), carriers, freight forwarders, partners, and other relevant parties to facilitate smooth customs clearance.

  • Maintain detailed transaction notes, instructions, client information, and database records, ensuring information remains accurate and up to date.

  • Prioritize workloads and consistently meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy, reliability, and attention to detail.

  • Independently investigate and resolve challenging customs and operational situations, proactively researching solutions and escalating issues when appropriate.

  • Support commercial activities by assisting the sales team and identifying opportunities to cross-sell relevant customs and brokerage services.

  • Contribute to the adoption of technology-enabled clearance workflows, including ecommerce parcel-level processing and automated brokerage tools.

  • Maintain professional knowledge by completing relevant examinations, certifications, conferences, training, and other industry development activities.

  • Collaborate across brokerage and technology teams to improve operational processes, knowledge sharing, and the overall customer experience.

    • Requirements:

    • Bring 1–3 years of hands-on experience in a customs brokerage environment, with experience processing shipments across multiple modes of transportation.

    • Hold a diploma or degree in a relevant field; post-secondary education or business courses related to customs, logistics, or international trade are considered an advantage.

    • Possess a CCS designation or another relevant industry certification; an LCB designation is considered an asset.

    • Have experience with CANdata or similar customs brokerage systems; familiarity with technology-enabled clearance platforms is an advantage.

    • Demonstrate strong knowledge of customs documentation, B3/CAD entries, HS tariff classification, duties and taxes, and Canadian customs compliance requirements.

    • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate professionally with clients, customs authorities, carriers, freight forwarders, and internal stakeholders.

    • Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a high level of ownership over assigned work.

    • Be resourceful and proactive, with strong problem-solving abilities and a determination to find effective solutions to unfamiliar or challenging situations.

    • Be comfortable working under pressure in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities and time-sensitive transactions.

    • Be self-motivated, dependable, flexible, and adaptable, with a positive, solutions-oriented attitude and willingness to continuously learn.

    • Have strong computer and software skills and be comfortable learning new digital tools and workflows.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Gersh
Gersh is a leading global entertainment and sports agency, representing a diverse roster of clients across film, television, sports, theater, comedy, branding, publishing, and digital media. As the fastest-growing major agency, Gersh is respected for its hands-on, client-first approach and commitment to driving innovation and success. Following an equity investment from Crestview Partners in 2023 Gersh has advanced its long-term growth plan, acquiring the Digital and Alternative departments of the A3 Agency, and You First – one of the world’s top sports and entertainment agencies. With clients at the heart of every growth decision, Gersh is harnessing strategic insights and decades of experience to strengthen its resources, empowering clients to realize success across all areas of the media landscape.

About the Role
Gersh is seeking an ambitious Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and evolve the platforms that power our business. You will work across cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, enterprise resource planning (ERP), SaaS integrations, content management systems (CMS), and AI-driven features. This is a hands-on technical role with real architectural ownership: you will shape how our systems scale, mentor other engineers, and partner closely with project and business stakeholders to turn complex requirements into reliable, maintainable software.

This is an ideal role for an ambitious professional with 0 to 3 years of project coordination or tech operations experience looking to advance their career in a rapidly evolving environment with exposure to AI, automation, business intelligence, and technology.

Key Responsibilities

1. Cloud & Scalable Architecture

  • Design and implement cloud-native services that are secure, resilient, observable, and cost-efficient.
  • Lead architectural decisions for distributed systems, including service boundaries, data partitioning, caching strategies, messaging, and event-driven patterns.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment workflows.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, plan for capacity, and ensure systems meet availability and latency targets.
  • Champion reliability practices such as monitoring, alerting, incident response, and post-incident reviews.

2. ERP Integration & Business Systems

  • Design and build integrations between core platforms and ERP systems covering finance, talent management, order management, and HR data.
  • Develop robust APIs, middleware, and data synchronization pipelines that keep business-critical data accurate and consistent across systems.
  • Translate business processes into technical workflows in partnership with IT, operations, and finance teams.
  • Ensure integrations are auditable, fault-tolerant, and compliant with data governance requirements in the US and EU.

3. CMS & Digital Experience

  • Architect and extend CMS platforms, including headless and API-first implementations, to support fast, flexible content delivery across web and mobile channels.
  • Build content models, custom modules, and publishing workflows that empower non-technical teams.
  • Optimize content delivery through CDNs, caching, and front-end performance best practices.

4. AI & Intelligent Features

  • Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features such as LLM-based assistants, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), recommendations, classification, and process automation.
  • Integrate machine learning models and third-party AI APIs into production systems with attention to latency, cost, evaluation, and safety.
  • Establish practices for prompt management, model evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI use.
  • Collaborate with data teams to build pipelines that prepare and serve data for AI workloads.

5. Technical Leadership

  • Mentor and support mid-level and junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, and design discussions.
  • Write and review technical design documents and contribute to long-term technical roadmaps.
  • Set and uphold high standards for code quality, testing, security, and documentation.
  • Communicate trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in a senior or lead capacity.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong proficiency in C#, SQL, and front-end frameworks like vue.js.
  • Deep hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud), including compute, storage, networking, serverless, and managed database services.
  • Proven experience designing and operating scalable, distributed systems, including microservices, event-driven architectures, message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), and caching (e.g., Redis).
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or Bicep).
  • Hands-on experience integrating with or customizing ERP systems such as Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Odoo, or Workday.
  • Experience building on or extending CMS platforms such as Contentful, Strapi, Sanity, Adobe Experience Manager, or Sitecore, including headless architectures.
  • Practical experience shipping AI/ML features to production, such as integrating LLM APIs, building RAG pipelines, working with vector databases, or deploying ML models and AI agents.
  • Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB) and data modeling.
  • Solid understanding of RESTful and GraphQL API design, identity and authorization (OAuth 2.0, OIDC), and application security best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills and a track record of collaborating across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Experience with ML frameworks and tooling (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex) and MLOps practices.
  • Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, OpenSearch) and AI evaluation techniques.
  • Experience with ERP migrations, data warehousing, or integration platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Integration Services).
  • Background in front-end frameworks (React, Next.js, Vue) for CMS-driven experiences.
  • Experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
  • Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and GDPR.
  • Capable of working from the middle out.

.

description:

Avum is seeking a DoD Contracting Subject Matter Expert with at least 15 years of experience supporting Federal or Department of Defense acquisition and contracting activities.


This individual will provide functional expertise to support the design, implementation, sustainment, and improvement of procurement business systems. Working closely with software developers, business analysts, QA teams, and government stakeholders, the SME will translate contracting regulations, business processes, and user needs into clear software requirements.


The ideal candidate has extensive knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), and the federal contracting lifecycle, along with hands-on experience using procurement systems. This role focuses on helping technical teams build and support solutions that meet the operational needs of contracting personnel.



Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the senior functional resource for Federal and DoD acquisition and contracting workflows, business processes, and procurement system requirements.
  • Work with contracting personnel and government stakeholders to identify user needs, clarify requirements, and resolve functional questions.

  • Support Agile development teams through requirements refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, and functional reviews.

  • Assess existing procurement processes and recommend improvements through updated workflows, automation, and system enhancements.
  • Support procurement data analysis, reporting requirements, and validation of system outputs.
  • Provide functional support for data migration, including mapping, interpretation, and validation of contracting data.
  • Assist Tier 3 service desk personnel with complex procurement system issues, workflow questions, and functional troubleshooting.
  • Develop and review user guides, training materials, business process documentation, and knowledge base content.
  • Explain complex contracting requirements clearly to technical teams and stakeholders with varying levels of procurement experience.

title: System Modeling and Simulation Lead (Quantum Systems)
description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real.

Job Summary:

We're looking for a System Modeling and Simulation Lead to build predictive, system-level models of our quantum computer based on photonic, electronic, and other system descriptions together with measured or specified component performance. The models will translate losses, noise, timing jitter, stability, crosstalk, false-count rates, and related nonidealities into key quantum performance metrics. This role will also create validated subsystem abstractions that conceal unnecessary implementation detail while preserving the behavior and control knobs needed by validation, architecture, and design teams for predictive analysis and model closure. These capabilities must be delivered through user-friendly, well-documented interfaces so teams across the organization can configure, run, and interpret approved models without needing to understand their internal implementation.

Responsibilities:

  • Build predictive system-level quantum performance models
    • Ingest and interpret photonic, electronic, and mixed-domain system descriptions, component models, characterization data, and system configuration inputs.
    • Translate component and interface performance - including loss, noise, jitter, drift and stability, crosstalk, and false-count rates - into end-to-end predictions of key quantum system metrics.
    • Develop models that support architecture trades, requirement allocation, performance budgeting, and design decisions before full hardware is available.
  • Develop coherent, reusable system abstractions
    • Create reduced-order or behavioral models that connect logical intent to physical-system behavior and support control, calibration, and validation workflows, while masking lower-level implementation details that are not needed by model users.
    • Define stable model interfaces and expose the necessary inputs, outputs, states, uncertainties, and control knobs for architecture, validation, and design teams, as well as control and calibration workflows.
    • Establish clear validity ranges, assumptions, parameter provenance, and fidelity levels, and maintain coherence among logical, physical, and control models as each evolves.
  • Drive model validation and closure
    • Partner with validation, design, and subsystem teams to compare model predictions against component, subsystem, and integrated-system measurements.
    • Quantify prediction error and uncertainty using sensitivity analysis, Monte Carlo methods, uncertainty propagation, and statistical inference where appropriate.
    • Investigate model-to-hardware discrepancies, identify missing physics or incorrect assumptions, and drive model closure with documented evidence.
  • Build usable simulation capabilities that scale
    • Develop maintainable, modular simulation software in Python, with automated tests, version control, clear APIs, and reproducible execution.
    • Provide a user-friendly interface - such as documented Python APIs, configuration-driven workflows, command-line or graphical tools, templates, and clear visualization/reporting - so users across the organization can configure and run approved analyses with minimal support.
    • Create versioned component and subsystem model libraries that remain synchronized with requirements, characterization data, system configurations, and hardware revisions, while improving execution efficiency without compromising accuracy or traceability.
    • Create a workflow that enables other engineers and domain experts to contribute component, subsystem, and detailed-physics models while maintaining common interfaces, review rigor, traceability, and quality standards.
  • Partner cross-functionally and communicate clearly
    • Work closely with architecture, validation, design, photonics, electronics, controls, calibration, detailed physics modeling, and systems engineering teams to define model needs, boundaries, and interfaces.
    • Turn ambiguous performance questions into well-scoped modeling studies with clear assumptions, confidence bounds, and decision-relevant outputs.
    • Communicate model behavior, limitations, dominant sensitivities, and recommended actions through clear documentation and concise technical and executive updates.

Experience/Qualifications:

  • Education & experience
    • MS in Systems Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field with 10+ years of relevant industry experience, or
    • PhD in a similar field with 6+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • Systems-modeling and signal-processing background
    • Strong foundation in systems modeling for complex, multi-domain physical systems, with the ability to connect component behavior and physical nonidealities to system-level performance metrics.
    • Strong understanding of signal processing, noise analysis, timing and frequency-domain behavior, stochastic processes, and statistical data analysis.
  • Modeling & software
    • Advanced proficiency in Python scientific computing and experience building production-quality simulation or analysis software that is usable by engineers beyond the development team.
    • Demonstrated experience with graph-based system representations, numerical simulation, and model validation for complex physical systems.
    • Experience using and championing modern agentic software-development best practices.
    • Proficiency with modern version-control tools and collaborative workflows, particularly Git, including branching, code review, and managing contributions from multiple developers.
  • Collaboration & communication
    • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to explain model assumptions, uncertainty, limitations, and technical conclusions to both domain experts and system-level decision makers.
  • Mindset
    • Rigorous and intellectually curious; comfortable working across abstraction levels, challenging assumptions, and iterating as designs and measured data evolve.

  • Prepare concise, decision-ready executive memos and Weekly Business Reviews that clearly communicate workforce insights, risks, recommendations, and required decisions.

    • Demonstrate advanced proficiency with analytical tools such as Google Sheets, SQL, or Python, with the ability to work confidently with complex and imperfect datasets.

    • Show strong business and financial judgment, with the ability to connect operational workforce dynamics to hiring requirements, BPO costs, overtime exposure, budget implications, and service-level risk.

    • Possess excellent strategic communication and writing skills, with the ability to distill complex workforce analytics into concise, executive-ready one- to two-page decision memos.

    • Demonstrate experience influencing Finance, Product, Operations, and senior stakeholders through data-driven recommendations, even without formal authority.

title: AI Linguistic Evaluator
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a AI Linguistic Evaluator based in India.

This is a flexible, remote opportunity for a language professional to help evaluate and improve the performance of AI applications in Tamil. You will interact directly with AI systems, assess the quality and accuracy of their responses, and provide structured feedback based on defined project standards. The role combines linguistic expertise with cultural awareness to ensure AI-generated content feels natural, relevant, and appropriate for Tamil-speaking users. You will also translate prompts from English into Tamil and evaluate how effectively the AI responds in the target language. The project is well suited to professionals with backgrounds in linguistics, translation, localization, or other language-focused disciplines. It offers the opportunity to contribute directly to the development of next-generation AI systems while working independently on a short-term engagement.

Accountabilities

  • Interact with an AI assistant in Tamil and evaluate how effectively it understands and responds to prompts in the target language.

  • Translate provided prompts from English into Tamil accurately while preserving the intended meaning, context, and linguistic nuances.

  • Assess AI-generated responses against established project guidelines, quality standards, and evaluation criteria.

  • Evaluate localization quality by reviewing linguistic accuracy, naturalness, fluency, cultural relevance, and appropriateness for Tamil-speaking audiences.

  • Identify linguistic or contextual issues in AI-generated content and provide clear, structured, and objective feedback.

  • Apply detailed evaluation guidelines consistently across tasks to ensure reliable and high-quality assessments.

  • Work independently to complete assigned evaluations accurately and within the expected project timelines.

    • Requirements:

    • Demonstrate native-level fluency in Tamil as used in India, with an excellent understanding of grammar, spelling, linguistic nuances, and cultural context.

    • Have strong English skills and the ability to accurately translate prompts from English into Tamil while maintaining meaning and intent.

    • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Linguistics, Translation, Languages, Philology, Literature, or a related field with at least one year of relevant professional experience, or have a minimum of five years of professional experience in language-related work.

    • Bring strong attention to detail and the ability to identify subtle issues in language quality, localization, tone, and cultural relevance.

    • Be comfortable evaluating AI-generated content independently and providing consistent, objective assessments based on defined criteria.

    • Demonstrate the ability to follow detailed project instructions and apply structured quality standards consistently.

    • Be self-directed, reliable, and capable of delivering accurate work with minimal supervision.

    • Have access to at least one personal device running iOS, Android, Windows, or macOS.

      • Benefits:

      • Freelance, temporary contract opportunity with an estimated project duration of approximately 10–15 total hours.

      • Flexible remote work schedule, with approximately five hours of work per day.

      • Immediate project start, subject to project onboarding and requirements.

      • Compensation of USD 18 per hour.

      • Opportunity to contribute to the evaluation and improvement of next-generation AI technology.

      • Hands-on experience assessing AI-generated language, localization, and cultural relevance.

      • Fully remote work environment with the flexibility to complete assignments independently.

      • Opportunity to apply and develop expertise in linguistics, translation, localization, and AI evaluation.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
• Shape the experiences that make managing money with Zip feel simple, intuitive and human, turning complex product challenges into beautifully considered customer journeys.
  • Bring deep interaction and visual design craft across native mobile and web, with strong product thinking, systems thinking and customer insight.
  • Work hybrid from our Sydney office, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Design to take ideas from discovery through to customer impact.

Write your story with a career at Zip

Join Zip’s Product Design team and help create trusted customer experiences that make managing money and paying with Zip simple, intuitive and human.

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll take ownership of complex product challenges from early discovery through to delivery and continuous improvement. Working as an individual contributor alongside Product, Engineering, Data and Design, you’ll have the opportunity to influence both the experiences our customers use and the direction of the products behind them.

You’ll bring together customer insight, product judgement and exceptional design craft to simplify complex financial journeys. As we explore new possibilities with AI and intelligent automation, you’ll also help identify where emerging technology can create meaningful value for customers.

What you’ll own

  • Lead end to end design across a product domain, from framing customer problems and discovery through to delivery, measurement and continuous improvement.
  • Set a high standard for accessible interaction and visual design across native mobile and web, taking ideas from early prototypes through to production ready experiences.
  • Use customer research, product data and experimentation to understand customer needs, influence product strategy and help define what success looks like.
  • Apply systems thinking to simplify complex financial journeys and understand how customer experience connects with technology, operations, policy and risk.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing and Risk to make thoughtful trade offs between customer needs, business priorities and technical feasibility.
  • Bring people together through workshops, design critiques and clear storytelling, adapting your approach to build alignment with different audiences.
  • Help evolve Zip’s design system, principles and experience standards, creating reusable patterns that lift quality and consistency.
  • Explore AI enabled experiences and emerging interaction patterns, while sharing your expertise through critique, mentoring and knowledge sharing.

What you’ll bring to the team

Zipsters work on a broad range of initiatives, and our skills and experiences all look a little different. What really matters to us is that you’re a great fit with our four Values, and have a desire to learn and grow.

So whether you meet some or all of the desirable attributes below, we’d still love to hear from you:

  • 5+ years’ experience designing complex, customer facing digital products in fintech, payments, technology or another high scale or regulated environment.
  • Deep interaction and visual design capability across native mobile and web, with a portfolio demonstrating this as well as strong product thinking, accessibility and attention to detail.
  • Confidence using customer research, usability testing, experimentation and product data to understand needs and influence product decisions.
  • Strong systems thinking, with experience simplifying complex customer journeys, services, workflows and dependencies.
  • Clear storytelling, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build alignment and partner closely with Product and Engineering through delivery.
  • Strong working knowledge of Figma and prototyping, alongside experience contributing to scalable design systems.
  • Practical experience using AI assisted tools for exploration, prototyping or research synthesis, with curiosity about how emerging technology can improve the quality and pace of design.
  • Sound judgement and the ability to work autonomously, navigate ambiguity and respond constructively to evidence and feedback.
  • A mindset that embraces AI and new tools to adapt, learn and grow.
  • An aptitude for identifying and managing risks. Whether you are a People Manager or an Individual Contributor, we are all leaders at Zip, therefore effective risk management is important to how we run our business and part of all our roles.
  • Our values in your DNA. Customer First, Own It, Stronger Together and Change the Game.

What you’ll get in return

As we write this next exciting chapter in our story, we will continue to move at pace and embrace change. For you, this might mean opportunities to learn new skills with hands-on experience, broader responsibilities, or the buzz of seeing your work impact customers faster.

Zip is a place where you’ll get out exactly what you put in. When you join the team, we'll do our best to make sure you can be yourself and surround yourself with smart, friendly colleagues and leaders who have your back, so that you can make the big things happen.

Zipsters tell us these are just some of the best things about working here. You’ll also receive:

  • 25 days paid leave annually, including birthday leave and quarterly wellbeing days
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers, and 4 weeks for supporting carers
  • Family support policies including miscarriage bereavement leave and domestic violence leave
  • Mental health and wellness initiatives, including $299 annual wellbeing allowance, free access for you and family members to our EAP service Sonder, discounted private health insurance, and great rates on fitness sessions through ClassPass
  • 2 days paid volunteering leave per year
  • Access to the Flare Benefits Hub and Novated Leasing for savings across lifestyle, essentials and wellbeing
  • Fee-free Zip products, and discounts with Zip merchant partners
  • Team social events, epic offices, free breakfast daily, and weekly free lunches

Be a part of a team that reflects the diversity of our customers

We pride ourselves on being a workplace that provides equal opportunities to people of all ages, cultural backgrounds, sexual orientations, gender identities, abilities, veteran status, and everything else that makes you unique.

Equally, we’re committed to ensuring our recruitment processes are accessible and inclusive. Please let us know If there are any adjustments that need to be made to ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

And finally…get to know us

Zip Co Limited (ASX: ZIP) is a digital financial services company, offering innovative, people-centred products that bring customers and merchants together.

Operating in two core markets - Australia and the US, Zip offers point-of-sale credit and digital payment services, connecting millions of customers with its global network of tens of thousands of merchants.

We’re proud to be a values-led business and our values - Customer First, Own it, Stronger Together and Change the Game - guide us in everything we do.

title: Maintenance Scheduler and Planner
description:
At IEM, we’re not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we’re shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting out, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world’s most dynamic markets.

Position Summary

The Maintenance Scheduler & Planner is responsible for planning, coordinating, and scheduling preventive, corrective, and planned maintenance activities to support safe, reliable, and efficient operations. This role serves as the primary MainX administrator, maintaining accurate work orders, preventive maintenance schedules, technician assignments, and maintenance records. Working under the direction of the Maintenance Manager, the position coordinates maintenance priorities, assigns planned work to specific technicians, and ensures required parts and resources are available for scheduled activities. The role also manages maintenance spare-parts inventory, supports maintenance performance reporting, and helps improve equipment reliability, schedule compliance, and overall maintenance effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

MainX Administration & Maintenance Planning

  • Serve as the primary MainX administrator and subject-matter resource for the Maintenance Department.
  • Maintain accurate equipment, assets, work order, preventive maintenance, and technician information within MainX.
  • Create, review, update, and close maintenance work orders in accordance with department procedures.
  • Develop and maintain preventive maintenance schedules in MainX.
  • Ensure maintenance activities are properly documented and accurately reflected in the system.
  • Monitor overdue, upcoming, and outstanding maintenance work orders and communicate status to the Maintenance Manager.
  • Generate and maintain maintenance reports, metrics, and performance data from MainX.
  • Identify opportunities to improve MainX utilization, data accuracy, and maintenance workflow efficiency.

Maintenance Scheduling & Coordination

  • Develop daily, weekly, and longer-term maintenance schedules based on priorities established by the Maintenance Manager.
  • Coordinate and assign planned maintenance activities to specific technicians based on skill level, availability, workload, and equipment requirements.
  • Balance planned maintenance work with corrective and emergency maintenance demands.
  • Coordinate maintenance activities with Production and other departments to minimize operational disruption.
  • Track scheduled work and follow up on incomplete, delayed, or rescheduled activities.
  • Maintain visibility of technician workload and available maintenance capacity.
  • Assist the Maintenance Manager with developing and maintaining the department's maintenance backlog and schedule.
  • Communicate schedule changes and priorities to Maintenance Leads and technicians.

Spare Parts & Inventory Management

  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance spare parts and inventory.
  • Monitor critical spare parts and identify potential shortages before they impact maintenance activities.
  • Coordinate parts availability with scheduled maintenance work orders.
  • Ensure required parts are identified and available prior to scheduling work whenever practical.
  • Assist with maintaining appropriate minimum/maximum inventory levels for critical maintenance components.
  • Coordinate with Purchasing and suppliers regarding parts availability, orders, lead times, and delivery status.
  • Identify obsolete, excess, or frequently used spare parts and communicate recommendations to the Maintenance Manager.
  • Maintain accurate parts information, including descriptions, part numbers, quantities, and storage locations.

Maintenance Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Track maintenance KPIs such as PM completion, schedule compliance, backlog, downtime, and work order status.
  • Provide regular maintenance scheduling and performance reports to the Maintenance Manager.
  • Assist in identifying recurring equipment issues and maintenance trends.
  • Support initiatives to improve preventive maintenance effectiveness, equipment reliability, and maintenance efficiency.
  • Participate in maintenance planning meetings and continuous improvement activities.
  • Promote an initiative-taking, planned-maintenance culture throughout the organization.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; technical degree or maintenance-related education preferred.
  • 2–5 years of experience in maintenance planning, scheduling, CMMS administration, inventory control, or a related maintenance role.
  • Experience working with a CMMS or maintenance management system; MainX experience preferred.
  • Understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance processes.
  • Experience with spare parts and maintenance inventory management.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple work orders and changing maintenance requirements.
  • Effective communication and people skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to work effectively with Maintenance, Production, Engineering, Purchasing, and other cross-functional teams.

Key Competencies

  • Maintenance Planning & Scheduling
  • CMMS/MainX Administration
  • Preventive Maintenance Management
  • Spare Parts & Inventory Control
  • Work Order Management
  • Data Accuracy & Reporting
  • Prioritization & Organization
  • Communication & Teamwork
  • Problem Solving
  • Continuous Improvement

Success Measures

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • PM schedule completion and compliance
  • Maintenance schedule adherence
  • Reduction of overdue maintenance work
  • Accurate and timely MainX work order management.
  • Improved maintenance backlog visibility
  • Availability of critical spare parts
  • Improved technician utilization and workload balance
  • Accuracy of maintenance records and inventory data

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join a major data transformation programme on an initial 3-month contract.

This is a hands‑on role for someone who enjoys building robust, scalable data platforms and pipelines. You will work as part of a wider technical delivery team, helping to develop a modern AWS-based data environment that supports enterprise reporting, analytics and operational decision-making.

The successful candidate will ideally be able to attend the Leeds office one day per week. However, flexible arrangements can be discussed for the right person.

The role

You will play a key part in designing, building and improving cloud‑based data solutions. This will include developing data pipelines, integrating data from multiple systems and helping to create trusted, well‑governed datasets for reporting and analytics.

You will work closely with Data Architects, Analysts, Developers and other technical stakeholders to turn business and technical requirements into practical, scalable solutions.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and build scalable data lake and data warehouse solutions on AWS.
  • Develop data ingestion, transformation and storage pipelines to support reporting, analytics and operational use cases.
  • Work with AWS services including S3, Redshift, Glue, Lambda, Lake Formation, Athena and EventBridge.
  • Implement Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers using Medallion Architecture principles.
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines across batch, streaming and Change Data Capture (CDC) workloads.
  • Develop reusable transformation frameworks, data models and curated datasets using Python, SQL and dbt.
  • Support data migration and integration activity across a range of source and target systems.
  • Build integrations using APIs, messaging technologies and file‑based ingestion methods.
  • Implement data validation, reconciliation and error‑handling processes to improve data quality.
  • Support data governance, lineage, security and audit requirements.
  • Help automate deployments and infrastructure using Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tooling.
  • Improve monitoring and operational support using tools such as CloudWatch and Splunk.
  • Produce clear technical documentation for pipelines, mappings, transformations and data flows.
  • Promote good engineering practice, automation, standardisation and continuous improvement.

About you

You will be a capable, delivery‑focused Data Engineer with experience working on modern cloud data platforms. You should be comfortable working independently, but equally happy collaborating with a multidisciplinary technical team.

You will have strong experience with AWS data services and be confident designing and developing data pipelines in complex transformation, migration or integration environments.

Key skills and experience

  • Proven experience designing and delivering AWS-based data platforms.
  • Strong hands‑on experience with services such as S3, Redshift, Glue, Lambda, Lake Formation, Athena and EventBridge.
  • Experience implementing Medallion Architecture, including Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers.
  • Strong data engineering experience across batch, streaming and CDC ingestion patterns.
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong Python development experience.
  • Experience using dbt for data transformation and modelling would be highly beneficial.
  • Experience building and optimising ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Good understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modelling and analytical data structures.
  • Experience with data integration, APIs, messaging and file‑based data ingestion.
  • Knowledge of Terraform or CloudFormation for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with CI/CD tooling, ideally GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with monitoring, observability and data quality frameworks.
  • Knowledge of CloudWatch, Splunk or similar monitoring tools.
  • An understanding of data governance, lineage, validation and security principles.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

This is a fast‑moving requirement, and we are keen to identify suitable candidates quickly. Please get in touch with relevant profiles.

Independently Licensed Clinical Supervisor (Part-Time)

Families & Youth Innovations Plus (FYI+)

Position: Part-Time Provider
Salary: $35.58/hr. - $43.05 (Based on education and experience)

Department: Outpatient/Mobile Crisis Services


Job Summary

FYI+ is seeking an independently licensed clinician who is qualified and authorized to provide clinical supervision in New Mexico. Based at our Solano location, this hybrid position combines scheduled in-person responsibilities with the flexibility to complete appropriate duties remotely.

The Clinical Supervisor provides consistent weekly supervision to an assigned group of non-independently licensed clinicians and interns. The role also serves as a trained backup source of independently licensed clinical support for the CCSS and Psychiatric Rehabilitation programs. This backup function is provided as needed, including when documentation requires review or signature by an independently licensed professional, and does not replace the programs’ routine supervision structures.


By maintaining familiarity with CCSS and Psychiatric Rehabilitation service and documentation requirements, the Clinical Supervisor helps create continuity and redundancy in clinical oversight. The position supports quality of care, sound clinical practice, documentation compliance, and adherence to agency, contractual, credentialing, payer, and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the agreed schedule, candidate availability, and program needs, the position may be structured as either a supervision-focused part-time role or a broader role that includes a defined caseload. A supervision-focused assignment does not carry an ongoing participant caseload. When direct clinical services are included, the caseload will be proportionate to the employee’s scheduled hours and supervisory responsibilities.

Qualified employees may also earn additional compensation by accepting optional, stipend-supported on-call coverage as a Mobile Crisis Team Clinician.


What You’ll Do

Clinical Supervision and Oversight

  • Provide consistent weekly one-on-one clinical supervision to assigned non-independently licensed clinicians and interns, including LMSWs, LMHCs, and LAMFTs, as permitted by the supervisor’s license and applicable professional board requirements.
  • Review, oversee, and co-sign documentation completed by assigned supervisees when required and authorized.
  • Ensure assigned clinicians follow applicable clinical standards, ethical requirements, agency policies, documentation expectations, and regulatory and payer requirements.
  • Provide clinical guidance, case consultation, and support to assigned clinicians, interns, and other clinically oriented staff.
  • Serve as backup independently licensed clinical support for the CCSS and Psychiatric Rehabilitation programs when regular program supervision is unavailable or additional coverage is needed.
  • Review and sign CCSS and Psychiatric Rehabilitation documentation when the signature of an independently licensed professional is required and the Clinical Supervisor is authorized to do so.
  • Maintain sufficient familiarity with CCSS and Psychiatric Rehabilitation services, standards, and documentation requirements to provide reliable backup coverage and help prevent gaps in clinical oversight.
  • Collaborate with program leadership to identify clinical-quality concerns, documentation issues, training needs, and opportunities to strengthen services.

Direct Clinical Services, When Included in the Assigned Role

  • Maintain a manageable caseload proportionate to scheduled hours and supervisory responsibilities.
  • Provide therapy, assessment, and related clinical services within the clinician’s scope of practice and in accordance with agency, contract, credentialing, and payer requirements.
  • Complete timely and accurate participant documentation in the electronic health record.
  • Support continuity of care, participant engagement, and timely access to appropriate services.

Optional Mobile Crisis Team Coverage

  • Accept optional, stipend-supported on-call hours as a Mobile Crisis Team Clinician based on interest, availability, qualifications, credentialing, and program needs.
  • Provide crisis assessment, intervention, safety planning, and related community-based crisis services in accordance with Mobile Crisis Team and agency standards.


What you’ll Need

  • Current New Mexico State License in Good Standing and Board Verified (LPCC, LMFT, or LCSW)
  • Must be independently licensed in the State of New Mexico (LISW, LPCC, LMFT, or Licensed Psychologist).
  • Master's degree or higher in counseling, social work, marriage and family therapy, psychology, or a related field required.
  • Board Approved Supervisor status preferred or willingness to obtain.

An Assembler works as an effective member of a team to assemble product in a timely manner according to work instructions, engineering drawings, and quality guidelines to produce quality products. This position requires the ability to complete routine operations on a continual basis.


PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Performs a specific step of the assembly process as part of a team, according to work instructions, engineering drawings, and training to produce quality product.
  2. Inspects the quality of the materials and work in process.
  3. Produces product in a timely manner as outlined by department supervision and management.
  4. Operates any equipment, tools, fixtures, etc. needed to perform the assigned job.
  5. Regular and reliable attendance is an essential function of this job. Punctuality and regular attendance are crucial for efficient plant operations, safety, and morale.
  6. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned as required.

AUTHORITY

  1. Requests necessary supplies and resources required to complete the jobs assigned.
  2. Alerts supervision of problems with materials, tools, fixtures, machinery, etc.
  3. Suggests improved or alternate methods of assembling product.

QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Able to perform routine tasks on a continuing basis.
  2. Able to correctly use required tools, fixtures, machines, etc. involved in the assembly process.
  3. Able to correctly assemble according to instructions, engineering drawings, and training.
  4. Able to recognize quality problems with materials and work in process.
  5. Able to complete an assembly step in a timely manner as outlined by department supervision and management.
  6. Good work attendance and dependability.
  7. Able to communicate and work with others as a team.
  8. If working nights or shifts with minimal supervision, must pass a criminal background check.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is primarily required to stand. The employee is regularly required to use hands to grasp, finger or handle objects and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or exert force from 25 up to 75 pounds. Push and/or pull up to 300 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision and depth perception.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

Majority of time spent at a workstation on a production line as part of a team assembling product. May need to operate machinery or use tools and/or fixtures as part of the assembly process.

401(k), Minimum Essential Coverage Plan (MEC)

title: Resource Management Lead
description:
We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You Will Be Working With

At PMG, our Business Transformation team plays a critical role in shaping how we operate, scale, and evolve as an organization. We’re focused on building innovative, efficient, and future-ready business capabilities that connect people, processes, data, and technology to drive meaningful impact. Through cross-functional collaboration, intelligent automation, and continuous improvement, we’re transforming how work is prioritized, managed, and delivered across PMG.

You’ll report to the Head of Business Transformation and partner closely with Resource Management, Impact Operations, Customer Operations, People & Culture, Talent Acquisition, and business leadership to design and implement PMG’s future Workforce Management capabilities. Together, you’ll develop the infrastructure, processes, systems, and governance needed to intelligently forecast, prioritize, and fulfill work at scale.

Beyond developing new capabilities, you’ll help lead a significant evolution in how PMG approaches workforce management—moving beyond traditional people-based resource allocation toward intelligent work orchestration across people, AI agents, automation, and technology. You’ll play a key role in building scalable solutions, driving organizational adoption, and establishing the frameworks that support operational excellence and long-term business growth.

As a Senior Principal in Workforce Management Transformation, if you're passionate about leading enterprise-wide transformation, leveraging emerging technologies, and building innovative solutions that redefine how organizations operate, this is the place to do your best work.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the design and implementation of PMG’s future Workforce Management capabilities, developing scalable processes, systems, and frameworks that support intelligent work planning and fulfillment.

  • Architect end-to-end workforce management infrastructure, including business processes, governance models, operating rhythms, service models, standard operating procedures, and workforce management methodologies.

  • Establish reporting frameworks, data standards, and governance practices that ensure accurate, consistent, and actionable workforce insights across the organization.

  • Develop executive dashboards and data visualization capabilities that provide business leaders with the right workforce insights at the right time to support strategic decision-making.

  • Evaluate and optimize the Work Demand Request process, improving how customer and business needs are captured, prioritized, and translated into actionable fulfillment strategies.

  • Develop standardized work taxonomies, fulfillment methodologies, and inventories of skills, capabilities, AI agents, automations, and reusable delivery assets.

  • Design decision-making frameworks that determine the optimal combination of people, AI, automation, and technology required to efficiently fulfill work.

  • Leverage operational data, historical performance, and emerging technologies to continuously improve workforce planning, fulfillment recommendations, and operational efficiency.

  • Define the product vision, business requirements, and strategic roadmap for PMG’s Workforce Management technology ecosystem.

  • Lead the evolution of PMG’s Resource Management App from a people-centric allocation tool into an intelligent, work demand-centric Workforce Management platform.

  • Identify opportunities to integrate workflow automation, AI-assisted management capabilities, and agentic workflows into workforce management processes and systems.

  • Partner with Resource Management, Customer Operations, Impact Operations, and cross-functional leadership to align transformation initiatives with business priorities and operational needs.

  • Develop and execute implementation roadmaps, change management strategies, and adoption plans that successfully introduce new processes, technologies, and ways of working.

  • Establish performance metrics and capability maturity frameworks to measure transformation progress, operational effectiveness, and long-term business impact.

  • Support operational continuity during key phases of transformation, balancing the implementation of future capabilities with current business needs.

  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve decision-making, and increase organizational scalability.

Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Business Transformation, Workforce Management, Resource Management, Operations Strategy, or a related field, with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

  • You have experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives, designing scalable business capabilities, and implementing operational improvements across teams or organizations.

  • You bring a strong understanding of workforce planning, resource management, work demand forecasting, capacity management, and operational fulfillment methodologies.

  • You have demonstrated experience developing business processes, governance frameworks, operating models, and standardized methodologies that improve organizational efficiency and scalability.

  • You understand how to leverage data, analytics, reporting frameworks, and executive dashboards to inform strategic decisions and measure operational performance.

  • You have experience defining business requirements, partnering with technology teams, and supporting the implementation or evolution of enterprise platforms and operational systems.

  • You are knowledgeable about emerging technologies, including AI, workflow automation, and agentic capabilities, and can identify opportunities to integrate these solutions into business operations.

  • You confidently partner with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, translating complex business challenges into clear strategies, actionable roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

  • You bring experience driving organizational change, building stakeholder alignment, and leading adoption efforts for new processes, systems, and technologies.

  • You balance strategic, long-term thinking with hands-on execution, navigating competing priorities while maintaining focus on business objectives and operational needs.

  • You are proactive, analytical, and solutions-oriented, with the ability to identify inefficiencies, challenge traditional ways of working, and develop innovative approaches to complex operational challenges.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and bring strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills to initiatives that span multiple business functions.

  • A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of emerging technologies, workforce management innovation, and business transformation practices while maintaining a Customer-Focused mindset that prioritizes meaningful business outcomes.

  • A dedication to People-Focused leadership, fostering collaboration, organizational alignment, and professional growth while empowering teams to embrace change, adopt new capabilities, and continuously improve.

What We Offer

  • Professional Development: Take advantage of our learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and career advancement support.

  • Generous Time Off: Enjoy generous paid time off and holiday allowances to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

  • Parental Leave: We provide paid parental leave to support your family during important life events.

  • Retirement & Pension Plans: Plan for your future with competitive retirement or pension programs, including contribution matching.

  • Fertility and Family Support: Access fertility benefits for all team members and their spouses.

  • Healthcare: Coverage and support for everyday medical expenses and routine care, tailored by geography.

  • Pet Insurance: Protect your pet's health and your finances.

  • Lifestyle Spending Accounts: Enjoy 100% company-funded accounts to promote healthy habits and well-being.

  • Commuter Benefits: Access support for travel and commuting needs, where available.

  • Annual Bonus: All employees are eligible for an annual bonus.

  • Volunteering Opportunities: Receive 8 give-back hours to volunteer in your local communities.

  • AI Enterprise License: Access AI Enterprise accounts and participate in weekly AI training sessions to empower and ensure AI safety.

Benefits vary by country, location, and geography to reflect local laws, norms, and expectations.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
