title: Residential Therapist
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Under the direction of the Program Director and clinical supervision of the Licensed Clinical Director, the Residential Therapist provides specialty mental health, rehabilitation, and recovery-oriented services within BRIDGES' Social Rehabilitation Facility, Enhanced Residential Services model.

The Residential Therapist serves adults experiencing serious mental illness and co-occurring behavioral health conditions who require residential rehabilitation and support to achieve psychiatric stability, increase independence, develop community living skills, and successfully transition to less restrictive community settings. ERS programs provide augmented specialty mental health services within licensed Social Rehabilitation Facilities (SRFs) designed to assist individuals transitioning from higher levels of care and reducing the risk of hospitalization, re-hospitalization, incarceration, homelessness, or other institutional placements. The programs support clients in developing the skills and community supports necessary for long-term recovery and successful community living.

The Residential Therapist functions as a key member of a multidisciplinary treatment team and provides clinical assessment, treatment planning, individual and group services, rehabilitation services, care coordination, crisis intervention, concurrent authorization support, and discharge planning activities consistent with Medi-Cal requirements, Los Angeles County Department of Mental Health standards, Community Care Licensing regulations, California Department of Health Care Services requirements, Behavioral Health Services Act (BHSA) principles, and BRIDGES policies and procedures.

The therapist promotes person-centered, trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and recovery-focused

services that support behavioral health recovery, independent living, and successful community

integration.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Admissions and Referral Coordination

  • Work collaboratively with intake staff, nursing staff, program leadership, and referral sources to support the admission process, including clinical consultation, assessment activities, coordination of care, and transition planning as needed.
  • Collaborate with referral sources, hospitals, conservators, LACDMH representatives, and community providers during the admission process, as appropriate.
  • Participate in admission planning and support successful transition into the residential treatment environment.
  • Complete intake assessments, document medical necessity, and all admission-related documentation within required timelines.

Assessment, Treatment Planning, and Clinical Services

  • Conduct comprehensive clinical assessments, risk assessments, functional assessments, and ongoing reassessments.
  • Develop, coordinate, and update individualized, person-centered treatment and recovery plans.
  • Monitor treatment progress and modify interventions based on client needs and outcomes.
  • Provide individual, group, family, collateral, rehabilitation, and therapeutic services consistent with program requirements and client treatment goals.
  • Utilize evidence-based, recovery-oriented, trauma-informed interventions, and best practices.
  • Assist clients in reducing behavioral health symptoms and improving overall functioning.
  • Support clients in developing independent living, interpersonal, emotional regulation, problem-solving, self-advocacy, and community living skills necessary to achieve individualized recovery goals.
  • Utilize the residential milieu as a therapeutic intervention to support behavioral change, recovery, and community integration.

Therapeutic Milieu Leadership

  • Provide clinical leadership within the therapeutic milieu by assisting residential staff in understanding, implementing, and supporting individualized treatment goals.
  • Provide consultation, coaching, and guidance to residential staff regarding behavioral interventions, symptom management, recovery-oriented practices, and crisis prevention strategies.
  • Assist team members in understanding client strengths, challenges, treatment goals, identified risks, and recommended interventions while promoting a safe, structured, and therapeutic environment.
  • Model therapeutic interventions, engagement techniques, behavioral support approaches, de-escalation methods, and risk prevention strategies for unlicensed team members. Provide ongoing coaching to staff regarding trauma-informed, recovery-oriented interactions, behavioral observations, documentation practices, and the use of objective, non-stigmatizing language when communicating about clients and their treatment needs.
  • When the Program Director is unavailable, provide day-to-day clinical and programmatic guidance to residential staff to support continuity of care, client safety, treatment implementation, and effective program operations, consistent with agency policies and within the scope of the position.

Care Coordination and Interdisciplinary Collaboration

  • Coordinate services with psychiatrists, nurses, primary care providers, outpatient mental health providers, substance use treatment providers, housing agencies, and community resources.
  • Work collaboratively with members of the multidisciplinary treatment team to ensure comprehensive and integrated care.
  • Participate in treatment team meetings, case conferences, clinical consultations, and interdisciplinary discussions.
  • Coordinate and communicate with public and private conservators, legal representatives, family members, and other authorized support persons regarding treatment planning, progress, discharge planning, and continuity of care as appropriate.
  • Facilitate communication across service systems to ensure continuity of care and successful community transitions.

Rehabilitation and Recovery Support

  • Provide, arrange, and coordinate services that support client recovery and community integration.
  • Assist clients in accessing behavioral health, physical health, substance use, educational, employment, financial, entitlement, and housing resources.
  • Support the development of self-advocacy skills, natural supports, community connections, and recovery resources that promote long-term stability, independent living, and successful community integration.
  • Promote self-determination, client choice, recovery, resilience, and independent living.

Concurrent Authorization and Continuing Stay Reviews

  • Participate actively in concurrent authorization, continuing stay reviews, and documentation activities supporting medical necessity and level-of-care justification.
  • Collaborate with treatment team members to complete authorization-related documentation and provide clinical justification supporting continued residential treatment services.
  • Monitor client progress and assist in determining readiness for transition to lower levels of care.
  • Support program compliance with county, state, and Medi-Cal authorization requirements and established timelines.

Discharge Planning and Community Transition

  • Collaborate with the treatment team in discharge planning activities and ongoing evaluation of client readiness for transition to a lower level of care.
  • Provide clinical input and recommendations related to discharge goals, treatment needs, relapse prevention, community supports, and continuity of care.
  • Support linkage to behavioral health, medical, housing, and community-based services to promote successful transitions and ongoing recovery.
  • Complete clinical documentation related to discharge planning and transition activities as assigned.

Crisis Intervention and Risk Management

  • Conduct risk assessments, safety planning, and other risk-management activities as clinically indicated.
  • Provide crisis intervention, stabilization, and de-escalation services.
  • Respond to psychiatric and behavioral health emergencies in collaboration with treatment team members and community crisis resources.
  • Initiate and/or participate in involuntary psychiatric hold processes (5150) when clinically appropriate and within the scope of training, designation, and agency policy.
  • Participate in critical incident review and follow-up activities when required.

Documentation, Compliance, and Quality Improvement

  • Maintain accurate, timely, and complete clinical documentation in accordance with Medi-Cal requirements, LACDMH standards, Community Care Licensing requirements, California regulations, and BRIDGES policies and procedures.
  • Complete assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, reviews, and related documentation within required timelines.
  • Maintain confidentiality and protect client information in accordance with HIPAA, state law, and organizational policy.
  • Participate in quality assurance, quality improvement, audit, chart review, and compliance activities and support adherence to contractual, regulatory, licensing, and funding requirements.

Professional Responsibilities

  • Maintain professional licensure or registration in good standing with the California Board of Behavioral Sciences (BBS).
  • Attend required individual, triadic, group, and/or clinical supervision sessions.
  • Participate in required agency, county, state, and external training activities.
  • Complete a minimum of twenty (20) hours of continuing education and professional development annually.
  • Maintain professional and ethical standards of conduct.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Sr. AV Engineer
description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

Zipline is looking for a Senior AV Engineer to define and deliver the technical vision for our workplace audiovisual environment. You will own how AV systems are designed, standardized, operated, and maintained across large event spaces, conference rooms, and office displays.

This is a hands-on technical role with responsibility for both the employee experience today and the architecture that supports our growth. You will build reliable systems, establish clear technology standards, and create an operating model that makes AV easier to use, monitor, support, and scale.

What You'll Do

Define the technical vision and standards

  • Assess our current AV environment and develop a roadmap for reliability, usability, standardization, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish standards for conference rooms, large event spaces, and office displays, including approved equipment, system designs, control interfaces, and acceptance criteria.
  • Translate business needs into technical designs, investment priorities, and practical implementation plans.
  • Evaluate new technologies through testing and pilots, balancing employee experience, maintainability, cost, and long-term support.

Own large event spaces and all-hands experiences

  • Engineer, maintain, and improve the systems supporting company all-hands, leadership presentations, and other high-visibility events.
  • Own the technical readiness of audio, microphones, cameras, video switching, presentation playback, streaming, recording, and room controls.
  • Deliver a strong experience for both in-person and remote participants, including clear speech, reliable presentation sharing, and effective audience participation.
  • Establish rehearsal procedures, event checklists, backup plans, and support coverage; provide hands-on technical leadership during major events.
  • Identify recurring issues and turn event learnings into lasting system improvements.

Deliver consistent conference-room experiences

  • Own conference-room AV design, integration, commissioning, and ongoing performance.
  • Create intuitive, repeatable experiences for joining meetings, sharing content, and collaborating with remote teams.
  • Serve as the technical escalation point for complex issues across audio, video, conferencing platforms, control systems, and network connectivity.
  • Partner with IT support to develop troubleshooting guides, training, and clear escalation paths.

Manage office displays and content distribution

  • Own the technical platform for digital signage and content distribution throughout the office.
  • Establish reliable processes for display provisioning, content scheduling, publishing permissions, playback, and device health monitoring.
  • Partner with internal communications and workplace teams to enable timely, consistent content delivery.
  • Standardize displays, players, configurations, and support procedures across spaces.

Build a sustainable AV service

  • Establish centralized monitoring, preventive maintenance, asset inventory, configuration backups, controlled updates, and recovery procedures.
  • Maintain accurate system diagrams, signal flows, equipment inventories, configuration files, and operating documentation.
  • Partner with networking and security teams on secure, reliable AV connectivity and remote management.
  • Lead integrators and vendors through design review, installation, commissioning, documentation, and handoff.
  • Ensure internal teams retain access to system designs, source files, configurations, and the knowledge needed to support the environment.
  • Define and track measures of service quality, including room availability, event readiness, recurring incidents, and resolution time.

What You'll Bring

  • Substantial experience engineering and supporting enterprise AV environments, with demonstrated ownership of complex deployments and ongoing operations.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with enterprise AV platforms such as QSC/Q-SYS, Biamp Tesira, Crestron, Extron, or comparable systems used in large meeting and event spaces.
  • Strong capabilities in DSP configuration, signal routing, control logic, user interfaces, commissioning, and troubleshooting across enterprise AV systems.
  • Strong audio fundamentals, including gain structure, acoustic echo cancellation, microphone selection and placement, wireless microphone coordination, loudspeaker systems, and system tuning.
  • Experience with video distribution, switching, cameras, presentation systems, streaming, and recording.
  • Working knowledge of AV networking, including networked audio and video, VLANs, multicast, QoS, and coordination with enterprise networking teams.
  • Experience integrating conferencing platforms, room peripherals, and control systems into a dependable user experience.
  • A track record of establishing technical standards, managing vendors, and taking systems from requirements through operational handoff.
  • The ability to troubleshoot calmly during live events and communicate clearly with presenters, employees, technical teams, and leadership.
  • Sound judgment about when to customize a solution and when to adopt a repeatable standard.

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep, hands-on expertise deploying and supporting QSC systems in large meeting and event spaces.
  • Strong Q-SYS capabilities, including Q-SYS Designer, Core processors, DSP configuration, signal routing, control logic, user interfaces, commissioning, and troubleshooting.
  • Relevant Q-SYS training or certifications, supported by practical deployment experience.
  • Experience with Lua scripting, APIs, and third-party device integration.
  • Experience administering enterprise digital signage or content-management platforms.
  • Experience developing AV standards across multiple locations.
  • AVIXA CTS, CTS-D, CTS-I, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

What success looks like

  • A clear, prioritized AV roadmap guides technology decisions and investment.
  • All-hands and major events are supported by documented, tested systems and repeatable operating procedures.
  • Conference rooms provide a consistent experience employees can use confidently.
  • Office content is easy for authorized teams to publish and reliable for employees to view.
  • AV systems are documented, monitored, maintainable, and supported by clear ownership.
  • New spaces follow established standards, reducing unnecessary variation and recurring support issues.

What Else You Need To Know

The starting cash range for this role is $150,00 - $180,000; please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. We are always open to negotiation. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; overtime pay; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more.

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

Voluntary Self-Identification

For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.

As set forth in Zipline ’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

title: Clinical Program Manager
description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

This is a unique opportunity for a Clinical Operations Professional. As a Clinical Program Manager (CPM), you will be responsible for acting as a central contact for the Clinical Study Team(s) and assist with the execution and management of Revolution Medicines (RevMed) clinical trials.

  • Adhere to Clinical Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) Guidelines.

  • Be a team leader, providing guidance and oversight for the successful management of all aspects of clinical trials within timelines and designated program budgets.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to manage, adjust, and revise project timelines and budgets as needed.

  • Analyze data health metrics to be shared with stakeholders.

  • Actively partner with cross-functional teams and vendors to drive the query resolution and data listings review process to meet objectives in a timely and efficient process.

  • Conduct risk management, contingency, and scenario planning.

  • Supervise, communicate project status/issues, and problem solve to ensure project team goals are met.

  • Participate in the development of all study-related documentation, including study protocols.

  • Actively contributes in the selection and management of contract research organizations (CROs) and/or vendors, including development of requests for proposals (RFPs).

  • Use all available tools to track, oversee, and communicate on program status to all key stakeholders.

  • Participate in other Clinical Operations activities as appropriate.

  • Leads a larger, more complex trial with some oversight from senior members of Clinical Operations.

  • With minimal support, lead cross-functional Clinical Study Execution Team (CSETs).

  • Participate in and contribute to SOP development, implementation, and training.

  • Support junior team members through mentorship.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • RN or Bachelor’s or Masters degree in biological sciences or health-related field required.

  • 8+ years direct Clinical Operations experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, preferably in Clinical Operations or Clinical Research-related experience. Relevant indirect experiences may also meet the requirement.

  • Minimum of 4 years of cross-functional study management or related leadership experience in life sciences, including multiple years’ experience managing project teams.

  • Strong working knowledge of FDA Regulations, ICH Guidelines, and GCP.

  • Proven ability to successfully start-up, manage, and close-out clinical trials, including authoring clinical study and regulatory documentation and SOPs.

  • Experience in selection of CROs/vendors and management of external resources.

  • Thrives in a collaborative team setting that demonstrates flexibility required to maintain a fast pace and is driven by a desire to deploy innovative approaches and technologies in a high-energy environment.

  • Be solution-oriented by anticipating obstacles and difficulties, and proactively providing risk assessment and mitigation strategies to achieve project goals.

  • Excellent written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

  • High sense of priority and commitment to excellence in the successful execution of deliverables.

  • Ability to analyze operational data, contribute with a mind on quality, timeliness and fiscal responsibility, make and drive decisions, multi-task, prioritize tasks, anticipate challenges, and execute on goals as a member of an interdisciplinary team.

  • Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint); MS Project and/or Smartsheet a plus.

  • Travel may be required (~25%).

Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity working with vendor systems/portals (e.g., eTMF, EDC, IRT, CTMS).

  • Oncology experience, early and/or late stage, strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge and/or familiarity with Ex-US region(s) clinical trial operations.

  • Some experience mentoring jr staff.

title: Sr IT Analyst - SAP S/4 HANA PP/QM Functional Consultant
description:
As an SAP Production Planning consultant specializing in S/4 HANA, you will be responsible for providing expertise in configuring, implementing, and optimizing the Production Planning, Execution and Quality Management modules within SAP S/4 HANA. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into effective solutions within the SAP ecosystem. Your role will involve configuring and customizing SAP systems, conducting Design and solution workshops, providing guidance on best practices, and executing project tasks for successful delivery of projects.

You will report to the Sr IT Manager and work out of our Charlotte, NC or Atlanta, GA location on a hybrid basis. Note: for the first 90 days, new hires must be prepared to work 100% onsite M-F.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Requirements Gathering: Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their Production Planning, Production Execution and Quality management processes (collectively referred as SAP PP and QM), challenges, and requirements.
  • Solution Design: Design SAP S/4 HANA solutions for SAP PP and QM processes, considering industry best practices and business needs.
  • Configuration and Customization: Configure and customize SAP PP & QM modules according to business requirements, including MRP Live, ePPDS, Order types and related processes.
  • Integration: Collaborate with integration teams to ensure seamless integration between SAP PP/QM and other systems.
  • Testing: Develop and execute test scripts to ensure the configured solutions meet business requirements and perform as expected.
  • Training and Documentation: Provide training to end-users on new processes and functionalities. Create documentation including user manuals, configuration guides, and training materials.
  • Support and Maintenance: Provide ongoing support and maintenance for SAP PP & QM solutions, including troubleshooting issues, applying patches, and implementing enhancements.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvement and optimization within SAP PP & QM, leveraging new features and functionalities of SAP S/4 HANA.
  • Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with business stakeholders, project managers, developers, and other consultants to ensure successful project delivery.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of experience as an SAP consultant specializing in SAP PP and QM, with a focus on SAP S/4 HANA.
  • In-depth knowledge of SAP Production Planning and Quality modules, including configuration, customization, and integration.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4 HANA implementation projects, including full lifecycle implementations and system conversions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into SAP solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.

WE VALUE

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • SAP S4 PP Certification
  • Knowledge in SAP MRP Live and ePPDS

title: Lead PFS Medical Billing Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead PFS Medical Billing Specialist based in United States.

This role provides senior-level leadership and subject matter expertise within the patient financial services and medical billing function. You will help ensure accurate, compliant, and timely claim submission while supporting complex account resolution and payer-related issues. The position combines hands-on billing expertise with mentoring, training, quality oversight, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration. You will serve as a key escalation point for complex billing questions, claim errors, rejections, and compliance concerns. The role also contributes to departmental initiatives, audits, reporting, onboarding, and continuous improvement across revenue cycle operations. It is well suited to an experienced healthcare billing professional who can work independently while helping teams maintain high standards of quality, productivity, and compliance.

Accountabilities

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and first-level escalation resource for complex medical billing questions, account issues, claim errors, rejections, and caregiver concerns.

  • Accurately prepare and submit claims while ensuring compliance with payer requirements, applicable regulations, and timely filing deadlines.

  • Research payer policies, contracts, guidelines, and complex claim issues, and communicate relevant updates to billing teams and leadership.

  • Analyze complex billing discrepancies and account issues, identify root causes, develop solution proposals, and escalate recurring trends appropriately.

  • Work closely with revenue cycle departments, provider representatives, departmental leaders, and payer representatives to resolve billing, reimbursement, compliance, and account issues.

  • Act as a proxy for the department manager when needed and provide quality reviews, workflow oversight, and mentoring for Medical Billing Specialist I and II team members.

  • Coordinate and support productivity and quality programs, payer meetings, PFS initiatives, staff training, educational sessions, and departmental projects.

  • Design, develop, and implement onboarding programs for new caregivers as well as ongoing training and education for existing staff.

  • Create and maintain process, workflow, and training documentation to support consistent execution and continuous learning.

  • Assist departmental leadership in establishing, implementing, and verifying controls that promote accurate billing and appropriate reimbursement practices.

  • Ensure month-end reconciliation reports are completed accurately and assist with departmental reporting, audits, special projects, and analysis as needed.

  • Collaborate with management to map existing processes, identify improvement opportunities, implement changes, and support development plans designed to improve departmental standards and workflows.

  • Attend or lead appropriate PFS meetings, capture follow-up actions, and coordinate with leadership and relevant stakeholders to drive timely resolution.

  • Maintain effective internal and external relationships across PFS, hospital, clinic, revenue cycle, and provider teams to support operational initiatives.

  • Monitor compliance with state and federal requirements and escalate suspected compliance issues to departmental leadership.

  • Promote a dependable, collaborative, and energetic approach to production, attendance, training, problem solving, and team activities.

    • Requirements:

    • Have a high school diploma or equivalent; an associate degree is preferred.

    • Bring approximately 4 years of non-clinical healthcare experience, preferably within revenue cycle, medical billing, or patient financial services.

    • Demonstrate strong knowledge of hospital and professional billing practices, payer guidelines, reimbursement requirements, and relevant regulatory standards.

    • Have substantial experience researching and resolving complex billing questions, claim discrepancies, errors, and rejections.

    • Understand payer policies and contracts and be able to translate changes and requirements into practical guidance for billing teams.

    • Demonstrate experience with claims processing, timely filing requirements, account resolution, reconciliation, and compliant billing practices.

    • Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, determine root causes, and recommend effective solutions.

    • Be comfortable working across multiple revenue cycle functions and collaborating with internal departments, provider representatives, payer contacts, and leadership.

    • Demonstrate strong communication and mentoring skills, with the ability to train colleagues, facilitate educational sessions, provide constructive guidance, and support onboarding.

    • Have the organizational skills required to manage projects, documentation, follow-up actions, training activities, and multiple priorities.

    • Demonstrate a high degree of ownership, dependability, attention to detail, and commitment to quality.

    • Previous leadership experience is highly preferred, particularly experience mentoring billing teams or coordinating departmental initiatives.

    • Be comfortable working within established compliance controls, processes, systems, and healthcare revenue cycle environments.

    • Be able to work independently while escalating issues appropriately and maintaining effective communication with managers and cross-functional stakeholders.

    • Be available for a full-time Monday-to-Friday schedule with approximately 40 hours per week.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work for candidates residing in eligible states: Alabama, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Minnesota, Missouri, Mississippi, Nebraska, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Texas, Utah, or Virginia.

      • Full-time Monday-to-Friday schedule with 40 working hours per week.

      • Opportunity to take on a senior, lead-level role within patient financial services and medical billing.

      • Leadership and mentoring responsibilities across medical billing teams.

      • Exposure to complex healthcare revenue cycle operations, payer relationships, compliance, audits, and process improvement initiatives.

      • Opportunities to lead training, onboarding, PFS projects, and continuous improvement efforts.

      • Access to a broad employee benefits and wellness offering, including concierge services, wellness programs, employee resources, and health clinic services.

      • Opportunity to contribute to healthcare operations focused on accurate, timely, and compliant patient financial services.

    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 계약직으로 수습기간 12 주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: EL1 Senior Siebel Designer Systems Analysts
description:
Australian Citizens residing in Australia only respond.

Job details

Systems Analyst – Siebel designer provides specialised business and systems analysis services to support the delivery, enhancement and ongoing operation of critical aged care digital services. The role work collaboratively with business, policy, project and technical stakeholders to analyse requirements, develop fit-for-purpose solution designs and support the successful delivery of system enhancements, releases and operational improvements across the Siebel CRM platform and related systems.

Systems Analyst – Siebel designer is responsible for delivering business and systems analysis, functional design and solution support services for the organisation's Siebel CRM platform and associated integrated systems. The role works closely with business, policy, project, technical and external stakeholders to understand business requirements, analyse impacts, and develop fit-for-purpose solutions that support the delivery and ongoing improvement of critical aged care digital services.

Operating within a complex ICT environment, the Siebel Analyst contributes across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, functional design, build support, test support, implementation and post-release activities. The role supports both project delivery and operational sustainment, ensuring system stability while enabling enhancements, regulatory changes and reform initiatives.

The position requires strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, a sound understanding of Siebel CRM and associated business processes, and the ability to manage dependencies across interconnected applications and technology platforms. Through effective stakeholder engagement and collaboration, the Siebel Analyst helps ensure technology solutions are aligned with business objectives and deliver positive outcomes for users and customers.

Key duties and responsibilities

The Systems Analyst – Siebel Designer will be responsible for:

  • Partnering with business analysts and other staff at all levels within the department and external agencies to determine business requirements
  • Negotiation of scope within technical and resourcing limitations
  • Planning and facilitating workshops with business and external stakeholders to clarify requirements and present design solutions
  • Working closely with architects, UX designers, product design assurance and developers to ensure solution and functional designs are feasible and follow established patterns and standards
  • Developing & documenting detailed functional design specifications, user stories, mock-ups, diagrams and other design artefacts
  • (Peer) reviewing colleagues' design deliverables, and confidence checks of built functionality
  • Providing advice on the relative risks of project-related activities
  • Coordinating the implementation of solution designs with relevant stakeholders
  • Analysing and resolving design issues raised during development and post go-live
  • Transferring skills and knowledge to departmental officers

To be an effective ACG systems analyst-designer working in a multi-disciplinary team, the candidate:

  • is required to have:
    • Minimum SFIA Level 4
    • Tertiary qualification or equivalent experience in ICT
    • 3-5+ years' experience in IT systems analysis and design
    • Prior experience working in the Australian Government, on large and complex IT systems
  • should:
    • demonstrate 5 + years of recent experience with Siebel CRM in any role, and
    • demonstrate at least 2 years recently working as a Siebel Analyst-Designer.
    • Extensive experience as a Siebel CRM designer, developer, or tester

The specified personnel may be redirected to assist or work on other projects/activities outside of the branch of initial assignment

title: Shopify Technical Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Shopify Technical Lead based in United States.

This is a senior technical leadership role focused on defining, building, and scaling high-performing Shopify experiences for leading brands. You will combine hands-on Shopify engineering expertise with team leadership and strategic eCommerce consulting. The role spans themes, custom applications, APIs, integrations, technical architecture, performance, security, and delivery standards. You will also act as a trusted advisor to clients, connecting technical decisions to business outcomes such as conversion, revenue, retention, and customer experience. Beyond technical delivery, you will contribute to eCommerce roadmaps, strategic workshops, product ownership, and pre-sales activities. The position offers the opportunity to shape technical practices, mentor developers, and help drive the adoption of AI-enabled development workflows.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the delivery of scalable, secure, maintainable, and high-performing Shopify solutions, including themes, custom applications, integrations, and API-driven experiences.

  • Remain hands-on with Shopify development across Liquid, Online Store 2.0, custom app development, Shopify APIs, integrations, and third-party services.

  • Establish and champion technical standards covering code quality, security, performance, documentation, maintainability, and delivery readiness.

  • Mentor and coach developers through pairing, code reviews, feedback, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance while encouraging team autonomy and reducing knowledge silos.

  • Guide technical direction, estimation, release planning, risk management, and delivery readiness in collaboration with Architects and Project Managers.

  • Lead the adoption of AI coding agents and emerging development technologies by establishing appropriate workflows, guardrails, and quality controls.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to clients, helping them make informed decisions about their Shopify platforms, integrations, and broader eCommerce ecosystems.

  • Contribute to eCommerce strategies and roadmaps using business objectives, data, research, competitive insights, and Shopify best practices.

  • Advise clients on platform capabilities, technical trade-offs, integrations, and technologies across the broader eCommerce ecosystem, including PIM, DAM, ERP, CDP, and martech solutions.

  • Lead or contribute to client workshops, discovery sessions, proposals, and pre-sales activities by providing technical and strategic expertise.

  • Connect technical recommendations and solutions to measurable business outcomes, including conversion, revenue, average order value, retention, and customer experience.

  • Translate business requirements into clear user stories and support backlog management when a dedicated Product Owner is unavailable or requires assistance.

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with Product Owners and Project Managers to maintain alignment between business objectives and technical execution.

  • Help prioritize competing client needs, technical constraints, platform capabilities, and eCommerce opportunities to keep projects progressing effectively.

    • Requirements:

    • Have 7+ years of software development experience, including significant hands-on experience building and scaling Shopify or comparable eCommerce solutions.

    • Demonstrate deep expertise in Shopify, Liquid, Online Store 2.0, Shopify APIs including Admin API, Storefront API, and Shopify Functions, as well as custom app development and integrations.

    • Have Shopify Plus experience as a strong asset.

    • Demonstrate proven experience leading, mentoring, or supervising software developers while remaining capable of contributing technically without becoming the team's sole technical contributor.

    • Have a strong understanding of eCommerce strategy, data-driven decision-making, KPI development, conversion optimization, customer experience, and digital roadmaps.

    • Possess excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to advise both technical and business stakeholders and lead strategic client workshops.

    • Be comfortable with Product Owner practices including requirements gathering, user stories, backlog management, prioritization, and Agile delivery.

    • Have working knowledge of eCommerce ecosystem technologies such as PIM, DAM, ERP, CDP, search and merchandising, and review platforms.

    • Have fluent spoken and written English; French proficiency is an asset.

    • Have hands-on experience with AI coding agents and agentic development workflows, or demonstrate the ability and willingness to rapidly adopt emerging AI technologies.

    • Demonstrate strong analytical skills, sound judgment, autonomy, organization, and prioritization abilities.

    • Have experience working in an agency or client-services environment as a strong asset.

    • Have experience working within Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

    • Have experience with additional eCommerce platforms such as BigCommerce or Adobe Commerce, or headless CMS platforms such as Contentful, Sanity, or Storyblok, as an asset.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time employment.

      • 100% remote work option.

      • Flexible work environment designed to support work-life balance.

      • Group health insurance partially paid by the employer for employees and their families.

      • Vacation time and personal days.

      • Disconnect-from-work policy supporting healthy boundaries between work and personal time.

      • Opportunities to work with established North American brands on high-impact digital commerce projects.

      • Collaboration with leading technology partners and recognized digital industry professionals.

      • Opportunity to work alongside more than 100 specialists across strategy, design, technology, data, and eCommerce.

      • Opportunity to influence technical practices, ways of working, and organizational direction.

      • Access to training and professional certification opportunities.

      • Exposure to Shopify, modern eCommerce technologies, AI-enabled development, and complex digital transformation projects.

description:
Pay Range: $18.00/hr.

Job Posting Closing on: Wednesday, October 21, 2026 📅

The City of Fort Worth is one of the fastest-growing large cities in the U.S. Our employees serve the needs of over 1,000,000 residents, promoting our values of exceptional customer experience, mutual respect, embracing our diversity, continuous improvement, ethical behavior, and accountability. 🌆

The Fort Worth City Attorney’s Office is a collegial team of legal professionals providing excellent legal service to the City of Fort Worth. As an in-house legal department, we practice in a wide range of civil and criminal law on behalf of and for the City, including general counsel, litigation, and prosecutorial areas. Local government is the form of government that is closest to the people, and working for a well-managed city like Fort Worth gives meaning and purpose as you see the direct and positive impact your work has on improving the community

A Legislative Intern position is available with the City of Fort Worth City Attorney's Office to provide on-site administrative, logistical, and legislative support to the City's Governmental Affairs Liaison during the 90th Texas Legislative Session in Austin. This temporary assignment is anticipated to run from January 3, 2027 through May 31, 2027, with the possibility of extension based on City needs if a special session is called. The intern will work in a fast-paced environment where schedules and priorities may change quickly based on legislative activity.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current or recently graduated within the last six (6) months of application or working towards a specialization in a vocational field, or a Bachelor’s, Master’s or Doctorate’s degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in a related field of study
  • No previous work experience is required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Coursework or demonstrated interest in government, political science, public administration, public policy, law, business, communications, or a related field
  • Familiarity with the Texas legislative process, municipal government, or public policy
  • Experience coordinating calendars, meetings, or events and managing multiple time-sensitive priorities
  • Strong written and verbal communication, organization, attention to detail, and ability to work professionally with elected officials, legislative staff, stakeholders, and City employees
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and experience organizing information in spreadsheets, databases, or similar tracking tools

The Legislative Intern - job responsibilities include:

  • Provides day-to-day administrative and logistical support to the Governmental Affairs Liaison, including coordinating assignments, deadlines, materials, and general office needs
  • Serves as a legal and legislative runner as needed, delivering and retrieving time-sensitive documents and materials between City representatives, legislative offices, committee rooms, and other Austin locations
  • Monitors legislative calendars, committee hearing notices, and other Capitol activity and communicates relevant schedule changes and updates
  • Assists with tracking municipal-related legislation and policy issues using legislative tracking tools, spreadsheets, and databases; prepares status reports and updates as directed
  • Attends committee hearings, briefings and other legislative proceedings as requested; takes notes and summarizes key information and follow-up items
  • Conducts basic research on proposed legislation and municipal policy issues and assists with preparing background information, briefing materials, contact lists, and shared record
  • Assists with meeting and event logistics, special projects, and other general administrative work as assigned
  • Adheres to assigned work schedule as outlined in Department and City attendance policies and procedures; ensures all behaviors comply with the City's Personnel Rules and Regulations

Working Conditions and Physical Demands

This position is based in Austin, Texas and requires in-person work during the 90th Texas Legislative Session. Work may include frequent walking and standing throughout the Capitol complex and other meeting locations, carrying and delivering documents or materials, and occasional early morning, evening, or irregular hours based on legislative activity. The temporary assignment is anticipated to end May 31, 2027 unless extended based on City needs.

Depending on assignment, positions in this class typically require touching, talking, hearing, seeing, grasping, standing, walking and repetitive motions.

Sedentary Work – Depending on assignment, positions in this class typically exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, a negligible amount of force frequently, and/or or constantly having to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.

Criminal Justice Information Systems (CJIS) Background Check

Applicants for this position must pass a Criminal Justice Information Systems (CJIS) fingerprint-based background check and maintain CJIS eligibility. Due to CJIS requirements related to system access, the following will result in being disqualified for this position: Felony Convictions, Felony Deferred Adjudication, Class A Misdemeanor Conviction, Class B Misdemeanor Convictions in the last 10 years, Class A Misdemeanor Deferred Adjudication, Class B Misdemeanor Deferred Adjudication in the last 10 years, an Open Arrest for Any Criminal Offense (Felony or Misdemeanor), and ALL Family Violence Convictions regardless of class.

Apply Now! Come be part of something special in Fort Worth. 🌟

Conditions of Employment

The City of Fort Worth is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. It is the policy and practice of the City to recruit, hire, train and promote a diverse workforce without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, parental status, military service, or another non-merit factor.

The City of Fort Worth is committed to full compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to participate in the job application or interview process and to perform essential job functions.

Candidates who do not meet the Education requirement, may be considered if they have more relevant work experience than the position requires. Those selected for employment will be required to pass Pre-Employment checks depending on the position requirements. Those could include, but are not limited to: criminal background check, drug screen, education verification, etc. criminal convictions will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Employees are paid by direct deposit only.

title: Head of Product
description:
BrightHire is a category-creating, high-growth, Series B software company with a mission to give everyone the hiring experience they deserve.

We deliver on this mission by transforming the way many of the world’s leading companies build exceptional teams. We created the Interview Intelligence category, and our clients include some of the world’s most innovative companies—Canva, OpenAI, Ramp, Hubspot—up to the Fortune 500.

BrightHire is building a leading AI-native hiring platform.

We created the Interview Intelligence category by applying conversation intelligence to how companies evaluate and hire talent. Today, hundreds of organizations—from Ramp and Canva to SAP and HCA Healthcare —use BrightHire to make better hiring decisions, improve interviewer performance, and deliver stronger candidate experiences.

BrightHire is now part of Zoom and operates as a stand-alone business unit. This gives us a rare combination of startup velocity and global scale. We are growing more than 100% year over year, with significant opportunities to accelerate through Zoom’s technology, distribution, customer relationships, and broader platform.

We currently have two rapidly growing products:

  • BrightHire Interview: Conversation intelligence for human-led interviews.
  • BrightHire Screen: An AI interviewer for structured candidate screening at scale.

This is only the beginning. Our ambition is to become one of the three most consequential hiring platforms in the world.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an exceptional Head of Product to lead BrightHire’s next chapter.

You will be our senior-most product leader, responsible for helping determine where we play, how we win, and how we translate our ambition into products that create meaningful customer and business impact.

You will rapidly build context across our customers, products, technology, market, competitive landscape, and commercial model. From that context, you will develop a clear point of view about the opportunities that matter most and translate it into a focused set of high-conviction product investments.

You will lead product across BrightHire Interview, BrightHire Screen, and future products. This will require difficult decisions about how to balance products with strong existing momentum, platform investments, and entirely new opportunities created by advances in AI.

A critical part of the role is bringing leverage to the CEO, Head of Engineering, and broader leadership team. You will bring clear recommendations, articulate the underlying reasoning and trade-offs, and help the organization make better and faster decisions about where to focus its resources.

You will also ensure that strategy translates into excellent execution. You will stay close to customers, active product work, roadmap decisions, product reviews, launches, and adoption—helping teams resolve ambiguity, raise product quality, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

You will work across Zoom to identify R&D, platform, go-to-market, and distribution synergies that can create differentiation and growth at a scale BrightHire could not achieve independently.

The goal is not to build a large product organization for its own sake. It is to build an exceptional product and business. The right candidate is motivated by customer impact, product quality, strategic advantage, and growth—not team size or span of control.

What You’ll Do

Define how BrightHire wins

  • Rapidly develop a deep understanding of our customers, products, market, technology, economics, and competitive position.
  • Develop a clear perspective on strategy – where BrightHire should play and how we can win.
  • Translate our strategy into a focused sequence of product investments.
  • Bring the CEO and leadership team clear points of view, recommendations, and trade-offs.
  • Continually reassess our assumptions and priorities as the market and technology evolves.

Lead a multi-product portfolio

  • Partner with the CEO and Head of Engineering on strategy, roadmap, resourcing, execution, launches, adoption, and business impact.
  • Allocate resources across BrightHire’s current products, platform capabilities, and new bets.
  • Ensure our largest initiatives have a clear customer, value proposition, competitive position, success measures, and path to meaningful impact.
  • Create the product and platform foundations required to expand BrightHire into a broader AI-native hiring platform.

Turn strategy into exceptional products

  • Translate strategic priorities into clear roadmaps, ownership, resource allocation, and execution.
  • Create a lightweight operating model that drives speed and quality.
  • Hold a high bar for product value, usability, reliability, and trust.
  • Stay close to workstreams to identify risks, resolve ambiguity, and maintain momentum.
  • Ensure products move successfully from insight and concept through launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.

Build AI-native products

  • Identify opportunities that become possible as model capabilities improve.
  • Apply your experience building great AI products – prototyping, evaluations, reliability, trust, product economics, and continuous improvement.
  • Balance rapid innovation with the transparency, quality, and trust required for enterprise adoption.
  • Personally use and experiment with modern AI tools and workflows.

Turn product into growth

  • Connect roadmap decisions to adoption, retention, and revenue.
  • Partner with sales, marketing, and CS to translate product investments into revenue.
  • Participate in customer and prospect conversations and use them to sharpen product strategy.
  • Shape positioning, launches, enablement, adoption, and competitive narratives.
  • Identify opportunities to use Zoom’s tech, relationships, and distribution to accelerate growth.

Raise the bar across product

  • Be an insightful, high-leverage resource to product managers and designers, helping them sharpen their thinking, make better decisions, and produce stronger work.
  • Raise the quality of product strategy, judgment, craft, and execution across the team.
  • Build a culture of intellectual honesty, customer obsession, speed, and accountability.

What We’re Looking For

Strategic judgment

  • You quickly understand complex customers, markets, products, and technologies.
  • You identify what matters most and turn incomplete information into clear recommendations and trade-offs.
  • You can focus an organization around a few high-conviction product bets.

Commercial instincts

  • You connect product decisions to adoption, retention, revenue, and competitive advantage.
  • You are strong with customers and prospects and can distinguish broad market demand from isolated requests.
  • You understand how to build scalable enterprise products.

Product leadership

  • You have led significant products from strategy through launch, adoption, and measurable impact.
  • You have made difficult prioritization and resource-allocation decisions across multiple products or workstreams.
  • You raise the judgment, product craft, and effectiveness of PMs and designers.

AI product experience

  • You have successfully shipped AI-first products.
  • You understand model capabilities, evaluations, reliability, trust, economics, and customer value.
  • You actively use modern AI tools and stay close to advances in the field.

Execution excellence

  • You translate strategy into focused, high-quality execution without unnecessary process.
  • You stay close to the details that matter, resolve ambiguity, and maintain momentum.
  • You are decisive, dependable, and consistently raise the quality of the work.

Experience in recruiting technology or an adjacent hiring category is strongly preferred, but not required.

How You Operate

Hands-on: You want to build, not simply supervise. You stay close to customers, product experiences, and the work of the team while focusing your own time on the decisions and interventions that create the most leverage.

Positive and energizing: You bring urgency, optimism, and an attitude that raises the performance of the people around you.

Highly collaborative: You bring clear opinions without ego, engage constructively in disagreement, and earn trust through judgment and follow-through.

Passionate about hiring: You believe hiring is an important and underserved problem and are motivated to improve it for companies and candidates.

Competitive: You study the market, care deeply about pace, and want to build the product that defines the category—not merely participates in it.

*Note to Recruiters and Placement Agencies: We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our website. We will not pay fees to any third party agency or firm and will not be responsible for any agency fees associated with unsolicited resumes. Unsolicited resumes received will be considered our property.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in Germany.

This is a senior individual-contributor role embedded directly within a product squad working on complex, high-risk technology domains.
You’ll act as the squad’s technical authority on quality, shaping test strategy, automation, performance, and integration practices.
The role goes beyond test execution, giving you ownership of architecture, quality gates, and the most challenging testing problems.
You’ll work closely with engineering and product teams from the earliest stages, challenging ambiguity before development begins.
You’ll also contribute to broader QA standards, mentor engineers, and lead initiatives that improve testing across the wider organization.
The environment values technical depth, autonomy, continuous improvement, and practical use of modern AI-assisted QA tooling.
It’s an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on reliable, high-scale financial technology as a senior technical leader without moving into management.

Accountabilities

  • Embed fully within an engineering squad, participating in sprint planning, daily standups, reviews, retrospectives, and other ceremonies as a core technical contributor.

  • Define and refine acceptance criteria with Product Owners, identifying ambiguity and quality risks before implementation begins.

  • Own the squad’s test architecture and strategy, determining how unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing work together and identifying coverage gaps.

  • Lead performance and load testing, establishing baselines, evaluating throughput and concurrency limits, and translating findings into actionable engineering improvements.

  • Own the squad’s Definition of Done and quality gates, serving as a final internal quality check before releases progress to staging or production.

  • Design, maintain, and improve automated test suites that remain reliable, readable, maintainable, and effective within CI environments.

  • Triage complex test failures and distinguish flaky tests from genuine regressions, particularly across high-traffic, high-risk, or highly integrated areas.

  • Mentor QA Engineers within the squad and across the wider QA community, raising standards around automation, test design, and engineering practices.

  • Represent the squad in broader QA initiatives and contribute to chapter-wide standards, tooling decisions, onboarding resources, and testing practices.

  • Take ownership of a strategic QA initiative, such as a contract-testing framework, performance-testing toolkit, testing discipline, or AI-assisted test generation workflow.

  • Actively leverage AI and LLM tooling for test case generation, synthetic data creation, regression triage, documentation, and other areas where automation can accelerate QA work.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of QA engineering experience in a software product environment, with demonstrated ownership of testing strategy for complex technical domains.

    • Strong test automation engineering skills, with the ability to write production-quality tests in Java, Python, or JavaScript and build stable, maintainable suites that run effectively in CI.

    • Deep experience with API testing, including REST APIs, contract testing, integration testing, HTTP semantics, and JSON schema validation.

    • Hands-on experience with performance and load testing, including designing tests, interpreting throughput and concurrency results, identifying bottlenecks, and translating findings into engineering action.

    • Strong experience working in Java-based backend environments, with the ability to understand application architecture, read Java code, and create tests that accurately reflect system behavior.

    • High level of technical autonomy and confidence operating without a dedicated QA manager, with the ability to make sound quality decisions and represent QA practices across teams.

    • Proven ability to mentor other QA engineers, improve engineering standards, and lead through technical expertise rather than formal authority.

    • Experience in fintech, payments, or digital financial services is strongly preferred, particularly where reliability and correctness are critical.

    • Familiarity with contract testing tools such as Pact or equivalent approaches within microservices environments is a strong advantage.

    • Mobile testing experience, particularly Android, using tools such as Espresso or Appium, or structured manual testing supported by regression frameworks, is beneficial.

    • Experience contributing to a QA chapter, guild, community of practice, or internal training program is valued.

    • Familiarity with AI-assisted QA workflows, including LLM-based test generation, regression analysis, and synthetic test data creation, is a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work as a senior technical individual contributor with substantial ownership and influence.

      • Full integration into a product squad, with a direct role in engineering decisions and product delivery rather than functioning as a downstream QA resource.

      • Opportunity to shape testing standards, architecture, tooling, and quality practices beyond your immediate squad.

      • Strong platform for technical leadership and mentoring without requiring a transition into people management.

      • Exposure to complex, high-scale fintech and digital financial services systems where software quality has a direct customer and business impact.

      • Opportunity to lead organization-wide QA initiatives and introduce improved testing disciplines and tooling.

      • Flexible European-based working environment with collaboration across international engineering teams.

      • Opportunity to work with AI-assisted testing and modern QA automation practices as part of an evolving engineering environment.

How Jobgether works:
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

title: Professional Services Embryologist
description:
Are you passionate about the livestock industry and looking for an opportunity that gets you out from behind a desk and into the field? This Professional Services Embryologist plays a key role in helping producers achieve reproductive success through industry-leading embryo transfer and reproductive technologies.

Supporting customers throughout Colorado and the surrounding region, you'll work directly with producers, veterinarians, and fellow team members while building the skills needed for a long-term career in cattle reproduction. Our ideal candidate would be located in Eastern Colorado, Southeastern Wyoming, or Western Nebraska.

This is an opportunity to develop technical expertise, build meaningful relationships with producers, and play a direct role in advancing reproductive success across the cattle industry. If you're looking for a career that combines science, agriculture, travel, and independence, we'd love to hear from you.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support embryo production and transfer activities, including oocyte searching, embryo grading, thawing, and transfer preparation.
  • Travel throughout the region to support producers, veterinarians, and livestock operations.
  • Build strong relationships with customers and serve as a trusted representative of Tras Ova Genetics in the field.
  • Maintain accurate records, manage inventory, and ensure the highest standards of quality and attention to detail.
  • Work independently to coordinate schedules, prioritize responsibilities, and support a growing customer base across the region.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, veterinarians, and producers to deliver exceptional service and reproductive outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • A degree in Animal Science, Veterinary Technology, or a related field.
  • A passion for agriculture, animal reproduction, and supporting livestock producers.
  • Strong communication skills and a customer-focused mindset.
  • The ability to work independently, stay organized, and adapt to changing priorities.
  • A willingness to travel extensively and thrive in a field-based environment.
  • An eye for detail and a commitment to doing things the right way.
  • Experience in cattle reproduction, embryology, veterinary medicine, dairy, beef production, or other livestock-related fields is beneficial but not required.
  • Previous customer service or relationship-building experience is a plus.
  • A positive attitude, strong work ethic, and the determination to solve problems and get things done.
  • The ability to safely perform the physical requirements of the role, including microscope work, lifting equipment and supplies, and working with liquid nitrogen.
