  • And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

title: Senior Claim Specialist - Medical Malpractice
description:
The Senior Medical Malpractice Claim Specialist is responsible for the independent investigation, evaluation, management, negotiation, and resolution of complex and high-severity medical malpractice and healthcare professional liability claims.

The position will manage a diverse portfolio of litigated and non-litigated matters involving hospitals and health systems, long-term care and senior living organizations, physician and medical groups, and allied healthcare professionals and facilities.

This role requires significant medical malpractice claims expertise, strong technical judgment, and the ability to develop and execute effective claim and litigation strategies. The Senior Medical Malpractice Claim Specialist will work closely with clients, insureds, defense counsel, medical experts, brokers, carriers, and other stakeholders to achieve high-quality claim outcomes while delivering exceptional client service.

  • Complex Claims Management
    • Independently manage a portfolio of complex and high-severity medical malpractice and healthcare professional liability claims from initial notice through final resolution.
    • Handle claims involving hospitals and health systems, long-term care and senior living facilities, physician and medical groups, allied healthcare providers, and other healthcare organizations and professionals.
    • Conduct comprehensive claim investigations, including review and analysis of medical records, incident reports, facility documentation, policies and procedures, witness information, pleadings, discovery, depositions, expert reports, and other relevant materials.
    • Evaluate liability, damages, causation, standard of care, venue, jurisdictional considerations, and other factors affecting claim exposure.
    • Identify significant severity drivers, emerging exposures, potential excess or reinsurance implications, and other issues requiring escalation or enhanced oversight.
    • Develop, document, and execute proactive claim strategies designed to achieve timely, appropriate, and cost-effective resolutions.
  • Litigation Management
    • Direct and actively manage defense counsel throughout the litigation process, including development of defense strategy, discovery, depositions, expert selection, dispositive motions, mediation, settlement negotiations, and trial preparation.
    • Partner with defense counsel and medical experts to evaluate standard of care, causation, damages, liability, and potential verdict exposure.
    • Establish clear litigation objectives and ensure defense strategies remain aligned with the interests of the client, insured, and applicable carrier.
    • Monitor defense counsel performance, litigation budgets, legal expenses, and case progression to ensure effective and efficient claim management.
    • Participate in mediations, settlement conferences, strategy meetings, significant depositions, and trials as appropriate.
    • Evaluate litigation developments and adjust claim strategy, reserves, and resolution plans as circumstances change.
  • Claim Evaluation, Reserving & Resolution
    • Establish and maintain timely, accurate, and well-supported reserves based upon comprehensive evaluation of liability, damages, medical issues, venue, litigation posture, and potential outcomes.
    • Prepare clear and persuasive claim evaluations, exposure analyses, reserve recommendations, settlement authority requests, and large-loss reports.
    • Develop and execute negotiation and resolution strategies for complex and high-severity claims.
    • Negotiate settlements within assigned authority and make well-supported recommendations when additional authority is required.
    • Identify appropriate opportunities for early resolution, mediation, alternative dispute resolution, or continued defense.
    • Maintain comprehensive and timely claim documentation supporting key decisions, evaluations, reserves, and strategies.
  • Coverage & Risk Analysis
    • Review and interpret applicable insurance policies, endorsements, coverage provisions, retentions, deductibles, and other contractual requirements.
    • Identify potential coverage issues and coordinate with coverage counsel, carriers, and other stakeholders as appropriate.
    • Recognize and appropriately escalate claims involving excess exposure, reinsurance considerations, aggregation issues, coverage concerns, or other significant risk considerations.
    • Identify trends and recurring loss drivers that may provide meaningful insights to clients, risk management teams, carriers, and other business partners.
  • Client & Stakeholder Management

title: Director of Data Engineering and Analytics
description:
About Us

Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care.

We deliver high-touch, relationship-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care.

We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations.

Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors.

About The Role

We're hiring our first dedicated data leader. You'll build Greenbrook's foundational data layer and data intelligence capabilities. You’ll also build our data team and culture from the ground up.

This is a hands on role. You'll be in the code daily, own what's in production from day one, and build the roadmap from scratch, inclusive of data infrastructure and business logic. You will forecast needs out on the magnitude of quarters and build a team to support delivery.

Success in this role means end to end ownership, from data platform to metric delivery and data team performance. You report to the VP of Growth and Population Health and partner closely with our care teams to improve observability on our care model.

As Greenbrook’s Head of Data & Analytics, you own four things:

  1. The analytics layer: the dbt models and business logic that turn raw data into something usable, and the metric definitions underneath them
  2. Reporting and BI: the reporting layer the whole business reads from, and turning data into findings that our teams can react on to improve performance
  3. Our production systems: you take ownership of systems as they come in-house from our engineering partner, harden them, and keep making them better, with accountability for uptime & system integrity
  4. The data roadmap and team development: You will develop, in partnership with Greenbrook’s functional leaders, a data capabilities roadmap that supports the business. You will translate that roadmap into tactical goals and hiring plans to ensure that the data team is improving observability across all aspects of the business.

Location: New York City strongly preferred (Hybrid). Open to exceptional remote candidates.

What You'll Do

Own the Analytics Layer

  • Build and maintain the dbt models and business logic behind our metrics and workflows in Google Cloud
  • Ensure metric definitions are consistent across every surface at Greenbrook
  • Build the reporting and dashboards the business uses to make decisions

Take Ownership of What's in Production

  • Take on systems as they move from our engineering partner into steady state, and keep improving them.
  • Catch ingestion, pipeline, and logic issues, and resolve them within our SLAs. Build monitoring and uptime reporting.
  • Be the counterpart our engineering partner hands production work to. Resolve what you can and escalate what needs them.

Make the Care Model Better With Data

  • Calculate and report on industry-standard care model measures
  • Turn quality and care-gap logic into triggers and flags inside our clinical workflows, so we act on data during the encounter, not after
  • Sit in the operating meetings where data gets used. Understand the care model well enough to define what we should measure and what good looks like
  • Surface patterns and risks proactively, acting as an early warning system for the business

Build the roadmap and the team

  • Own the end-to-end data roadmap, from data strategy to product delivery and integration. Construct roadmaps on the order of quarters that align with what the business needs
  • Build the data team from scratch. Put together a people roadmap, define sub-competencies based off of our needs, and design levels and competencies
  • Hire and manage data engineers and analysts. Start as a player coach and then hire to supplement skills and ensure delivery against the roadmap

What Success Looks Like

  • Data trust: the business trusts the numbers, and you're ahead of issues rather than behind them
  • Impact: data changes how we deliver care, and our quality measures improve year over year
  • Early warning: leaders hear about emerging problems from you first
  • Coverage: every metric our operating levers depend on has a certified definition and a single source of truth
  • Reliability: systems transitioned to you stay healthy and get fixed fast when they break
  • Scale readiness: new clinics come online with full data coverage from day one
  • Delivery: committed quarterly work ships, and your counterparts, including performance managers and the Head of Population Health, rate the partnership highly

About You

You bring:

  • Strong SQL, dbt, and Python, and you still write production code
  • Hands-on experience with healthcare data, including claims, eligibility, and EHR data and familiarity with interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7
  • Experience with value-based care measurement, such as HEDIS/Stars, HCC/RAF, and utilization
  • The ability to interpret data and explain what it means to clinical and business leaders in plain language
  • Experience owning production systems, including being the person who responds when something breaks
  • Experience building roadmaps, driving alignment on them, and hiring technical talent
  • A bachelor's degree
  • A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork

You'll stand out if you:

  • Have done this at a risk-bearing organization, such as an ACO, MA plan, or at-risk provider, especially where data powered internal clinical software
  • Tie data to workflow: you've moved a quality measure, not just reported on it
  • Challenge the status quo constructively: you'll tell us what's not working and why
  • Get to root cause: you find out why a number is wrong instead of patching the symptom
  • Enjoy both hardening what exists and building what's next
  • Are AI-native: you use modern AI tools in your daily work
  • Drive outcomes: you have a bias for action and close loops without being chased

Why You'll Love Working Here

Make An Impact Every Day

Be part of a mission-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare.

Work That Actually Matters

We're not a volume-driven system, we're accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered.

Build And Grow With Us

We're building more than a company, we're building careers. As we expand, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges.

Strong, Transparent Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary: Remote (U.S.): $160,000–$190,000; New York City: $175,000–$210,000
  • Generous annual performance bonus
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid time off
  • 401(k) with company match

Our Selection Process

Application → Initial interview → Skills/experience interview → Values interview → Case Study and Case Study Interview → References

Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity

At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We do this through a culture of respect and belonging, ensuring our teammates feel cared for first and foremost.

We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

title: RF Antenna Engineer
description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

You will be responsible for the test & measurement of radiofrequency (RF) and microwave electronics to be hosted on some of the largest, most powerful, rapidly designed and rapidly manufactured satellites ever deployed in space. In your first 6 months you will develop the RF test and measurement infrastructure required to integrate and test new RF electronics and antennas for use in software defined radio (SDR) systems for satellite communications and beyond. You will work with a multidisciplinary team of antenna, RF, field programmable gate array (FPGA), digital signal processing (DSP), software, mechanical, and electrical engineers in order to prototype your systems and refine your designs. In your first two years you will have contributed to developing cutting-edge RF systems that will fly in space.

Responsibilities

  • Lead research, design, and procurement of antenna measurement assets such as anechoic chambers and near field scanners
  • Qualify radiofrequency and antenna hardware through environmental testing including vibration, shock, thermal, and thermal vacuum (TVAC) testing
  • Assist with design and validation testing for radiofrequency and microwave hardware from UHF 200 MHz through Ka band 30 GHz, including phased array antennas, low noise amplifiers, power amplifiers, filters, high speed converters, and other RF electronic components
  • Execute development and production tests to meet internal and external customer needs
  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to integrate your designs into the spacecraft system

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer, electrical, aerospace engineering, or other relevant science, technology, or mathematics discipline
  • 2+ years of experience in microwave, RF, or antenna engineering
  • Experience with RF test equipment such as vector network analyzers (VNA), spectrum analyzer, etc.
  • Experience with anechoic chambers and antenna measurement assets such as near field scanners
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and high velocity start-up atmosphere

Nice to Have

  • Experience with environmental testing for space electronics such as thermal, vibration, TVAC, radiation, and EMI/EMC testing per standards such as SMC-S-016
  • Experience with RF systems testing, including antenna characterization and insertion loss tests
  • Experience with antenna and electromagnetic modeling and analysis software tools such as Ansys Electronics Desktop HFSS and Altair FEKO
  • Experience with software defined radio hardware development including high speed RF data converters (digital to analog and analog to digital converters), clock trees, and data converter interfaces

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Base salary range for this role is $110,000 - $170,000 + equity in the company
  • Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”

title: Supply Chain Planning Analyst
description:
As a S4 Supply Chain Planning Analyst here at Honeywell Technologies, you will play a vital role in leveraging data analytics to enhance S4 planning processes. You will analyze supply chain data to provide actionable insights that improve planning accuracy, optimize inventory levels, and support decision-making across the supply chain network.

In this role, your work will provide insights to improve supply chain efficiency, reduce costs, and increase customer satisfaction by ensuring the right products are available at the right time through data-driven supply planning strategies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and maintain SAP S/4HANA reporting solutions supporting supply planning, inventory management, material availability, and planning execution.
  • Design, build, and enhance S/4 reporting dashboards, KPI scorecards, and analytical reports used by planning, operations, and leadership teams.
  • Develop S4 based reporting to support supply planning and execution.
  • Develop and maintain analytics dashboards and reports to support supply planning decision-making.
  • Analyze supply planning data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including procurement, production, and logistics to align supply planning analytics with business objectives.
  • Utilize advanced analytics tools and techniques to optimize supply planning processes.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying automation opportunities and process enhancements.
  • Support roadmap for AI initiatives and implementation.
  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with data quality issues that could lead to MRP failures or supply chain disruptions.
  • Provide ongoing support and training to stakeholders on analytics practices and tools.
  • Monitor and report on data quality metrics, implementing corrective actions as necessary.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • 4+ years of experience in supply chain analytics or supply planning analytics.
  • 2+ years of experience transforming SAP S/4HANA planning data into actionable business insights through SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP Fiori Reporting, Embedded Analytics, CDS Views, and advanced visualization tools.
  • Experience with data visualization tools like Power BI.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • Proven experience in supply chain processes.
  • Strong understanding of MRP systems and data management principles.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of influencing stakeholders at all levels.
  • Knowledge of supply planning processes and inventory management principles.

WE VALUE

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Supply Chain Certifications such as CSCP / CPIM / CPSM / Lean Six Sigma.
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools and programming languages such as Python, R, and SQL.
  • Familiarity with advanced analytics techniques including predictive modeling and machine learning.

BENEFITS FOR WORKING AT HONEYWELL

In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. Learn more (https://benefits.honeywell.com/)

Honeywell Technologies International Inc. invents and commercializes technologies that address some of the world’s most critical challenges around energy, safety, security, air travel, productivity, and global urbanization. title: Senior Data Engineer (Azure, Databricks & Python)
description:
At a glance

Are you a technical expert and enthusiastic person who inspires others to create innovative solutions? Then we need your help, in making ABN AMRO a personal bank in a digital age! How are you going to shape innovation, advancements, and projects within your department? Our employees get the freedom to grow and experiment. You support and guide them, so they can become the technical experts that contribute to a future-proof bank. We work hybrid, which means you and your team can flexibly decide where and when you can work most comfortable and effectively (either working from Home or Office). All-in-all, working at ABN AMRO means that you contribute to projects that matter and impact millions of customers! Are you up for the challenge?

Your job

You will be part of a team specifically focused on future-proof technologies and frameworks to help accelerate the bank’s strategy and initiatives. In this role, you will oversee designing, developing, and implementing ETL frameworks & data pipelines that helps other teams deliver their data to their consumers with the main goal of being efficient and cost effective. You will be responsible for developing and reviewing software solutions that are deployed in the Azure Cloud using a variety of technologies such as: Databricks, Kafka, Airflow etc. You will be part of diverse Agile/Scrum DevOps team and have end-to-end responsibility, for developing, managing, and maintaining functionalities in the Credit Capability Team area.

Working environment

At ABN AMRO, we strive to be a personal bank in a digital age. That strategy is also brought to life in how we work ourselves. Hence, we offer hybrid working as the new normal. This offers you the flexibility to decide when and where can work most comfortably and effectively. Of course, we offer you the right resources you need to set up a good home office. For example, an ergonomic chair, desk, and laptop.

Your profile

You feel at home in a technical environment and are always up to date on the latest technologies. On top you're a good communicator (in English) and you're used to an agile/scrum way of working. Do you think you're a fit? Check your profile and apply if you recognize yourself (partially) in the following required skills:

  • At least 10 years of experience working with Azure.
  • 8+ years of experience with Python and willingness to learn other programming languages.
  • 8+ years of experience with Databricks, Azure Devops.
  • 2+ years of experience with Airflow.
  • Knowledge of change and incident management.

We are offering

We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing.

In addition, we offer:

  • An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowanceand a flexible benefit budget.
  • An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
  • Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
  • Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.
  • Five "Banking for better days": extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work.
  • Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000.
  • An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.

You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy.

Your Future: Inclusive, Innovative, Sustainable

At ABN AMRO, we believe in "Banking for better, for generations to come." Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision ofbeing a personal bank in the digital agealigns perfectly with the demand for surprising insights and innovative solutions, born from a diverse interplay of cultures and experiences. We focus on customer experience, sustainability, and building a future-proof bank, conducting annual reviews to ensure equal pay for equal work. Join a bank that embraces ingenuity and ambition, and make an impact with us for a better future.

If you want to apply for the B-Able or Reboot program, make sure to mention it both in the title and the content of your resume.

Use of AI in our application process

You’re welcome to use AI to help write your CV or cover letter, as long as it reflects your own story. We review every application personally and without AI. During interviews, real time AI tools may not be used. With your permission, interviews can be recorded and supported by AI. This helps us keep the process fair, careful, and transparent.

Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs.

Senior Consultant with experience in Commerce ecosystems and technologies wanted to join our Business Services team

The opportunity:

How consumers discover, evaluate and buy products is changing faster than most organisations can respond. AI-powered search, agentic commerce, generative product discovery and the collapse of the traditional funnel are reshaping commercial models across every sector. Most enterprise clients know something has shifted, few have a clear plan for what to do about it.

WPP Enterprise Solutions is building a commerce consulting practice to help clients navigate these shifts. What makes this role different from a boutique or a SaaS provider is what sits around you: your consulting recommendations connect directly to creative, content, CX and commerce execution teams who bring them to life. Strategy doesn't end at a slide deck here.

We're looking for a Senior Consultant who can own projects and client relationships. Someone who takes an ambiguous brief, structures it independently, drives the strategic direction and ensures the quality of everything the team delivers. You'll lead client conversations, design and facilitate workshops, and be the person mid-to-senior client stakeholders trust to connect diagnostic findings to commercial action. You'll also play a key role in growing the practice, spotting extension opportunities within accounts, contributing to pitches and coaching more junior members of the team.

  • Perm
  • London/Hybrid
  • Travel to client site where required

What you’ll be doing:

Project Leadership & Delivery

title: Solutions Engineer | Contract | Remote USA
description:
About us:

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

The Role:

We are looking for Solutions Engineers for a project-based assignment to support the development and implementation of identity and trust infrastructure for the internet, including emerging AI agent technologies. This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical role that combines deep expertise in DNS, networking, PKI, and agentic AI protocols with solutions architecture, technical consulting, and proof-of-concept development. You will work closely with customers, product, engineering, and business teams to translate technical requirements into practical solutions, demonstrate product capabilities, and support successful customer integrations. The ideal candidate is comfortable leading technical customer conversations, designing solution architectures, and building working prototypes using modern programming languages, REST APIs, and cloud technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the technical lead in customer meetings, discovery calls, workshops, and demos.
  • Speak in depth about DNS (resolution, DNSSEC, zone management, registries and registrars) and how it supports identity and trust.
  • Explain networking fundamentals to technical and non-technical audiences: TCP/IP, TLS, HTTP, routing, load balancing, and CDNs.
  • Advise customers on PKI: certificate lifecycle, certificate authorities, chains of trust, mTLS, and key management.
  • Guide customers on agentic AI protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A), including agent discovery, identity, authentication, and authorization.
  • Design and build proofs of concept (POCs) and prototypes that show how the client's products solve real customer problems.
  • Translate customer requirements into solution architectures, integration plans, and technical documentation.
  • Answer technical questions in RFPs, security reviews, and solution proposals.
  • Share customer feedback with product and engineering to shape the roadmap.
  • Create reusable demos, reference architectures, and enablement content for sales and partner teams.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical consulting, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of DNS, including DNSSEC, record types, resolvers, and authoritative servers.
  • Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, TLS, HTTP/S, and common network architectures.
  • Practical experience with PKI: X.509 certificates, certificate authorities, certificate lifecycle management, and mTLS.
  • Working knowledge of agentic AI and LLM integration, including protocols such as MCP and A2A, and how agents discover, authenticate, and call each other.
  • Proven ability to build POCs quickly using Python, Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar languages, plus REST APIs.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills. You can explain complex topics to engineers and executives alike.
  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience at a domain registry, registrar, DNS provider, certificate authority, or CDN.
  • Familiarity with identity standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, DIDs, or verifiable credentials.
  • Experience building AI agents with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or the OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs.
  • Knowledge of internet governance and standards bodies (IETF, ICANN, W3C).
  • Relevant certifications, such as CCNA/CCNP, CISSP, or a cloud architect certification.

Location:

  • Remote, USA

Employment type:

  • Contract

*Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time

Tech Holding is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, and we consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. title: Knowledge AI Quality Lead
description:
Knowledge AI Quality Lead | Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Who are we looking for?
We are seeking a detail-oriented Knowledge AI QA Lead to monitor, test, and evaluate our AI-driven customer experiences to ensure effortless, accurate, and scalable support for all our customers. This role focuses on the end-to-end quality of the customer support journey - from Self-Service and AI-Assist through to Human-Assist transitions. Ideal for a hands-on quality specialist with strong process validation experience, this role bridges customer feedback with technical tuning to continuously improve response accuracy, system compliance, and overall resolution quality.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 1-2 days per week in our London or Oxford office.

What You’ll Do

  • Quality Framework & Testing: Design and execute QA frameworks, test scripts, and evaluation criteria specifically for AI chatbots, automated workflows, and agent copilot tools.

  • Performance Monitoring: Continuously audit and analyze real-time AI conversations and self-service flows to identify intent misclassifications, hallucinations, inaccurate answers, or broken customer journeys.

  • Closed-Loop Quality Feedback: Identify root causes of AI accuracy failures and customer friction; feed actionable insights directly back to AI Automation Leads, Product, and Engineering teams for sprint training and fine-tuning.

  • Human-Assist QA Integration: Audit the handover from AI to Human-Assist to ensure context retention, CRM integration accuracy, and seamless agent workflow execution.

  • Benchmarking & Accuracy Scoring: Track and report on key QA metrics, including intent recognition accuracy, resolution precision, containment effectiveness, and compliance standards.

  • Data Validation & Testing: Conduct pre-release user acceptance testing (UAT) and regression testing for all new AI prompt deployments, KB updates, and workflow releases.

  • Defect & Gap Analysis: Partner with operational teams to identify recurring knowledge base gaps and out-of-scope customer queries to broaden AI coverage safely.

Skills & Experience

Core Qualifications & Experience:

  • QA or Process Improvement specialist with 2+ years of experience in customer contact-center operations or tech support environments.

  • Hands-on experience in testing or auditing AI conversational flows, chatbots, virtual assistants, or automated workflow tooling.

  • Familiarity with process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) applied to quality control and operational auditing.

  • Strong understanding of AI behavior, intent structures, and natural language understanding (NLU) failure modes.

  • Proven ability to translate operational customer friction into technical feedback for engineering and product teams.

  • Demonstrated experience in data logging, audit reporting, and root-cause defect analysis.

  • Customer-obsessed mindset with meticulous attention to detail and standard-setting for response quality.

Skills you should bring to the role:

  • Communication: Clear written and verbal reporting skills with the ability to articulate quality defects to technical and non-technical stakeholders (required).

  • Analytical Mindset: Exceptional eye for detail with the ability to spot subtle pattern failures in data and conversational logs (required).

  • Data Driven: Comfortable leveraging call/chat logs, accuracy metrics, and A/B test results to validate performance (required).

  • Industry: Experience in a similar role within the Travel Industry (Preferred).

  • Impact-Driven: Motivated by delivering high Traveler Sentiment Scores (TSS) through effortless resolution, protecting brand trust, and ensuring travelers enjoy exceptional experiences.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

title: Bilingual Electoral Canvasser
description:

title: Product Engineer

You will take complex problems from an initial thesis through design, implementation, deployment, and continuous iteration, with broad freedom over how solutions are built.
The role spans the full product and engineering stack, from user interfaces and APIs to data models, background jobs, and AI-powered workflows.
You will work with large-scale, structured insurance data to create intuitive products used by brokers, lenders, underwriters, and other insurance professionals.
AI is deeply embedded in the engineering workflow, and you will be expected to use modern coding agents and AI tooling to increase development speed and leverage.
With no traditional Product Manager or QA layer, Product Engineers are expected to exercise strong product judgment, challenge assumptions, and own outcomes rather than simply execute specifications.
This is an opportunity to join an ambitious, highly empowered environment where your work can have immediate impact on a rapidly evolving financial infrastructure market.

Accountabilities

  • Own product features end to end, from defining scope and identifying dependencies through development, deployment, customer adoption, and iteration.

  • Work across the full technology stack as needed, including user interfaces, APIs, data models, backend services, background jobs, and infrastructure integrations.

  • Develop and improve internal evaluation harnesses where they can outperform or provide greater reliability than direct model calls.

  • Apply strong product judgment to challenge unclear requirements, simplify solutions, prioritize high-value work, and discontinue features that do not deliver sufficient value.

  • Work closely with Product Designers and Infrastructure/Platform specialists to turn ambiguous problems into effective, production-ready experiences.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve the product, engineering workflows, and underlying data systems.

  • Take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for detailed specifications, established processes, or predefined implementation plans.

    • High autonomy and self-direction, with the ability to make meaningful progress without extensive processes or management layers.

title: Operational Technology Systems & Network Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Operational Technology Systems & Network Engineer based in United States.

This is a hands-on engineering role responsible for the networks, servers, cybersecurity, and connectivity that support critical manufacturing operations. You will help maintain reliable and secure OT infrastructure across existing facilities while supporting new plants and remote installations. The role combines industrial networking, systems administration, cybersecurity, troubleshooting, infrastructure standards, and technical project support. You will work closely with Controls Engineering, Operations, corporate IT, vendors, and site teams to keep production-critical systems connected and resilient. The position offers significant ownership of manufacturing infrastructure while partnering with controls specialists who manage PLC programming and SCADA application development. It is well suited to an experienced OT infrastructure professional who enjoys solving complex technical problems in industrial environments.

Accountabilities

  • Design, maintain, and troubleshoot industrial network infrastructure and secure connectivity across manufacturing facilities, corporate systems, and remote installations.

  • Deploy, administer, and maintain OT servers, industrial computers, networking equipment, and infrastructure supporting Ignition, historians, databases, and related services.

  • Establish and manage secure remote access to manufacturing sites for troubleshooting and maintenance while controlling employee and vendor access appropriately.

  • Implement and maintain OT cybersecurity practices, including network segmentation, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and incident-response processes.

  • Maintain infrastructure reliability through system monitoring, coordinated patching, lifecycle planning, and tested backup and recovery procedures.

  • Support industrial communications and manufacturing data connectivity across Allen-Bradley/EtherNet/IP networks, MQTT environments, and cloud services.

  • Establish infrastructure standards, technical documentation, and repeatable practices for OT systems and network deployments.

  • Coordinate with external vendors and internal teams during site deployments, infrastructure projects, maintenance activities, and technical escalations.

  • Serve as a technical escalation point for OT infrastructure issues affecting manufacturing operations.

  • Monitor network performance and identify opportunities to improve reliability, availability, security, and operational effectiveness.

  • Diagnose and resolve connectivity, latency, intermittent communication, and network performance issues affecting production systems.

  • Partner closely with Controls Engineering while maintaining ownership of manufacturing infrastructure and infrastructure-related technical decisions.

  • Support new facility and remote-site deployments, including occasional onsite work and critical issue response outside standard business hours.

    • Requirements:

    • Have 5+ years of relevant experience in networking, systems administration, OT infrastructure, or a related field, including experience supporting industrial environments.

    • Hold an associate or bachelor’s degree in information technology, networking, computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or possess equivalent practical experience.

    • Demonstrate strong knowledge of routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, and Windows Server administration.

    • Have experience supporting infrastructure for PLCs, SCADA systems, and other production-critical industrial technologies.

    • Understand OT network segmentation, industrial cybersecurity, secure remote access, vulnerability management, and backup and recovery practices.

    • Demonstrate strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to diagnose complex infrastructure and connectivity issues efficiently.

    • Possess strong documentation and communication skills and be able to collaborate effectively with Controls Engineering, Operations, IT, vendors, and other stakeholders.

    • Have experience with Allen-Bradley control systems and EtherNet/IP networks as preferred technical experience.

    • Have experience with Ignition, IXON, EWON, Microsoft Azure, MQTT, OPC-UA, and PostgreSQL as preferred qualifications.

    • Be comfortable working independently in a remote environment while taking ownership of critical infrastructure and coordinating with distributed teams.

    • Be willing to travel approximately 10% for site deployments, maintenance, and other operational requirements.

    • Be available for occasional support outside normal business hours when critical infrastructure issues or deployment needs arise.

    • Be able to successfully complete a criminal background check.

    • Be prepared to follow all required safety precautions when performing onsite work.

      • Benefits:

      • Annual salary of $125,000–$140,000.

      • Full-time, exempt position.

      • Fully remote work within the United States.

      • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

      • Optional Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA).

Job Title: Hourly Disabilities Coordinator (Head Start)

Status: Contract. This is a 1099-Consultant position

The Disabilities Coordinator manages the identification, referral, evaluation, and service coordination processes for children enrolled in the Head Start program who have suspected or diagnosed developmental delays or disabilities. This role serves as the primary liaison between the program, families, local school districts, and service providers, with a strong emphasis on navigating the Committee on Preschool Special Education (CPSE) process.

Key Responsibilities

  • CPSE Navigation/Management: Guide families through the Committee on Preschool Special Education (CPSE) process, including referrals, evaluations, Individualized Education Program (IEP) meetings, and transition planning.

  • Service Coordination: Coordinate and track related services (e.g., Speech Therapy, Occupational Therapy, Physical Therapy, Counseling) with service providers to ensure full implementation of each child’s IEP..
  • Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with classroom teachers, family advocates, and specialists to develop classroom accommodations, behavioral strategies, and inclusive practices aligned with Head Start Program Performance Standards.
  • Compliance & Documentation: Maintain accurate, confidential child files; track service delivery minutes; and ensure full compliance with federal Head Start standards, IDEA, and local educational agency mandates.

Qualifications

  • Education & Credentials (Must hold at least ONE of the following):
  • Licensed Master Social Worker (LMSW) or Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)
  • Master of Science in Education (MSEd) in Special Education
  • Experience Requirements:
  • Direct hands-on experience navigating the CPSE process from referral through IEP development and implementation.
  • Proven experience conducting family meetings and explaining complex special education processes in a culturally responsive manner.
  • Skills: Strong knowledge of early childhood development, federal/state special education laws (IDEA), and Head Start Performance Standards; exceptional communication and organizational skills.

title: Mission Operations Engineering Intern – Summer 2027

Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

title: Events & Community Relations Coordinator
description:
Events & Community Relations Coordinator

The Events & Community Relations Coordinator supports Pinkbox Doughnuts and Siegel Cares through event coordination, community outreach, customer engagement, and administrative support. This is a highly visible, customer-facing position that serves as a direct representative of our brands at events, community initiatives, corporate functions, and high-profile activations.

This position actively coordinates and works onsite at Pinkbox Doughnuts and Siegel Cares events, including Doughnut Truck events, Community Table events, Allegiant Stadium/Kiosk events, promotional activations, charitable initiatives, resource events, and community partnerships.

title: Lab and Build Engineer II, Battery Design, Amazon Leo
description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Batteries power that mission, and getting from parts and cells to trustworthy test results takes careful, hands-on work in the lab. We are looking for a Lab Engineer to own that work: set up and maintain the equipment, prepare builds and work orders, and move tests through the lab's processes so the team's cell and pack testing keeps flowing, while steadily making the lab run better.

This is a very hands-on role, and it is also a self-directed one. Requests will often arrive loosely defined: a test that needs running, a build that needs prepping, equipment that is not behaving. You will work out what is actually needed, decide how and in what order to do it, and carry it to completion without being managed task to task. You will set up, maintain, and troubleshoot build process equipment such as ultrasonic wirebonders, epoxy dispense systems, custom fixturing and tooling, thermal chambers, and robot arms. You will manage consumables and parts so work is never blocked, prepare builds and work orders, and run tests through the lab's processes, pulling in engineers when a decision genuinely needs them and escalating early when something is blocked.

We are looking for someone who likes lab work, cares about doing a process the same way every time, and is technical enough to keep equipment running, solve difficult lab problems, and improve how the lab operates. You will manage your own queue against the team's priorities and keep several efforts moving at once. You will handle cells end to end (unpacking, registering, tracking, and measuring them), keep the lab to a high 5S standard, write and improve work instructions and procedures, and drive lab improvements you identify yourself. You will build effective relationships with the cell test, build, and design engineers and with suppliers, and begin to mentor and train new teammates.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Take loosely defined requests from engineers, clarify what is actually needed, and turn them into a concrete plan of lab work you own through completion.
- Prioritize and manage your own queue against team goals, sequence work so builds and tests are not blocked, and keep several efforts moving at once with limited supervision.
- Set up, calibrate, maintain, and troubleshoot build process equipment — ultrasonic wirebonders, epoxy dispense systems, custom fixturing, thermal chambers, robot arms — bringing new equipment online and working problems toward root cause.
- Prepare builds and work orders by kitting parts, staging materials, and readying stations against work instructions and engineering direction; process tests end to end from cell prep through clean, traceable results.
- Spot gaps in how the lab runs, recommend and implement process improvements, maintain 5S standards, contribute to engineering documentation, and begin mentoring new teammates on lab systems and tools.

A day in the life
You might start the day deciding what matters most: a test that needs to start today, a build that needs kitting, or a wirebonder that has been drifting out of spec. You sequence them yourself, stage the build, get the test running, then work the equipment problem toward root cause rather than just resetting it. An engineer stops by with a vague request for a new kind of coupon, and you ask enough questions to turn it into a plan, then estimate what it will take and tell them when it can be ready. In the afternoon you unpack and register a new batch of cells, update a work instruction based on what you learned this morning, and flag a consumable that needs reordering before it becomes a blocker.

About the team
We are the battery team behind Amazon Leo's power systems. We design, build, and test the cells and packs that keep satellites running. Over the coming years, we are scaling from development builds to flight-ready production, which means growing lab capacity, tightening processes, and building the team to support higher volumes. This role is the hands-on backbone of the lab: it keeps equipment, consumables, builds, and tests flowing, and steadily improves how the lab runs, so the cell test, build, and design engineers can focus on the engineering.

title: Senior Product Security Engineer
description:
Emerson’s Measurement Solutions business is seeking a Senior Product Security Engineer to provide product security leadership for industrial sensing, connectivity, software, and cloud programs. In this role, you will own product security for a portfolio that spans wireless field devices, WirelessHART gateways, Ethernet-APL connectivity platforms, monitoring platforms, and Plantweb Insight software and cloud solutions. These products bring pressure, temperature, flow, level, and other critical measurements from the field into control systems and analytics platforms for customers in oil and gas, chemical, pharmaceutical, and other critical industries.

You will embed security into every phase of the product lifecycle, from architecture and design through release and post-market support, and help product teams meet the requirements of the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) and IEC 62443. This is a high-impact, hands-on technical role with broad visibility across engineering, product management, quality, legal, and our global security test organization.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
  • Serve as the Product Security Lead for assigned industrial automation products, connectivity platforms, software applications, and cloud solutions.
  • Drive secure development lifecycle (SDL) activities and ensure product security requirements are defined, implemented, and verified throughout the product development process.
  • Partner with hardware, firmware, software, and cloud engineering teams to design secure architectures and integrate cybersecurity best practices into products and solutions.
  • Lead cybersecurity risk assessments, threat modeling, and product security planning to identify and mitigate security risks.
  • Support security testing activities, including vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, code analysis, and remediation efforts.
  • Manage product security vulnerabilities and collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate, prioritize, and resolve cybersecurity issues.
  • Support compliance with industry cybersecurity standards, regulations, certifications, and customer security requirements.
  • Provide technical guidance, training, and mentorship to engineering teams while promoting a strong culture of product cybersecurity.
  • Monitor emerging cybersecurity threats, technologies, and industry trends to continuously improve product security practices.
Who You Are:

You are a hands-on security technologist who enjoys learning the nuances of new technology and understanding how systems fit together securely. You quickly master complex, interconnected products, from embedded devices to the cloud, and can translate technical risk into clear, practical guidance for engineers and leaders. You build strong working relationships across functions and global teams, and you take ownership of results in a fast-moving regulatory environment.

For This Role, You Will Need:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Learn and follow hotel engineering standards, procedures, and preventive maintenance programs.
  • Assist with daily inspections of hotel facilities and equipment to identify maintenance needs.
  • Support the operation and maintenance of building systems essential to hotel operations.
  • Maintain accurate records of completed work, inspections, and maintenance activities.
  • Assist with maintaining engineering tools, equipment, supplies, workshops, and storage areas.

Guest Room and Public Area Maintenance

  • Assist with the inspection, repair, and maintenance of guest rooms to ensure they are safe, functional, and ready for occupancy.
  • Respond to guest room maintenance concerns, including issues involving lighting, plumbing, HVAC, doors, locks, furniture, fixtures, and appliances.
  • Work closely with Housekeeping and Front Desk teams to address maintenance issues that may affect room availability or the guest experience.
  • Assist with maintaining hotel public spaces, including lobbies, meeting areas, restaurants, corridors, and exterior areas.
  • Perform repairs and maintenance in a manner that minimizes disruption to guests and hotel operations.

Preventive Maintenance

  • Participate in the hotel's preventive maintenance program.
  • Assist with scheduled inspections and maintenance of guest rooms, public areas, and building equipment.
  • Learn to identify potential equipment failures and maintenance concerns before they affect hotel operations.
  • Assist with documenting preventive maintenance activities and completing assigned tasks.
  • Help maintain equipment and facilities to support operational reliability and extend the life of hotel assets.

Hotel Building Systems

Under appropriate supervision, the apprentice will gain experience with hotel building systems, which may include:

  • Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems.
  • Plumbing systems and fixtures.
  • Electrical and lighting systems.
  • Boilers, water heaters, pumps, and other mechanical equipment.
  • Kitchen and food and beverage equipment.
  • Laundry equipment.
  • Building automation and energy management systems.
  • Fire and life safety systems.
  • Elevators and other building equipment.
  • Pools, spas, and recreational equipment, where applicable.

The apprentice will assist with monitoring, inspecting, and maintaining these systems to support safe and efficient hotel operations.

Guest Service and Interdepartmental Support

  • Recognize the role of the Engineering Department in supporting the overall guest experience.
  • Respond professionally and courteously when entering guest rooms or interacting with guests.
  • Coordinate with Front Desk, Housekeeping, Food and Beverage, Sales, and other departments regarding maintenance needs and operational priorities.
  • Assist with preparing guest rooms and meeting spaces for operational use.
  • Communicate maintenance concerns that may impact room availability, events, food service, or other hotel operations.
  • Understand and support the hotel's service standards and commitment to guest satisfaction.

Safety and Emergency Preparedness

  • Follow all hotel safety policies, engineering procedures, and applicable regulations.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment and safe work practices.
  • Participate in training related to fire and life safety systems, emergency procedures, and hotel emergency response.
  • Report unsafe conditions, equipment failures, and potential hazards promptly.
  • Assist with maintaining safe and compliant hotel facilities.
  • Follow proper procedures when working with tools, equipment, chemicals, electrical systems, and mechanical equipment.

Learning and Professional Development

  • Participate in a structured hotel engineering apprenticeship and training program.
  • Complete assigned technical training, coursework, certifications, and on-the-job learning requirements.
  • Develop an understanding of hotel engineering operations, including work order management, preventive maintenance, building systems, and operational planning.
  • Work alongside experienced hotel engineering professionals and leadership.
  • Demonstrate increasing technical knowledge, responsibility, and independence throughout the apprenticeship.
  • Maintain required training records and complete assigned evaluations and projects.

title: SRE
description:
Who We Are

Fulcrum Digital is a global AI-first enterprise transformation company with over 25 years of experience. We partner with enterprises across financial services, insurance, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, higher education, and logistics to move from AI experimentation to scalable business outcomes. Fulcrum Digital works with over 100 global clients, including Fortune 500 enterprises, combining deep industry expertise with capabilities in enterprise AI, digital engineering, cloud modernisation, platform integration, and generative AI.


The Role

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the health, stability, and performance of a production environment supporting one of our client engagements. You will define how applications are monitored and supported, drive automation across deployment and operations, and work closely with development teams to reduce incidents and improve resiliency over time. This role suits someone with a strong service ownership mindset who enjoys connecting the dots across a complex technology stack and working with a global team across multiple time zones.


What You'll Do

• Plan, manage, and oversee all aspects of the production environment.

• Define strategies for application performance monitoring and optimization in production.

• Design, develop, and standardize monitoring and alerting mechanisms for supported applications.

• Respond to incidents, improve the platform based on feedback, and measure the reduction of incidents over time.

• Take a holistic approach to problem solving during production events, connecting the dots across the full technology stack to optimize mean time to recover (MTTR).

• Analyze ITSM activities for the platform and provide a feedback loop to development teams on operational gaps or resiliency concerns.

• Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services, from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.

• Support services before they go live through system design consulting, capacity planning, and launch reviews.

• Maintain live services by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system health.

• Support code deployments into multiple lower environments, supporting current processes while automating wherever possible.

• Support the application CI/CD pipeline for promoting software into higher environments through validation and operational gating, and lead on DevOps automation and best practices.

• Scale systems sustainably through automation, pushing for changes that improve both reliability and velocity.

• Collaborate with a global team spread across tech hubs in multiple geographies and time zones, sharing knowledge and explaining processes and procedures to others.



Requirements

​

Requirements

• Strong hands-on experience with Linux.

• Experience with monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, or equivalent.

• Working knowledge of ITIL/ITSM practices.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across complex, multi-layered platforms.

• Proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL.

• Experience with Jenkins and CI/CD pipelines.

• Scripting experience with Groovy, YAML, and Shell.

• Experience with Git and Bitbucket.

• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and AWS.

• Proven experience in production support leadership, including runbook and support model creation.

• Experience defining monitoring and alerting strategies.

• Experience with disaster recovery and resiliency planning.

• Experience with deployment readiness validation and operational process design.

• Solid background in root cause analysis and problem management.

• A service ownership mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and toil reduction.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to share knowledge across distributed teams.

• Availability to participate in rotational on-call duties and occasional off-hours work.

title: Technical Lead, Flashblade//EXA
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As the Performance Technical Lead for FlashBlade//EXA, you will define and own the end-to-end performance narrative for Everpure’s exascale disaggregated storage architecture built for AI factories. In this strategic and hands-on role, you will bridge systems performance engineering, benchmark architecture, and competitive intelligence to establish how //EXA is engineered, proven, and positioned against leading competitors in HPC and hyperscale AI infrastructure. You will partner directly with engineering, product management, and field sales teams to drive high-impact architecture evaluations and showcase Everpure’s leadership in high-throughput workloads.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Architect and Define Performance Roadmaps: Translate deep storage protocol expertise (NFSv3 direct-to-DN, pNFS, S3) into technical performance requirements for //EXA’s disaggregated data path to resolve GPU-starved read patterns, metadata storms, and bursty HPC workloads.
  • Drive Strategic Market Alignment for GPU/Sovereign Cloud: Align //EXA’s performance roadmap, sizing guidance, and reference architectures with the buying criteria and operational needs of multi-tenant GPU-cloud and sovereign-cloud operators.
  • Establish Competitive Performance Technical Positioning: Develop rigorously substantiated architectural analyses comparing metadata scaling, durability tradeoffs, and GPU-direct paths to empower field engineering during customer technical evaluations and POCs.
  • Optimize Stack-Wide Tuning and Benchmarking: Lead end-to-end performance validation across storage, RDMA networking, and compute, while building reproducible benchmark suites (MLPerf Storage, IO500, elbencho) that validate public claims and demonstrate market superiority.
  • Define Multi-Tenant QoS and SLA Guarantees: Establish technical requirements and validation frameworks for quality-of-service, workload isolation, and IOPS limits to deliver predictable SLA commitments in shared deployments.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Storage Performance Architecture Expertise: Proven expertise in storage performance engineering across file, block, and object protocols (such as parallel filesystems, pNFS/NFS at scale, and S3-scale object stores).
  • GPU Cluster & Fabric Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of GPU cluster architecture, including RDMA fabrics, GPUDirect Storage, checkpoint/restore dynamics, and resolving bottleneck patterns across compute, network, and storage layers.
  • Benchmarking & Load Generation Mastery: Proficiency with industry benchmark standards (MLPerf Storage, IO500) and load-generation tools (elbencho, fio, vdbench), alongside the capability to design custom, workload-representative tests.
  • Competitive Analysis & Systems Design: Demonstrated ability to perform architecture-level competitive analysis, along with a firm grasp of multi-tenant resource management concepts (QoS, rate limiting, and workload isolation) in distributed systems.
  • Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Ability to navigate complex technical discussions across the full stack—from debugging low-level network queue stalls to articulating system capabilities directly to customer evaluation teams.
  • Location: We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.

There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

$239,000—$359,000 USD

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out for more information.

Security Officer

The Security Officer provides a safe and secure environment for the patients, visitors, staff and property of Swedish Medical Center. Due to the continuous public contact of the position the highest level of customer service skills is essential. Security Officers conduct random patrols of Swedish Medical Center property, respond to and investigate security incidents, report safety hazards, and appropriately document actions and observations made during the shift. Security Officers respond to alarms and codes by providing traffic control and assisting with safe patient handling. Security Officers conduct routine safety walks of the facilities and submits remedial requests for any concerns they identify. Security Officers routinely engage in stressful situations and at times may be required to use physical force to maintain the safety of the patient care environment, and also may be required to run, climb stairs, carry people, or perform other physical acts in response to emergent situations. Security Officers will provide advice to clinical staff regarding matters of patient release and restraint. Security Officers also engage in a wide range of customer service activities involving direct contact with patients and visitors, providing directions and helping people find their way. Security Officers regularly use computers to write reports and logs and to monitor security cameras and access control systems. title: Transporter (2823)
description:
Job description:

About Us:

GMTCare is a leading provider of non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT) services, with a strong and growing presence in the Southwest. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Las Vegas, we have expanded our operations to serve communities across Nevada, Arizona, New Mexico, and Utah. Our mission is to deliver safe, reliable, and compassionate transportation for individuals with diverse mobility needs.

Guided by our motto, "We CARE"—Compassion, Attitude, Responsibility, and Excellence—these core values shape everything we do, from patient interactions to our internal culture.

At GMTCare, we prioritize safety, comfort, and professionalism. Our fleet features state-of-the-art technology, including GPS, two-way communication systems, and powered equipment for gurneys and wheelchair lifts. Each driver completes over 80 hours of training to meet the highest standards of care and service. We maintain rigorous regulatory compliance, vehicle safety, and maintenance standards across all of our operating locations.

About the Role:

GMTCare is seeking reliable, safety-focused Transporters to join our growing team. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in ensuring individuals get where they need to go safely and on time.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working independently, interacting with people, and making a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. You’ll operate company vehicles, assist passengers, and work closely with dispatch to keep operations running smoothly in a fast-paced environment.

  • Safely transport passengers between residences, healthcare facilities, and other destinations throughout Salt Lake City and the surrounding areas.

  • Maintain focus, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Understand, follow, and apply instructions, routes, and procedures while exercising sound judgment in real-time situations.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 22 years of age.

  • Valid Utah driver’s license with a minimum of three (3) years of driving experience.
  • Acceptable driving record in accordance with company standards (no major violations, suspensions, or at-fault accidents).

  • Ability to lift, push, and maneuver up to 125+ pounds, with or without assistance or appropriate equipment.

  • Ability to successfully pass a DOT physical, drug screening, and background check.
  • Strong attention to detail, reliability, and time management skills.
  • Effective communication and customer service skills.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism in time-sensitive and high-demand situations.
  • Ability to work in medical transport environments, including exposure to bodily fluids, using appropriate safety precautions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10 years of experience in transportation.
  • 2+ years of customer service experience.

  • Starting Rate: $20.00/hour

Benefits
