Designed as a modern-era company operating through an ecosystem of interconnected global operating platforms, we’re bound by a common mission and purpose: One Ascot. Our greatest strength is a talented team who flourishes in a collaborative, inclusive, and entrepreneurial culture, steeped in underwriting excellence, integrity, and a passion to find a better way, The Ascot Way.

The Ascot Way guides our people and our organization. Our underwriting platforms collaborate to find creative ways to deploy our capital in a true cross-product and cross-platform approach. These platforms work as one, deploying our capital creatively through our Client Centric, Risk Centric, and Technology Centric strategies.

Built to be resilient, Ascot maximizes client financial security while delivering bespoke products and world class service — both pre- and post-claims. Ascot exists to solve our clients’ brightest tomorrow, through agility, collaboration, resilience, and discipline.

Ascot is embedding artificial intelligence (AI) and automation across the organisation to enhance decision‑making, efficiency, and quality of outcomes. In this role, you will be expected to work confidently alongside AI‑enabled tools, apply sound judgment when interpreting insights, and adapt as technology continues to evolve. We value curiosity, critical thinking, and a willingness to embrace change as part of how we work.

Job Summary:

As part of Ascot’s Cybersecurity team, the Cyber Offense Analyst has a key role in helping deliver its cybersecurity strategic objectives. This individual will be instrumental in helping the program prepare and respond against the ever-changing threat actor’s tactics, techniques and procedures. This is a hands-on role where the successful candidate will be required to provide effective outcomes in determining weaknesses and threats specific to Ascot while also supporting the day-to-day processes and procedures. The job includes routine metrics and outcome measurements of the effectiveness of the cyber offense deliverables. This role will be in the office with a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform cyber offense functions including vulnerability scanning, coordination of penetration testing activities, overseeing remediation of vulnerabilities, continuous monitoring, application security testing, and process rollout and management. The scope of work is global covering people, process and technology across Ascot Group.

  • Assist in delivering a comprehensive offensive security strategy including identifying vulnerabilities, weaknesses and exposures in the organization’s environment, systems and applications.

  • Assist in implementing best in class solutions and tooling that will help achieve the cyber offense strategic objectives.

  • Manage vulnerability detection, coordinate patch management activities, and manage the application security program by supporting relevant processes and continuous monitoring.

  • Support penetration testing, purple and red team exercises with external and internal reviews of the environment by running, managing, and supporting remediation of those assessments.

  • Coordinate penetration testing (ethical hacking) activities and/or perform them to pinpoint vulnerabilities and consult on action plans for remediation that considers industry benchmark SLAs, asset criticality and severity rating of the vulnerabilities.

  • Integrate application security best practices into the development processes to facilitate a secure system development life cycle.

  • Leverage vulnerability databases, tooling, intelligence sources, and reports to build metrics as defined by leadership to identify the risks and tracking of risk reduction in the cyber offense space.

  • Research new tactics, techniques and procedures in public and closed forums and communicate those with security leadership.

  • Work with the cybersecurity resilience and defense team to collaborate on the presence of indicators of compromise (IOC’s) within or relevant to the environment along with determining the relevant corrective action.

  • Communicate and collaborate with technical and non-technical functions across the company and vendors to share, receive, and interpret various cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and risks related to cyber offense.

title: Test Technician (Starlink)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

TEST TECHNICIAN (STARLINK)

SpaceX is seeking a hands-on Test Technician to support development and qualification testing of Starlink satellites in the Redmond Test Lab. The lab is responsible for mechanical, structural, environmental, pressure, battery-cell, and solar-cell evaluation testing that proves satellite hardware before flight. This technician is the operator on the floor: prepare hardware and assets, run released procedures, fabricate fixtures and ground support equipment to print, and restore the setup.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assemble, instrument, and test satellite flight hardware throughout development, production, and on-orbit correlation testing phases
  • Monitor and assess test asset and test article performance throughout development and qualification campaigns
  • Activate, evaluate, monitor, and maintain space simulation test equipment (Thermal, Thermal Vacuum, HASS / HALT, Vibration, Shock, Battery, Pressure, Solar)
  • Assembly, activation and troubleshooting of custom test racks and automated equipment interfaces to increase test lab capability and unit test quality
  • Structural test build and execution for a variety of large- and small-scale structural and mechanical satellite components
  • Work with engineering to plan, build, and activate test equipment (mechanical assemblies, gas, hydraulic, cryogenic fluid systems, etc.)
  • Install, maintain, troubleshoot and repair instrumentation and harnessing. including pressure transducers, flowmeters, temperature sensors, accelerometers and strain gauges

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with mechanical/structural/fluid/electrical systems
  • 1+ years of experience performing electronic testing and inspection using measuring devices

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience with NASA STD 8739.4, IPC-620, and J-STD-001 qualifications
  • Experience with electromechanical build processes including iron & hot-air soldering; wire crimping and stripping; machine and hand drilling, shaping, cutting, and joining; 3D plastic printing
  • Ability to fabricate and repair cable harnesses including: soldering, crimping, assembling connectors
  • A&P (airframe and powerplant) license
  • Able to read mechanical and engineering drawings and interpret tolerances (including GD&T)
  • Experience with hydraulic plumbing repair/fabrication
  • Knowledge/experience with cryogenic systems (gaseous and liquid)
  • Experience with rigging, cranes, and lift operations
  • Experience with precision measuring instruments/equipment
  • Knowledge of various fittings (NPT, MS, AN, Swagelok, medium pressure)
  • Experience with test operations procedures including hydraulic load control, hydro/pneumatic pressure control, and safe handling of flight parts
  • Strong computer and analytical skills including proficiency in spreadsheets, databases, shop floor management software (ERP), and related programs
  • Strong computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and ability to navigate and manipulate files
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills
  • Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while working in a high-paced, challenging work environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to work all shifts, overtime, and weekends as needed; shift assignment is based on business need and may change
  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 25 pounds
  • Repetitive assembly operations, grasping, standing, lifting, bending, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, and carrying are generally required to perform the functions of this position
  • Flexibility is required: responsibilities, assets, and priorities will change as Starlink development and qualification needs change

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $23.00 - $29.00
Level 2: $28.00 - $34.50
Level 3: $33.00 - $40.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

Learn more about the ITAR here.

title: Director, Customer Experience, Trading API
description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

Alpaca is looking for a Director of Customer Experience to lead and develop the customer-facing support functions across Trading API.

Trading API serves a diverse and increasingly sophisticated customer base, from active traders and developers to trading firms and institutional customers. As we expand our products, markets, and global customer base, the customer experience function needs to scale with the complexity and demands of the business.

This role will lead our existing teams across General Support and VIP Support and evolve how we support customers globally. The Director will build a follow-the-sun operating model, develop the team and its capabilities, establish clear service standards and use data, AI, and automation to continuously improve how we serve customers.

The role will also be a key partner to Product, Engineering, Trading, Operations, and Compliance. Customer interactions provide an important source of insight into where customers encounter friction and where our products and processes can improve. The Director will be responsible for turning those insights into actionable feedback and working across the organization to drive improvements to the customer experience.

We expect this person to spend time understanding the customer experience firsthand, particularly early on. They should develop a deep understanding of how customers use Alpaca, the issues they encounter, and how those issues move through the organization. The goal is to translate that knowledge into a high-performing global function that can scale with Trading API.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Support and Global Coverage

  • Lead and develop the Trading API customer support team
  • Build a follow-the-sun model providing 24/5 coverage and ultimately 24/7
  • Establish service levels, escalation paths, and effective handoffs across regions
  • Ensure timely, high-quality support across Trading API products
  • Identify recurring issues and partner across teams to address root causes

Data, AI and Continuous Improvement

  • Establish KPIs across service levels, resolution times, customer satisfaction, escalations, and other measures of customer experience
  • Build reporting to identify trends, customer friction, and areas for improvement
  • Use data to set goals and continuously improve team performance
  • Own the use and fine-tuning of customer-facing AI support
  • Use AI, automation, and self-service tools to improve quality and scalability

VIP and Institutional Support

  • Build a differentiated support model for customers with greater scale, complexity, or support requirements
  • Ensure VIP customers have responsive escalation paths for critical issues
  • Build strong knowledge of customer integrations, trading workflows, and operational requirements
  • Strategize with the Head of Trading to establish a trading desk with smooth handoffs for institutional orders
  • Work closely with the business owners responsible for VIP and institutional customer relationships

Customer Experience and Product Partnership

  • Build a structured process for identifying recurring customer pain points
  • Partner with Product to improve onboarding, usability, self-service, and the overall customer experience
  • Use data and customer feedback to identify and prioritize areas for improvement
  • Represent the needs of Trading API customers and identify opportunities to make the platform easier to use
  • Measure the impact of customer experience initiatives

Leadership and Team Development

  • Lead, coach, QA and develop the existing customer-facing support teams
  • Evolve the organization, processes, and staffing model as Trading API scales
  • Establish clear goals, accountability, and a data-driven operating culture
  • Hire and develop talent as the organization grows
  • Stay close to customers and frontline teams while building a function that does not depend on the Director to manage individual issues

Who You Are

  • Experienced building and leading customer-facing teams in brokerage, trading, or financial markets
  • Strong understanding of brokerage products, trading workflows, order lifecycle, and the needs of active and institutional traders
  • Series 7 required
  • Series 24 required, or ability to obtain the Series 24 within an agreed timeframe after joining
  • Strong people leader with experience developing existing teams
  • Experience managing customer support across multiple regions and time zones
  • Highly data-driven with experience establishing and managing against KPIs
  • Technically fluent and comfortable with APIs, integrations, and complex customer issues
  • Experience using AI and automation to improve customer support
  • Strong cross-functional operator who can work across Product, Engineering, Trading, Operations, Compliance, and Sales

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Model Dev)
description:
About Us: Artera is an artificial intelligence company dedicated to transforming cancer care. We’ve developed foundation models that analyze clinical and pathology data, generating actionable insights that guide therapy selection and improve outcomes for cancer patients. By continuously improving these models, we aim to uncover the biological mechanisms driving cancer progression.

We're looking for a machine learning engineer to help develop AI biomarkers that improve cancer care. You'll work closely with experienced ML scientists and engineers, as well as clinical, biostatistics, product, and regulatory partners, across the model-development lifecycle, from prototyping and experimentation through validation and production deployment. You'll contribute to challenging problems in medical AI, including building models from digital pathology and clinical data, improving robustness across scanners and sites, understanding model behavior, and advancing our pathology foundation models.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Develop and evaluate AI-based biomarkers using multimodal data, including whole-slide images, clinical variables, and molecular data, to predict patient outcomes, treatment benefit, and molecular traits.

  • Contribute to the development and evaluation of self-supervised foundation models and downstream machine-learning models, including multiple-instance learning, time-to-event / hazard models, segmentation, and classification.

  • Develop and evaluate methods to improve model robustness and reproducibility across scanners, institutions, staining protocols, and patient populations.

  • Explore and apply interpretability methods to explain model decisions, build clinician trust, and drive actionable model improvements.

  • Build and improve tools and workflows that support efficient, reproducible model development, experimentation, validation, and deployment.

  • Perform rigorous model evaluation and analysis, communicate findings clearly, and document experiments and technical decisions.

  • Collaborate with ML scientists and engineers as well as product, biostatistics, clinical development, and regulatory/quality partners throughout model development and validation.

  • Support regulatory and quality documentation related to AI model development and validation.

  • Contribute to peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, and external academic or industry collaborations.

Experience Requirements:

  • 1+ years of experience developing machine-learning or deep-learning models using PyTorch (or TensorFlow), including relevant master's or graduate research experience.

  • Familiarity with oncology and biomarker development, including cancer biology and treatment pathways, clinical endpoints, risk stratification, and what makes a biomarker clinically actionable.

  • Experience working with real-world datasets and evaluating machine-learning models using appropriate metrics and validation approaches.

  • Strong Python programming skills and familiarity with modern software-development practices, including version control, testing, and code review.

  • Ability to analyze experimental results, troubleshoot model behavior, and communicate findings clearly.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with ML engineers, scientists, and cross-functional partners.

Desired:

  • Experience working with complex clinical datasets, such as medical imaging, multi-omics, longitudinal patient records, or data from clinical studies and multi-institutional cohorts.

  • Familiarity with weakly supervised learning, multiple-instance learning, survival analysis, or related methods.

  • Experience with self-supervised representation learning or foundation models.

  • Familiarity with dataset shift and variation across sites, devices, scanners, or acquisition protocols.

  • Exposure to machine learning in regulated healthcare environments, including SaMD, FDA 510(k)/De Novo, design controls, or CLIA/LDT validation.

  • Research experience through publications, conference presentations, internships, or academic projects.

  • Familiarity with cloud-based ML development, including distributed training, workflow orchestration, experiment tracking, or reproducible pipelines.

Equal Employee Opportunity:At Artera, we value bringing together individuals from diverse backgrounds to develop new andinnovative solutions for patients and physicians. As an equal opportunity employer, we do notdiscriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy),physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information gender identity orexpression, sexual orientation, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other legallyprotected characteristic.

Training Delivery 60%

title: Executive Business Partner
description:
About Us

At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice.

More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. From admin work to clinical care, our suite of innovative solutions work together to reduce administrative burden—empowering solo and small group practitioners to thrive alongside their clients.

Award-winning and people-first, SimplePractice is shaping the future of health tech. In 2026, we were recognized by BuiltIn as a Best Remote Company to Work For, Software Guru's Best Places to Code, Becker Healthcare Telehealth Companies to Know, and we won a MedTech Breakthrough Award for Best Practice Management Solution Provider.

The Role

The Executive Business Partner role is focused on helping our Chief Technology Officer become more effective through process, technology, and ways of working. While this will include some day-to-day support activities including limited calendar management - the primary focus of this role will be on projects and process improvements to change how we work.

This means diagnosing where our CTO is losing time, information, or leverage — then running a project to fix it. That could be redesigning how information flows to the executive before a critical meeting, building a system so follow-ups never get dropped, or optimizing how information flows up from the team to the executive. AI tools are a core part of how you work: you're expected to use them to move faster on research, drafting, synthesis, and system-building, and to bring in new AI-driven approaches wherever they can make our CTO more effective.

A smaller part of the role involves light day-to-day support to keep things running while you work on the bigger picture.

Responsibilities

Effectiveness Projects

  • Identify where the executive is spending time, attention, or energy inefficiently, and scope a project to fix it
  • Design and build systems that improve how information, decisions, and follow-ups move to and from the executive (e.g., a better meeting prep process, a cleaner decision log, a tighter action-item tracker)
  • Own discrete projects the executive assigns that are aimed at unblocking their own effectiveness — preparing them for a high-stakes negotiation, restructuring how their staff meeting runs, cleaning up a reporting process that wastes their time
  • Build and maintain the infrastructure that keeps the executive's priorities visible and on track across the organization, without the executive having to chase status themselves
  • Run pilot projects to test new ways of working before scaling them across the executive's team
  • Evaluate and deploy AI tools that reduce the executive's workload — meeting summarization, research synthesis, drafting assistance, automated status tracking — and build the workflows around them so they stick
  • Own the planning, logistics and itinerary for team offsites and events both internal to the team and cross functionally across the company. Automating these via AI is a plus.

Day-to-Day Support

  • Coordinate scheduling for the executive's most complex commitments — multi-stakeholder internal meetings, board and leadership sessions, and external meetings with candidates, customers, partners, investors, or other outside parties
  • Manage the logistics of executive-to-executive coordination, including aligning calendars and priorities across other senior leaders
  • Prepare quick briefings ahead of key meetings related to your project work, using AI tools to synthesize background, prior context, and relevant materials efficiently
  • Handle the administrative details that keep your projects moving

Desired Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years in a role focused on operational improvement, process design, or project execution — Chief of Staff, Business Operations, Program Manager, or similar — ideally at a software or technology company
  • Strong project management instincts: you can scope, plan, execute, and measure the impact of your own work
  • Comfort diagnosing inefficiency without waiting to be told exactly what's broken
  • Fluency with AI tools and a habit of reaching for them to work faster — research, drafting, summarization, and building lightweight automations
  • Clear written communication for project plans, recommendations, and results
  • Good judgment and discretion with sensitive information
  • A bias toward action — you'd rather run a small pilot and learn than write a long plan

Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits program including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO), wellbeing days, paid holidays, and summer Fridays
  • Mental health resources
  • Paid parental leave & Backup Care
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

title: Data Engineering Coordinator
description:
Data Engineering Coordinator Opportunity with the Civil Works Alliance (CWA), Supporting Sizewell C

As part of the CWA (Civil Works Alliance), you will support the building of Sizewell C. Sizewell C will be a 3.2-gigawatt power station generating low‑carbon electricity for around 6 million homes and will play a key role in our energy future, supplying reliable, clean electricity for at least 60 years. This role will be within the Main Civil Works Section.

What will you do?

The CWA is recruiting directly for a Data Coordinator to provide a trusted data presence where delivery happens, working closely with project teams, suppliers and the Transverse Data & Reporting Service.

This is a practical, delivery‑focused role that goes beyond producing reports. The successful candidate will help ensure project information is complete, correctly coded and accurately reflects activity taking place across the site and within supply‑chain facilities. Their work will give project managers reliable information for valuation and help ensure quality records are ready for handover.

  • Checking progress, quality, manufacturing and completion information against activity taking place on site and in factories.
  • Applying naming, coding and data standards at source, correcting or rejecting information that does not meet the required standard.
  • Reviewing scope completeness and reconciling reported progress against programme baselines and forecasts.
  • Identifying missing, inconsistent or poor‑quality information and working with project teams and suppliers to resolve issues.
  • Monitoring the timeliness and completeness of quality records ahead of valuations and handover.
  • Coordinating weekly supplier data returns, including reports, schedules and material‑tracking information.
  • Supporting suppliers and delivery teams with reporting processes, systems and data requirements.
  • Contributing to improvements in data collection, reporting workflows and operational visibility

What are we looking for?

The successful candidate will be accountable for improving data quality at source and making sure reliable information is available to support delivery decisions.

  • Experience in project delivery, project controls, reporting or information management within a major project environment.
  • A practical understanding of delivery processes and the confidence to challenge information that does not reflect what is happening on the ground.
  • Experience coordinating data or progress returns from suppliers and delivery partners.
  • The ability to investigate data‑quality and reporting issues and drive them through to resolution.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities across several workstreams.
  • Clear communication and effective stakeholder‑engagement skills.
  • Experience using reporting, workflow or information‑management systems.
  • The ability to obtain the required level of security clearance.

Experience in nuclear, major construction, infrastructure or manufacturing would be advantageous. Familiarity with Power BI, Primavera P6, Field View, material‑tracking systems, quality records, completions processes or BS EN ISO 19650 would also be beneficial

What we will offer you?

The CWA is a single delivery organisation made of up of the client (Sizewell C) and three parent companies - Balfour Beatty, Bouygues and Laing O'Rourke - which offer industry leading packages including market leading salaries, generous annual leave entitlements, pension scheme and other flexible benefits.

About Us

The CWA celebrates the creativity and innovation that comes from a diverse workforce, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds — especially those from under‑represented communities. Our project is built on five core values: Humility, Positivity, Respect, Solidarity, and Clarity.
By joining us, you’ll be encouraged to bring your whole self to work, speak up, and share your ideas. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of gender, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.
We are committed to protecting your privacy. If you decide to apply, please avoid including sensitive personal data in your CV.

title: Senior FHIR Backend Developer
description:
Who we are:

Tria Federal delivers digital services and technology solutions that support the health and safety of veterans, service members and civilians. For two decades, federal agencies have relied on Tria companies to advance their critical missions and modernize their systems, so that they can uphold their commitment to the American people. Today, we are pushing the boundaries of possibility through partnerships and investments in artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, developing solutions for the biggest challenges that government will face tomorrow.

We are proud to employ and support military veterans who bring mission-first mindset, technical expertise, and leadership qualities that strengthen our work. Veterans, transitioning service members, and military spouses are strongly encouraged to apply.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior FHIR Backend Developer to design, build, and maintain the FHIR-based APIs that power CMS's FHIR initiatives. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on implementing standards-based healthcare data exchange, with primary responsibility for the services that submit and process the DEQM Summary MeasureReport profile.

The ideal candidate is a strong backend engineer who has already implemented FHIR R4 resources, profiles, and APIs in production, and who is comfortable working inside CMS implementation guides (IGs) and conformance requirements. This role works closely with the project's Technical Lead and architecture decisions, turning profile and IG requirements into secure, well-tested, production-grade code.

Basic Requirements:

  • Ability to successfully obtain a U.S. Federal Position of Trust clearance designation.
  • Must reside in and be able to perform work in the United States.
  • Must have lived in the United States for 3 of the last 5 years.
  • A bachelor's degree is required, preferably in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or a related field (equivalent experience considered).
  • 8+ years of backend software engineering experience, including building and maintaining production REST APIs.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience implementing HL7 FHIR (R4 preferred) resources, profiles, extensions, and RESTful FHIR APIs.
  • Experience building or extending a FHIR server (e.g., HAPI FHIR) or FHIR client integrations in a production environment.
  • Experience implementing API security patterns such as SMART on FHIR, SMART Backend Services, and OAuth 2.0.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical designs and decisions clearly.

Additional Qualifications:

  • HL7 FHIR Foundational Implementer certification strongly preferred; candidates actively pursuing it will also be considered. HL7 FHIR Advanced Developer or Advanced Architect certification is a nice-to-have.
  • Experience implementing or consuming Da Vinci Digital Quality Measures (DEQM), the Quality Measure IG, CRMI, or QI-Core.
  • Familiarity with CQL (Clinical Quality Language) as used in digital quality measure logic.
  • Experience with FHIR Bulk Data export/import and large-scale healthcare data processing.
  • Experience standing up automated profile validation and conformance testing in a CI/CD pipeline.
  • Experience with Java-based FHIR implementations (e.g., HAPI FHIR) a strong plus.
  • Prior experience supporting CMS programs, Medicare/Medicaid data exchange, or other federal health IT systems.
  • Familiarity with FHIR Shorthand (FSH) and SUSHI for authoring and testing profiles and implementation guides.

title: Supervisor, Distribution Center - 3rd Shift
description:
Job Summary

The Supervisor, Distribution Center leads third-shift operations, including receiving, picking, packing, cycle counting, shipping, and related warehouse activities. The role converts departmental priorities into daily work plans, assigns labor and resources, monitors safety, quality, productivity, and service, and resolves issues to support accurate, timely order fulfillment. This position leads team leaders and Distribution Center employees by setting expectations, coaching performance, planning staffing, managing performance, and developing employee capabilities. The Supervisor also supports warehouse management systems, automated storage and retrieval systems, and related processes, coordinating escalations with internal partners and external providers as needed. Success is measured by safe, compliant operations; achievement of shift objectives; accurate and timely product flow; effective employee development; strong cross-shift coordination; and continuous improvement.
This role has formal people-management responsibility, including direct supervision, performance management, talent development, workforce scheduling, resource allocation, employee engagement, and team results. The role leads one operational team or shift, makes day-to-day decisions within established policies and delegated authority, allocates resources to meet operating needs, and delivers results through the performance and development of others.

Responsibilities

  • Leads third-shift Distribution Center operations and ensures receiving, picking, packing, cycle counting, shipping, and related activities are completed safely, accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established process specifications.
  • Provides direct supervision, direction, coaching, and performance feedback to assigned team leaders and Distribution Center employees.
  • Establishes daily priorities, assigns work, balances labor, and adjusts workflow and resources to meet customer service, productivity, quality, and delivery requirements.
  • Communicates performance expectations and ensures employees understand job responsibilities, standard work, safety requirements, and operating procedures.
  • Monitors shift performance using established metrics and operating reports; identifies gaps, determines appropriate corrective actions, and escalates significant risks or barriers.
  • Conducts performance reviews, supports goal setting, addresses performance concerns, recognizes employee contributions, and creates meaningful development opportunities.
  • Supports staffing decisions, onboarding, training, cross-training, succession planning, attendance management, and workforce coverage for regular operations, absences, overtime, and changing business needs.
  • Builds an inclusive, respectful, accountable, and customer-focused team culture while modeling company values and leadership principles.
  • Ensures Distribution Center activities comply with company policies, safety requirements, quality standards, inventory-control procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Investigates operational errors, inventory discrepancies, process failures, and service issues; determines root causes and implements or recommends corrective and preventive actions.
  • Coordinates workflow and operational handoffs with other shifts, logistics functions, maintenance, Information Technology, Customer Service, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Serves as a Warehouse Management System key user by supporting proper system utilization, assisting users, troubleshooting operational issues, and coordinating issue escalation when necessary.
  • Investigates and corrects routine operational issues within the Warehouse Management System and related business systems.
  • Contacts the appropriate Warehouse Management System support provider when issues cannot be resolved internally.
  • Coordinates response to minor automated storage and retrieval system hardware or controls issues and engages internal facilities, maintenance, technical resources, or vendors for mechanical or advanced technical concerns.
  • Reviews work quality, reinforces standard procedures, and provides additional instruction, coaching, or training when errors or performance gaps are identified.
  • Participates in Distribution Center, Warehouse Management System, automation, productivity, and continuous-improvement
  • Identifies opportunities to improve safety, quality, inventory accuracy, labor utilization, process efficiency, system performance, and customer service.
  • Maintains timely and accurate shift documentation, attendance records, performance information, incident reports, training records, and other required operational records.
  • Makes day-to-day decisions within delegated authority regarding work assignments, priorities, staffing adjustments, issue resolution, and operational execution.
  • Communicates significant safety, quality, personnel, system, or operational risks to the Distribution Center Manager and appropriate stakeholders.
  • Serves as a visible leadership presence on the Distribution Center floor and models professional, ethical, safe, and customer-focused behavior.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by the manager.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or G.E.D. required.
  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field preferred.
  • Three or more years of progressive experience in distribution, warehouse, logistics, inventory, fulfillment, or related operations.
  • Prior formal supervisory or people-management experience required; experience supervising employees in a multi-shift distribution or warehouse environment preferred.
  • Working knowledge of receiving, picking, packing, cycle counting, shipping, inventory control, and general Distribution Center processes.
  • Experience using warehouse management systems and related enterprise or business systems.
  • Familiarity with automated storage and retrieval systems, material-handling equipment, controls systems, or automated Distribution Center technologies preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan work, establish priorities, allocate resources, and achieve operational requirements in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach employees, provide performance feedback, address performance concerns, and support employee development.
  • Strong decision-making, problem-solving, conflict-resolution, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to interpret and apply operating procedures, safety requirements, quality standards, and company policies.
  • Ability to analyze operational information, identify performance gaps, and implement practical corrective actions.
  • Proficiency with personal computers, Microsoft Office applications, reporting tools, and related business software.
  • High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to collaborate across shifts and functions and communicate effectively with employees, leaders, internal customers, technical partners, and vendors.
  • Demonstrates a willingness to collaborate with others, build relationships, and involve others in decision-making.
  • Demonstrates the ability to deliver results by solving or supporting others in solving problems, prioritizing tasks and resources, and maintaining focus on outcomes.
  • Demonstrates the ability to develop and adapt strategies, communicate direction convincingly, and regularly monitor progress toward defined objectives.
  • Demonstrates the ability to develop people and teams by providing appropriate development opportunities, delegating work, coaching performance, and building effective teams.
  • Demonstrates self-awareness and a willingness to learn, grow, accept change, and adapt to changing work demands.
  • Demonstrates the ability to drive customer value by understanding business needs, identifying customer requirements, and delivering work that maximizes customer value.
  • Demonstrates a willingness to promote improvement and innovation by identifying ideas and opportunities and increasing the speed and effectiveness of execution.
  • Demonstrates a willingness to initiate and support change, provide direction during uncertainty, and understand and address employee concerns.
  • Demonstrates a willingness to take ownership by making decisions, accepting responsibility, and driving work forward.

Supporting Qualifications

  • Professional certification in supply chain, logistics, warehouse operations, lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Experience with Warehouse Management Systems, enterprise resource planning systems, automated storage and retrieval systems, and warehouse controls technologies preferred.
  • Forklift powered industrial truck, or other material-handling equipment training or certification preferred.
  • Experience supporting continuous-improvement, productivity, quality, safety, or labor-planning initiatives.
  • Experience using operational metrics and key performance indicators related to safety, quality, inventory accuracy, productivity, delivery, attendance, employee engagement, and continuous improvement.
  • Familiarity with lean methodologies, root-cause analysis, standard work, and corrective-action practices.

Essential Job Functions

  • Must be able to lift up to 70 pounds.
  • Must be able to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Must be able to work at a computer terminal or screen for extended periods when necessary.
  • Must be able to work in an active Distribution Center environment around material-handling equipment, automation, and varying noise levels.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, and through electronic systems.
  • Must be professional, ethical, safety-conscious, and customer-focused.
  • Must be able to work 3rd shift hours
  • Must be able to work flexible hours when necessary, including weekends and holidays.

title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Reddit has a flexible workforce! If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like. Don't live near one of our offices? No worries: You can apply to work remotely in any country in which we have a physical presence.

Reddit's Infrastructure organization has the mission of building and delivering the compute orchestration environment, storage and data systems, and essential platform services behind all of Reddit. The breadth of the infrastructure portfolio spans Compute, Storage, Messaging, Transport, Core Platform, Ranking Platform, SRE, Security, and Compliance. and more, each with active roadmaps driving modernization, migrations, and platform evolution.

We are looking for an experienced Staff Technical Program Manager (IC5) who is a generalist across all things infrastructure. This role requires strong TPM skills paired with strong technical knowledge to effectively drive programs across the full breadth of Reddit's infrastructure stack. You will plan and execute complex, multi-team programs, from cluster migrations and storage modernization to Kafka client rollouts, with a deep understanding of the processes, trade-offs, and dependencies involved.

Why this role matters:

Reddit's infrastructure is undergoing its most significant modernization in company history. We are migrating off legacy clusters, standing up intent-based compute environments, evolving our storage and messaging platforms, scaling ML serving to GPU, and expanding to multi-region serving, all simultaneously across 30+ platform teams. This is a rare opportunity to partner with world-class engineering teams at the intersection of all of these efforts, serving as the connective tissue that keeps Reddit's most complex infrastructure programs on track, dependencies visible, and execution aligned to a shared long-term strategy.

If you’re looking to positively and directly impact an already awesome company culture, we’d like to hear from you!

Who we are:

The Technical Program Management Office (Tech PMO) exists to accelerate, scale, and empower all teams at Reddit to do their best work and advance our company’s mission. We operate from within the office of the CTO, maximizing our ability to galvanize and drive technical programs and solutions to solve company-wide problems. Our reach extends across the entire company, driving key strategic focus areas for the business.

What you’ll do:

You will own and drive programs across the full breadth of Reddit's infrastructure stack, spanning Compute, Storage, Messaging, Transport, Core Platform, Ranking Platform, Security, and Compliance. Your portfolio will include large-scale migrations, tooling modernization, and platform evolution efforts. You will partner deeply with engineering teams as a technical peer, not from the stratosphere, but in the details, bringing programs to completion, balancing risk across frontend, backend, and revenue-producing teams, and ensuring execution stays aligned to Reddit's long-term infrastructure strategy.

  • Get Things Done. More than just displaying activity, counting sprint points, or delivering regular updates. You actually bring programs to completion and deliver real accomplishments for the business, and help your teams understand the difference.
  • Dive into Details. You understand the details of their programs and help guide them with and in active partnership with their teams. You don’t just stay in the stratosphere or in an abstract process. You have the technical judgment to act as a partner with your teams in planning and decision making.
  • Make Work Repeatable. You create and improve processes that smooth the path for others and prevent and remove recurring organizational toil (and the lower quality bar that often allows). You reuse processes developed elsewhere, and aid in adoption of standards where relevant.
  • Leverage AI to Improve Program Outcomes. Use AI and LLM-assisted tooling to automate reporting, improve cost anomaly detection, accelerate data analysis, and enhance program management workflows, ensuring the Cost & Capacity function operates with maximum leverage.
  • Mentor & Lead. You are good at, and enjoy, informally aiding others in developing key organizational and program skills. You’re a leader within the Program Management org, your programs, and support people in the process.
  • Bring Order out of Chaos. You are known for leaving a program and the teams you support in a position of stronger organization than where they started, and those teams continue to succeed even when you are no longer specifically engaged in the program.

Who you are:

  • 8+ years of collective experience in engineering and program management roles.
  • Strong technical depth and judgment. You are comfortable discussing Kubernetes orchestration, storage engines, messaging systems (Kafka), ML serving infrastructure, deployment pipelines, CDN and traffic management, and data platform architectures. You can credibly challenge technical plans and identify risks that engineering teams may overlook. You have experience with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD systems, observability platforms, and container orchestration is highly valued.
  • Strong Technical Program Management skills. title: Senior Backend Engineer - Data Core
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer – Data Core based in Netherlands.

This is a senior backend engineering role focused on building the infrastructure that powers a large-scale creator data platform. You’ll design and operate systems responsible for collecting and maintaining data on more than 400 million creator profiles across major social platforms. The role involves solving complex distributed-systems challenges around reliability, freshness, scalability, external dependencies, and cost efficiency. You’ll have end-to-end ownership, from shaping ambiguous problems and designing architectures to deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving production systems. You’ll work with high-volume data, third-party APIs, proxy networks, and cloud infrastructure where small technical improvements can have a significant business impact. The environment is remote-first, async-oriented, collaborative, and designed to give senior engineers substantial autonomy.

Accountabilities:

  • Build and evolve backend systems responsible for collecting and maintaining 400M+ creator profiles across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

  • Develop reliable collection infrastructure capable of processing billions of data points while maintaining appropriate levels of freshness, coverage, and data quality.

  • Design resilient services that can handle third-party API instability, rate limits, provider outages, platform changes, partial failures, and other external disruptions.

  • Improve the economics of large-scale data collection by optimizing requests, proxy usage, retries, storage, compute, and other infrastructure costs.

  • Design and maintain systems that determine which creators should be collected, when they should be collected, and how frequently, balancing customer value with operational cost.

  • Own backend systems throughout their lifecycle, including requirements gathering, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, operation, and iteration.

  • Build strong observability, alerting, monitoring, and operational safeguards to identify collection failures, data-quality issues, coverage gaps, and freshness regressions before they affect customers.

  • Work closely with data, search, product, and engineering teams to establish reliable interfaces and dependencies between systems.

  • Evaluate technical approaches through production experiments, considering throughput, failure modes, scalability, reliability, and unit economics before making larger investments.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, architecture decisions, code reviews, and technical direction across production-critical infrastructure.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience building large-scale backend or data systems where reliability, throughput, latency, scalability, and cost are important considerations.

  • Demonstrated ability to take systems from concept to production, including scoping, architecture, implementation, release, operation, measurement, and continuous improvement.

  • Strong knowledge of distributed systems and the ability to reason about partial failures, retries, idempotency, backpressure, scaling, fault tolerance, and operational tradeoffs.

  • Experience building and maintaining integrations with third-party APIs or external dependencies that may be rate-limited, unreliable, or subject to frequent changes.

  • Practical experience with proxy management, request routing, or high-volume traffic management is valuable, including an understanding of the challenges associated with anti-bot systems and responsible large-scale traffic handling.

  • Strong operational ownership, with experience using observability, monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and data-quality controls to keep production systems reliable after deployment.

  • Ability to work autonomously on ambiguous technical challenges, gather requirements, identify the right questions, and move projects forward without needing fully defined specifications.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly, provide constructive feedback, and work effectively across teams.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS, and strong proficiency with backend technologies such as TypeScript and Node.js.

  • Familiarity with databases, queues, object storage, infrastructure as code, and distributed cloud services.

  • Bonus experience with social-media APIs, large-scale data collection, data-quality frameworks, or freshness and coverage monitoring.

  • Interest in the creator economy or social platforms is a plus, but prior industry experience is not required.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation: Annual salary range of €80,000–€110,000, plus stock options. The exact package depends on location, employment type, skills, and experience.

  • Meaningful equity: Stock options designed to provide employees with meaningful ownership as the organization grows.

  • Fully remote in Europe: Work from wherever you do your best work, with some overlap with GMT+3.

  • Flexible working hours: The focus is on outcomes and impact rather than fixed working schedules.

  • Unlimited paid vacation: Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and maintain a sustainable work-life balance.

  • Personal development support: Courses, books, conferences, and other learning opportunities are supported when they contribute to your growth.

  • Real ownership: Take production-critical infrastructure from initial concept through deployment and operation without unnecessary layers of process.

  • Regular offsites: Connect with colleagues in person through recurring company gatherings while maintaining a remote-first working model.

  • Deep-work environment: Purposeful meetings, focused collaboration, and plenty of time for designing, building, hardening, and operating systems.

  • Modern technical stack: Work with AWS, Pulumi, TypeScript, Node.js, Aurora Limitless/Postgres, S3, CloudWatch, ECS, SQS, Athena, proxy networks, and custom routing infrastructure.

  • Fast interview process: The hiring process is designed to move quickly and can be completed in under a week, with an introductory conversation, coding interview, system design interview, team interview, and final culture and alignment conversation.

title: AI Python Developer Lead
description: Principal Python + LangGraph Engineer Engagement: Atlas (US health-tech, AI-driven mobile coaching platform) Engagement context We are partnering with a US-based health-tech company on the takeover of a production AI-powered mobile coaching platform. The platform is built around a Python AI core (atlas-ai) which runs: • A FastAPI chat surface with intent routing and tool-using agents • A LangGraph-based agent framework with multi-agent orchestration • A Celery + Redis task queue for asynchronous agent flows • MongoDB for fitness-plan storage, Redis for conversation state, Postgres for LangGraph checkpoints • Several agent personas: onboarding, chat, plan creation, in-workout smart adjust, plan smart adjust, habit formation • Direct OpenAI integration for the LLM layer This is the product. If the AI core breaks, the product breaks. If LLM token cost runs away, our margin runs away. If the agent flows behave unpredictably under load, real users get bad coaching. Role summary As Principal AI Engineer you are the technical owner of the AI core. You lead the audit of the existing codebase, define the architecture we evolve toward, build the test and evaluation harness that lets us ship changes safely, and you are the engineer who is paged when the AI surface misbehaves in production. You will be the deciding voice on whether we can responsibly take this service in our scope or whether we keep the client's original team embedded longer. The audit conclusions you write in the first 4 weeks will inform the contractual scope of the entire engagement. What you'll do First 90 days • Audit atlas-ai: agent flows, LangGraph state machines, Celery topology, datastore usage, OpenAI integration patterns • Produce a written assessment of operational risk: failure modes, race conditions, retry semantics, idempotency, checkpoint integrity • Quantify token cost per agent flow and per user session • Identify the highest-risk subsystems and propose stabilisation plans • Build (or harden) an evaluation harness for the agent flows — golden cases, regression suites, hallucination/safety tests • Lead the knowledge-transfer sessions from the client's title: Robotics Intern, Learning Kits & Curriculum
description:
About the Role

We're hiring a Robotics Intern to help design, build, and ship the hands-on robotics kits we put in front of students. We're scaling a program that puts thousands of robotics kits, paired with AI-powered courses, into K-12 schools, colleges, and universities across the US, and we need someone who loves building things to help.

You'll work on the full kit, not just one piece of it. That means assembling and testing hardware like SO-101 robot arms and drone kits, 3D printing and designing parts, and then building the courses on Honen that teach students how to use what's in the box. Your work will be used by real students and teachers in real classrooms.

This is a hands-on role. You'll spend a lot of time at a workbench, and a lot of time figuring out how to explain what you just built to a student who's never touched a robot.

What You'll Do

  • Assemble, wire, calibrate, and test robotics hardware, including SO-101 arms, drone kits, and NVIDIA Jetson-based kits.
  • Design, model, and 3D print custom parts, mounts, enclosures, and replacement components.
  • Help decide what goes into each kit, source parts, and write bills of materials.
  • Write clear build guides, setup instructions, and troubleshooting docs that a teacher with no robotics background can follow.
  • Build robotics lessons and courses in Honen, including step-by-step projects, videos, quizzes, and hands-on challenges.
  • Write and debug starter code students use to control their robots, for example in Python.
  • Test kits and courses end to end, find where people get stuck, and fix it.
  • Photograph and film builds for course content, marketing, and partner updates.
  • Help pack and prepare kits for school deployments, and support teachers once kits are in the field.
  • Bring ideas for new kits and projects to the team.

What We're Looking For

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or a related field. Strong self-taught builders are welcome too.
  • Hands-on experience building robots, drones, or electronics projects, through a club, team, class, or on your own.
  • Experience with 3D printing and CAD (Fusion 360, Onshape, SolidWorks, or similar).
  • Comfortable with basic electronics: wiring, soldering, motors, servos, and sensors.
  • Some programming experience, ideally Python.
  • Good at explaining technical things in plain language.
  • Patient with debugging hardware that doesn't work the first time.
  • Organized and careful with parts, inventory, and documentation.
  • Excited about getting students and new learners into robotics and AI.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with the SO-101 / SO-100 arms, Hugging Face LeRobot, or other open-source robot arms.
  • Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, or Arduino.
  • Drone building or flying experience.
  • ROS or ROS 2 experience.
  • FIRST Robotics, VEX, or similar competition experience, as a student or mentor.
  • Teaching, tutoring, camp counseling, or curriculum writing experience.
  • Video editing or photography skills.

What Strong Candidates Look Like

We care more about what you've built than what classes you've taken. The strongest candidates can show us things like a robot they built and programmed, a drone they put together from parts, a 3D printed design they iterated on, a project they documented well enough for someone else to rebuild, or a time they taught someone else how to build something.

Send us photos, videos, GitHub links, or anything else that shows your work.

Position Details

  • Position: Robotics Intern
  • Focus: Robotics learning kits and curriculum
  • Hours: Approximately 20 hours per week
  • Location: On-site, Beverly Hills, CA
  • Schedule: Flexible around coursework
  • Compensation: $3,500/month

This role is designed for someone who wants real experience building hardware and educational products that go straight into classrooms across the country.

title: Sr. Industrial Security Analyst (PERSEC)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. INDUSTRIAL SECURITY ANALYST (PERSEC)

SpaceX is looking for a multidisciplinary Industrial Security Officer (PERSEC) to serve as a Senior Personnel Security Analyst within our Redmond, WA office. This is a chance to fill a critical role within a dynamic and high-tempo environment working on programs pushing the boundaries of industry and technology. A successful candidate will be a self-starter and problem-solver and will possess the ability to convey security requirements to a diverse group of technical personnel.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support all Personnel Security (PERSEC) aspects of a variety of missions at the SCI, SAP and Collateral level
  • Support all steps of PERSEC processing in an efficient manner, including pre-screening, clearance initiation, review of paperwork and customer submission
  • Be able to develop a deep understanding of the clearance processes for SCI, SAP and Collateral
  • Be able to develop a deep understanding of security clearance databases including DISS, NBIS, JADE, TALON, etc.
  • Successfully interact with a variety of government customers to ensure clearances are processed efficiently on the government side
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and question assumptions to make procedures as streamlined as possible
  • Manage all reporting requirements for the entirety of the cleared SpaceX population, to include foreign travel, life changes, incidents and adverse information
  • Coordinate indoctrinations and debriefings
  • Partner with Mission Management and government representatives to ensure SpaceX is providing the best possible security clearance support
  • Partner with internal stakeholder teams to reinforce their understanding of clearance holder requirements and ensure those requirements are met
  • Prepare for and assist with the PERSEC component of compliance inspections
  • Conduct security related inquires and incident reporting
  • Keep abreast of the latest security trends and policy updates, implementing innovative solutions and processes

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree; OR 7+ years of professional experience performing NISPOM-related security responsibilities in lieu of a degree
  • 5+ years security experience in PERSEC performing responsibilities specifically within a SAP, SCI, and/or Collateral environment or a security field

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience with DISS, NBIS, JADE, TALON and Scattered Castles
  • Strong knowledge of the NISPOM, (32 CFR 117), Intelligence Community Directives (ICD 704), DoDM 5205.07, and other related security policies and procedures
  • Familiarity with SIMS

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to favorably complete a U.S. Government CI scope polygraph
  • Ability to travel in support of mission requirements, < 10%

title: Technical Product Manager - Core Banking
description:
ABOUT NYMBUS:

Nymbus is a high-growth fintech company, empowering banks and financial institutions to transform faster, compete smarter, and deliver greater value in today’s digital marketplace. At Nymbus, we’re revolutionizing banking technology. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based solutions help financial institutions modernize, scale, and succeed. As part of our team, you won’t just be part of a tech revolution; you’ll be at the forefront of it, driving innovation and delivering exceptional client experiences.

Nymbus is building the next generation of fintech platforms, and that takes people who are ready to challenge convention, move with purpose, and reimagine what’s possible. We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work, and the value we deliver to our clients.

We want our partners to be thrilled about the possibilities we are creating together and the lasting impact our collaboration will bring to the industry and consumers. The journey to growth begins with doing something different. And that journey starts with the great people who make Nymbus.

We challenge the status quo, question assumptions, and work together to turn bold ideas into meaningful progress.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Nymbus, the AI Technical Product Manager, Core is the primary builder in our squad triad model.

You are responsible for transforming product vision into reality. Working within a dedicated squad alongside an Architect (who owns system design and technical integrity) and a Shipper (who owns delivery, quality, and release), you own the build, from specification through implementation. You operate with an AI-first, spec-first mindset, leveraging tools like Kiro and Claude to accelerate every phase of product creation.

This is not a traditional product owner or product management role. You bring your own experience, research, and creativity to design products end-to-end, authoring specifications, shaping system behavior, and iterating rapidly using AI-assisted workflows. You own the "what" and the "how," translating domain problems into working, shippable software.

THE SQUAD TRIAD MODEL:

You operate as one-third of a high-autonomy squad:

  • Technical Product Manager / Builder (This Role): Owns product intent, specification, and implementation. You are the primary creator — designing system behavior, authoring specs, and iterating with AI tools to produce working software. Deep domain knowledge is a plus; the ability to acquire it quickly is a must.

  • Architect (Your Partner): Owns system design, technical integrity, and cross-squad consistency. The Architect ensures your solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with platform architecture. You collaborate daily on data models, API contracts, and integration patterns.

  • Shipper (Your Partner): Owns delivery, quality assurance, release management, and operational readiness. The Shipper ensures what you build meets quality standards, passes validation, and reaches production reliably. You collaborate on acceptance criteria, test coverage, and deployment strategy.

Together, the triad owns outcomes end-to-end — from problem definition through production operation.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN:

Product Design and Specification

  • Use AI tools (Kiro, Claude) to rapidly iterate on designs, edge cases, and alternative approaches
  • Own end-to-end product design from problem definition through system behavior and user experience
  • Author clear, testable, implementation-ready specifications using AI-assisted workflows
  • Define APIs, data models, and interaction patterns in partnership with the squad Architect
  • Translate business requirements and domain knowledge into buildable system specifications

AI-First Building and Implementation

  • Build working software using AI-assisted development workflows as the primary creation method
  • Generate, refine, and implement product and technical specifications using spec-driven development
  • Prototype and validate solutions rapidly before committing to full implementation
  • Push through ambiguity — when requirements are unclear, explore, propose, and build to learn
  • Leverage AI tools as co-developers, not just assistants, to multiply output and quality

Squad Collaboration

  • Partner daily with the Architect on API design, data modeling, and system architecture decisions
  • Coordinate with the Shipper on acceptance criteria, testability, and release readiness
  • Participate directly in technical design discussions and tradeoff decisions with the full triad
  • Surface blockers, risks, and dependencies to the squad early and proactively
  • Maintain shared context with squad partners through specifications, documentation, and working demos

WHAT YOU WILL BRING:

Product & Fintech Experience:

  • 5 plus years in product and/or engineering roles within fintech, banking, or financial services
  • Experience working with core banking platforms
  • Strong understanding of complex, regulated environments and financial workflows
  • Proven ability to translate customer and market feedback into measurable outcomes, including direct input from banks, credit unions, and their customers alongside market and competitive signals to iteratively refine features, driving improvements in customer experience, adoption, and institutional growth
  • Ability to connect business goals to technical capabilities and constraints, quickly distinguishing high-impact investments from low-value efforts to keep the work focused on what actually moves the business forward
  • Proven ability to design and build systems and workflows, not just define requirements
  • Track record of shipping working software, not just producing documentation

Technical Fluency:

  • Strong hands-on development capability across front-end and/or back-end technologies
  • Ability to own implementation end-to-end within a product domain
  • Comfort working across the stack as needed to deliver complete features
  • Plus - Understanding of REST APIs, data modeling, and system interactions
  • Plus - Familiarity with, Prisma, Redis, Kafka/SQS, AWS deployment

AI-First Mindset:

  • Active, hands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflows
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools for specification, code generation, and iteration
  • Willingness to experiment with tools and continuously improve AI-augmented building practices
  • Comfort operating in a spec-first, AI-first development methodology

Ways of working:

  • High Agency: Takes ownership of outcomes and drives work forward without waiting for permission or heavy process. Identifies what should be built and builds it.
  • Problem Solver: Thrives in ambiguity. Frames problems clearly, explores solution spaces, and converges on practical approaches quickly.
  • Builder Mindset: Measures success by what ships. Prefers building and iterating over planning and discussing. Gets energy from creating working software.
  • Experimenter: Tests ideas quickly using AI tools and iterates based on results. Explores multiple approaches before committing.
  • Quality Driven: Focuses on correctness, clarity, and long-term maintainability. Treats specifications and code as durable assets.
  • Scale Oriented: Designs with performance, extensibility, and operational realities in mind from the start.
  • Ownership: Takes pride in end-to-end delivery. Does not hand off and walk away — stays accountable through production. Manages other duties as assigned.

THIS ROLE ISN'T FOR:

  • Backlog administrators who manage tickets but do not build
  • Requirements writers who stay removed from how solutions get implemented
  • Developers who wait for fully specified work before starting
  • Individuals uncomfortable with ambiguity, cross-functional ownership, or AI-first workflows
  • Narrowly-scoped specialists who prefer staying in a single function

HOW WE WORK:

Nymbus is a remote-first company. Success in our remote environment requires self-motivation, initiative, and strong personal accountability. Team members are expected to manage their priorities independently, communicate proactively, remain responsive, and participate on camera during virtual meetings.

A strong remote culture requires intentional effort from everyone. We expect team members to engage in our global community, proactively build relationships, participate actively in team and company conversations, seek opportunities to collaborate, and take shared ownership of creating a connected and inclusive remote community including showing up on camera.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

  • Base Salary Range: $125,000 - $140,000 annually
  • Annual cash bonus and equity eligibility
  • Remote work environment
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, including HSA/FSA/DCA
  • 401(k) plan
  • Flexible time-off and company holidays
  • Additional paid volunteer day
  • Supplemental Insurance Programs, including voluntary Life, Accident, Critical Illness, Pet Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programs [EAP]
  • Wellness programs
  • Growth and development programs

Actual compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, role scope, and location.

OUR HIRING COMMITMENTS

As an AI-first company, we embrace the power of AI tools throughout our hiring process. Nymbus remains committed to finding the right match for our teams and candidates alike. While we are excited about the AI tools available to us today, including AI-enabled video interview tools, we remain equally committed to maintaining human involvement and oversight throughout the hiring process.

Nymbus is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Nymbus is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process, including accommodations related to our use of AI tools. If you require an accommodation, please notify your recruiter.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country in which the position is based. This role is currently based in the United States. Not all locations are available for consideration, and locations will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, this posting includes the anticipated base salary range, a general description of available benefits, and the application deadline where required. Actual compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, skills, and location.

By submitting this application, (i) you represent and warrant that you are not subject to or (ii) will disclose any non-compete agreement, restrictive covenant, or confidentiality obligation with a current or former employer that would restrict or prohibit you from performing the duties of the role for which you are applying.

title: Transactions Closing, Analyst
description:

    • Possess expert knowledge of Agent ICA and Team Contracts and understand how these documents affect transaction processing and commission structures.

    • Be agile, flexible, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities.

    • Have proficient knowledge of G Suite; Microsoft Office experience is an advantage.

    • Demonstrate experience working remotely and have a dedicated, professional home-office or workspace.

    • Be comfortable using online platforms, software, and remote collaboration tools, with advanced Trello experience considered an advantage.

    • Have experience coordinating events or group activities, with the ability to manage communication and logistics across multiple participants.
