title: Director/Associate Director, BioPharma Portfolio & Program Management
description:
Summary

Natera’s Pharma Discovery Lab (PDL) bridges R&D execution, analytics, and target and biomarker discovery and development. We are seeking an Director/Associate Director of Portfolio & Program Management to build and run the operational backbone of PDL. The successful candidate will manage a broad portfolio of internal and external projects from inception to execution — managing portfolio metrics, tracking budgets, stage-gating project milestones, coordinating wet lab / dry lab / bioinformatics, RWD analytics resourcing, and managing pharma-partner engagements (biomarker consultation, translational research contracts, and target discovery/co-development projects) from intake through delivery. The role sits at the intersection of science, business, and operations, and reports into PDL leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Internal Project Management - Cross-Functional & Operational Coordination:

-Work closely with lab and IT operations to build out PDL on time and on budget

-Serve as the operational lead for internal cross-functional projects across PDL and the BioPharma BU

-Track deliverables, timelines, and resourcing for PDL pharma contracts and flag risks to scope, budget, or timeline early

-Work with R&D and Commercial project management operations to ensure line of sight for PDL projects and ensure transparency between the organizations

-Coordinate shared infrastructure and CapEx planning between the pharma-facing PDL and the internal R& Lab to maximize ROI on shared equipment and space.

-Coordinate across wet lab (DNA/RNA/digital pathology, biorepository, spatial transcriptomics, single-cell RNA,advanced microscopy), dry lab/bioinformatics, and BD/pharma partnerships teams to keep PDL commitments on track.

-Support resourcing and hiring plans to close identified capability gaps in partnership with lab and discovery leadership.

-Facilitate recurring working groups, client status meetings, and internal review forums; author agendas, minutes, and action-item tracking.

Business & Financial Operations:

-Support go-to-market and monetization structuring for PDL offerings in partnership with BD and finance.

-Maintain program-level budget visibility, resource forecasts, and spend tracking against the approved investment case.

Communications & Stakeholder Management:

-Act as a trusted cross-functional partner to scientific, laboratory, BD, and commercial stakeholders, translating

scientific priorities into operational plans.

-Prepare client-facing materials, KOL engagement support, and scientific narratives supporting regulatory and

commercial adoption of PDL-enabled diagnostics.

-Manage change and communication strategies as PDL scales, including team structure, roles, and process updates as the portfolio grows.

Qualifications:

-10+ years of experience in oncology drug development, translational research, or biomarker/CDx program

management, ideally spanning both pharma and diagnostics/lab-services environments.

-Demonstrated track record leading complex, cross-functional programs — governance operations, portfolio/program

tracking, and stakeholder management at the senior leadership level.

-Experience managing biomarker sample operations, biorepository/biobank workflows, or CDx-adjacent laboratory

operations.

• Financial acumen, including budget forecasting, resource planning, and experience supporting deal or contract

structuring (fee-for-service, milestone, royalty, or licensing models).

• Strong meeting facilitation, executive communication, and document-authoring skills; comfortable presenting to

senior leadership and external pharma partners.

• Ability to navigate ambiguity in a newly-formed business line and build process/governance from the ground up.

• Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, or MS) in a life sciences required; MBA or equivalent business training a plus.

Preferred Experience:

-Prior experience in a biopharma translational medicine, biomarker portfolio, or clinical operations role at a large

pharma or biotech (e.g., governance, franchise-level portfolio management, or business/program management

supporting a $M+ budget).

-Familiarity with liquid biopsy/MRD (e.g., Signatera-type assays), CGP (WES/WTS/WGS), spatial transcriptomics,

single-cell, or digital pathology platforms.

-Experience supporting biomarker strategy for regulatory submissions (IND/IDE, companion diagnostics) or Phase 1–3 clinical trial biomarker operations.

title: UI/UX Researcher & Designer - Canada
description:
As a UI/UX Researcher & Designer at Intelerad, you will play a meaningful role in shaping how clinicians and healthcare professionals interact with our medical imaging products. You will independently own research and design for one or more product areas, partnering with product managers, developers, and end users to turn complex clinical needs and business goals into intuitive, high-quality experiences, from early discovery through to successful release. You will bring a balanced skillset, grounding design decisions in rigorous user research, translating insight into compelling, usable interfaces, and helping raise the quality of UX practice across the team.

Key Responsibilities

Research

  • Independently plan and lead qualitative and quantitative UX research across the product lifecycle, using field studies, direct observation, interviews, workflow and task analysis, usability testing, and surveys to identify opportunities, validate assumptions, and shape product direction.

  • Set research priorities and methodologies for your product area in partnership with product management; recruit participants and moderate sessions with clinicians and other end users.

  • Synthesize research data into personas, journey maps, and actionable insights, and translate findings into design and product recommendations that influence roadmap decisions.

  • Own and evolve our research repository so findings stay discoverable and continue to inform current and future work.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us. We’re working to make mental healthcare more accessible, so more people can get the support they need, when they need it. As the world’s largest online therapy service, we’ve connected millions of people with a network of more than 30,000 licensed therapists-- and we’re not stopping there. As the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As a Full Stack Software Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. You’ll have the opportunity to make an immediate impact, grow alongside the business, and do meaningful work alongside people who care deeply about what we’re building together.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning continuously, and building products that make a meaningful difference. This role is ideal for someone who has delivered multiple challenging projects, takes pride in writing thoughtful, maintainable code, and enjoys both mentoring and learning from teammates.

You'll join an engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and sound technical judgment. We embrace modern engineering practices and thoughtfully adopt new technologies, including AI, to help engineers focus on solving hard problems while keeping human expertise at the center of every decision.

What technologies will you work with?

We use a mix of established and modern technologies to support a platform serving millions of users. As our products evolve, we're continually improving our architecture, modernizing portions of our codebase, and evaluating technologies that help us build secure, reliable, and scalable software.

  • Backend: Linux, nginx, Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Redis
  • Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS
  • Existing technologies you may encounter as we modernize the platform: Twig, Bootstrap, jQuery

We do not expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our environment. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

What will you do?

  • You will develop end to end, owning features from technical design and development through deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement.
  • You will write clean, secure, readable, maintainable, and scalable code.
  • You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners.
  • You will design, integrate, and build internal and external APIs.
  • You will develop new products and features while improving and modernizing existing systems.
  • You will write and optimize SQL queries and design relational database schemas.
  • You will create and maintain complex backend services and algorithms.
  • You will profile, troubleshoot, and optimize new and legacy code.
  • You will build experiences that work across mobile, tablet, and desktop environments.
  • You will contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering practices that improve quality, reliability, security, and developer experience.
  • You will ship thoughtfully and frequently in an agile environment with continuous deployment.
  • You will care about our product, mission, and long-term success, well beyond checking off development tasks.
  • You will thoughtfully use approved AI-assisted development tools to reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, and improve productivity while applying your own engineering judgment to architecture, implementation, security, privacy, and code quality. Engineers remain accountable for every technical decision.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about funding. We have startup energy, with the support and resources of our parent company, Teladoc Health.
  • You will NOT be limited to a narrow set of responsibilities. We encourage employees to contribute ideas, develop new skills, collaborate across teams, and explore opportunities that support both their growth and the growing needs of the business.
  • You will NOT be expected to navigate a culture driven by ego or unnecessary hierarchy. We value respectful collaboration, thoughtful debate, and teammates who are committed to shared success.
  • You will NOT be expected to sacrifice your well-being to make an impact. We work hard and hold ourselves to high standards, all while supporting sustainable ways of working.
  • You will NOT have to wonder why your work matters. The work we do here helps to expand access to mental health care and supports people seeking help when they need it.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. While we embrace the flexibility of remote work, we also value opportunities to bring teams together in person for collaboration and connection. BetterHelp covers approved expenses for company-requested travel, and reasonable accommodations are available for employees who are unable to travel.

Requirements

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Deep understanding of web development concepts and principles.
  • Examples of full-stack projects or significant product features.
  • At least one major demonstrable project that includes frontend code, backend code, and a database.
  • Ability to design, develop, and launch a web application or substantial feature from start to finish.
  • Ability to learn quickly, navigate an established codebase, and build new skills independently.
  • A strong sense of ownership and eagerness to build something meaningful.
  • Five or more years of professional web development experience in any stack, solving challenging problems and implementing new features from scratch.
  • Three or more years of experience with SQL, including relational schema design and complex queries.
  • Familiarity with web application, data, and SQL security best practices.
  • Comfort working outside the abstractions of a framework and understanding what is happening behind the scenes.
  • Experience using Git in a collaborative team environment.
  • Sound engineering judgment and a thoughtful approach to modern development tools, including AI assistants, with appropriate attention to security, privacy, and code quality.

Bonus (Helpful, but not required)

  • Experience working with PHP, Laravel, or the LAMP/LEMP ecosystem.
  • Experience with React or Next.js.
  • Experience modernizing established applications or incrementally replacing legacy systems.
  • Experience working in a startup, growth-stage company, or other fast-moving environment.
  • Experience building products in health care, mental health, or another highly regulated or privacy-sensitive field.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting the growth of other engineers.

Benefits

  • Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
  • Competitive compensation
  • Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
  • The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love
  • Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive

title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend

Gradial is the marketing operations system of work that helps marketers and creatives move from idea to execution faster. Our platform orchestrates across martech stacks, workflows, and people to automate marketing execution, cutting execution time, so marketers focus on the work only humans can do: shaping brands, understanding customers, and creating the work that moves people.

Backed by leading investors, we’re building software that adapts to the user, not the other way around. We move with urgency, operate with ownership, and solve hard problems from first principles. If you want to do ambitious work, take real responsibility, and help define the future of AI-native content operations, you’ll do your best work here.

Gradial is looking for a Staff Software Engineer, Backend to take on some of the largest, most complex and ambiguous technical problems across our product. You’ll own critical systems from loosely defined problem through architecture and production, building the backend foundations that enable Gradial to deliver increasingly powerful AI-driven workflows.

What We Need

  • Proven ability to independently lead large, technically complex projects in fast-moving or ambiguous environments
  • Deep technical expertise in software architecture, distributed systems, algorithms and system design
  • Track record of taking products or systems from 0→1 and making sound architectural decisions with incomplete information

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Search
description:

This is a senior engineering role focused on building and improving a large-scale creator search experience used by thousands of businesses worldwide. You’ll work across the full search stack, from data and indexing pipelines to retrieval, embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving. The role combines distributed systems, multimodal data, vector search, and LLM-powered technologies to solve complex search problems at significant scale. You’ll work with hundreds of millions of profiles and billions of media files, turning messy, high-volume data into useful intelligence. You’ll have substantial autonomy and ownership, taking ambiguous product challenges from discovery through architecture, implementation, production, and measurement. You’ll collaborate closely with data, product, engineering, customers, and leadership teams in a fast-moving, async-first environment.

title: Director of Data Engineering and Analytics

description:
About Us

Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care.

We deliver high-touch, relationship-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care.

We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations.

Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors.

About The Role

We're hiring our first dedicated data leader. You'll build Greenbrook's foundational data layer and data intelligence capabilities. You’ll also build our data team and culture from the ground up.

This is a hands on role. You'll be in the code daily, own what's in production from day one, and build the roadmap from scratch, inclusive of data infrastructure and business logic. You will forecast needs out on the magnitude of quarters and build a team to support delivery.

Success in this role means end to end ownership, from data platform to metric delivery and data team performance. You report to the VP of Growth and Population Health and partner closely with our care teams to improve observability on our care model.

As Greenbrook’s Head of Data & Analytics, you own four things:

  1. The analytics layer: the dbt models and business logic that turn raw data into something usable, and the metric definitions underneath them
  2. Reporting and BI: the reporting layer the whole business reads from, and turning data into findings that our teams can react on to improve performance
  3. Our production systems: you take ownership of systems as they come in-house from our engineering partner, harden them, and keep making them better, with accountability for uptime & system integrity
  4. The data roadmap and team development: You will develop, in partnership with Greenbrook’s functional leaders, a data capabilities roadmap that supports the business. You will translate that roadmap into tactical goals and hiring plans to ensure that the data team is improving observability across all aspects of the business.

Location: New York City strongly preferred (Hybrid). Open to exceptional remote candidates.

What You'll Do

Own the Analytics Layer

  • Build and maintain the dbt models and business logic behind our metrics and workflows in Google Cloud
  • Ensure metric definitions are consistent across every surface at Greenbrook
  • Build the reporting and dashboards the business uses to make decisions

Take Ownership of What's in Production

  • Take on systems as they move from our engineering partner into steady state, and keep improving them.
  • Catch ingestion, pipeline, and logic issues, and resolve them within our SLAs. Build monitoring and uptime reporting.
  • Be the counterpart our engineering partner hands production work to. Resolve what you can and escalate what needs them.

Make the Care Model Better With Data

  • Calculate and report on industry-standard care model measures
  • Turn quality and care-gap logic into triggers and flags inside our clinical workflows, so we act on data during the encounter, not after
  • Sit in the operating meetings where data gets used. Understand the care model well enough to define what we should measure and what good looks like
  • Surface patterns and risks proactively, acting as an early warning system for the business

Build the roadmap and the team

  • Own the end-to-end data roadmap, from data strategy to product delivery and integration. Construct roadmaps on the order of quarters that align with what the business needs
  • Build the data team from scratch. Put together a people roadmap, define sub-competencies based off of our needs, and design levels and competencies
  • Hire and manage data engineers and analysts. Start as a player coach and then hire to supplement skills and ensure delivery against the roadmap

What Success Looks Like

  • Data trust: the business trusts the numbers, and you're ahead of issues rather than behind them
  • Impact: data changes how we deliver care, and our quality measures improve year over year
  • Early warning: leaders hear about emerging problems from you first
  • Coverage: every metric our operating levers depend on has a certified definition and a single source of truth
  • Reliability: systems transitioned to you stay healthy and get fixed fast when they break
  • Scale readiness: new clinics come online with full data coverage from day one
  • Delivery: committed quarterly work ships, and your counterparts, including performance managers and the Head of Population Health, rate the partnership highly

About You

You bring:

  • Strong SQL, dbt, and Python, and you still write production code
  • Hands-on experience with healthcare data, including claims, eligibility, and EHR data and familiarity with interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7
  • Experience with value-based care measurement, such as HEDIS/Stars, HCC/RAF, and utilization
  • The ability to interpret data and explain what it means to clinical and business leaders in plain language
  • Experience owning production systems, including being the person who responds when something breaks
  • Experience building roadmaps, driving alignment on them, and hiring technical talent
  • A bachelor's degree
  • A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork

You'll stand out if you:

  • Have done this at a risk-bearing organization, such as an ACO, MA plan, or at-risk provider, especially where data powered internal clinical software
  • Tie data to workflow: you've moved a quality measure, not just reported on it
  • Challenge the status quo constructively: you'll tell us what's not working and why
  • Get to root cause: you find out why a number is wrong instead of patching the symptom
  • Enjoy both hardening what exists and building what's next
  • Are AI-native: you use modern AI tools in your daily work
  • Drive outcomes: you have a bias for action and close loops without being chased

Why You'll Love Working Here

Make An Impact Every Day

Be part of a mission-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare.

Work That Actually Matters

We're not a volume-driven system, we're accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered.

Build And Grow With Us

We're building more than a company, we're building careers. As we expand, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges.

Strong, Transparent Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary: Remote (U.S.): $160,000–$190,000; New York City: $175,000–$210,000
  • Generous annual performance bonus
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid time off

Application → Initial interview → Skills/experience interview → Values interview → Case Study and Case Study Interview → References

We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. The ideal candidate has a passion for delighting our Pinners and strong intuition about what matters most to their experience. In addition, they must possess a deep understanding of the back-end systems, have worked cross functionally with engineering, data teams, and PMM and understand the interaction effects of introducing qualitatively different content onto the page, and tradeoff dynamics of the ads marketplace.

What you’ll do:

  • Own a vision for new and existing capabilities that help match the right ad to the right Pinner at the right time, and translate problem statements into clear business and technical requirements through focused business requirements documents (BRDs) and product requirement documents (PRDs), including epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, for your area. Create and maintain a clear, prioritized roadmap and requirements backlog, track requirement status from discovery through GA, and ensure traceability from business goals to shipped features. Plan and deliver a sequenced roadmap, aligning with partner teams on architecture, guardrails, and experimentation so launches drive measurable advertiser and Pinner outcomes. Coordinate changes to well-defined components within back-end ads delivery systems (e.g., parts of retrieval, ranking, pacing/budgeting, auction/bidding, quality/diversity guardrails, conversion visibility, forecasting, modeling, or measurement) to meet product requirements.

  • Partner day-to-day with engineering, ML, data science/analytics, design, and research to deliver high-quality features; collaborate with PMM, sales, and policy/integrity as needed for launches. Work closely with PM peers across Ads Quality (e.g., retrieval, ranking, pacing/budgeting, measurement/incrementality, integrity) and with PMs on front-end presentation/components (e.g., modules, formats, surfaces) to manage dependencies, define APIs/contracts for your area, align on experiment design and guardrails, and coordinate GTM and feedback loops. Facilitate roadmap and requirements reviews, keep shared artifacts (roadmap, PRDs, dependency trackers) up to date, and proactively surface risks, decisions, and changes.

  • Build features within our ads bidding and optimization solutions that help advertisers clearly express objectives and align budgets to their business needs, while maintaining a safe, delightful Pinner experience. Deliver scoped improvements from discovery through launch and adoption, instrumenting metrics, writing documentation, and incorporating learnings into subsequent iterations. Define success metrics and acceptance criteria up front, track requirement completion and quality signals post-launch, and use insights to update the roadmap and next set of requirements.

What we’re looking for:

  • 6+ years of experience working as a Product Manager, Engineering Manager, Data Scientist, or related role.
  • Strong evidence of the ability to review and define new products and strategies with back-end products in an ambiguous space and to execute from ideation, roadmaps, to go-to-market.
  • Experience working with Engineering, data, or PMM cross functional teams and a strong ability to empathize with, anticipate the needs of, and effectively collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders.
  • Deep understanding of business metrics and tradeoffs in the contexts of online marketplaces
  • Preferred but not required: Experience with Ads Marketplace and/or Ads Formats
  • Preferred but not required: Direct experience with and fundamental understanding of ads delivery systems.
  • Preferred but not required: Design, run, or analyze marketplace experiments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in France.

This is a senior individual-contributor role embedded directly within a product squad working on complex, high-risk technology domains.
You’ll act as the squad’s technical authority on quality, shaping test strategy, automation, performance, and integration practices.
The role goes beyond test execution, giving you ownership of architecture, quality gates, and the most challenging testing problems.
You’ll work closely with engineering and product teams from the earliest stages, challenging ambiguity before development begins.
You’ll also contribute to broader QA standards, mentor engineers, and lead initiatives that improve testing across the wider organization.
The environment values technical depth, autonomy, continuous improvement, and practical use of modern AI-assisted QA tooling.
It’s an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on reliable, high-scale financial technology as a senior technical leader without moving into management.

Accountabilities

  • Embed fully within an engineering squad, participating in sprint planning, daily standups, reviews, retrospectives, and other ceremonies as a core technical contributor.

  • Define and refine acceptance criteria with Product Owners, identifying ambiguity and quality risks before implementation begins.

  • Own the squad’s test architecture and strategy, determining how unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing work together and identifying coverage gaps.

  • Lead performance and load testing, establishing baselines, evaluating throughput and concurrency limits, and translating findings into actionable engineering improvements.

  • Own the squad’s Definition of Done and quality gates, serving as a final internal quality check before releases progress to staging or production.

  • Design, maintain, and improve automated test suites that remain reliable, readable, maintainable, and effective within CI environments.

  • Triage complex test failures and distinguish flaky tests from genuine regressions, particularly across high-traffic, high-risk, or highly integrated areas.

  • Mentor QA Engineers within the squad and across the wider QA community, raising standards around automation, test design, and engineering practices.

  • Represent the squad in broader QA initiatives and contribute to chapter-wide standards, tooling decisions, onboarding resources, and testing practices.

  • Take ownership of a strategic QA initiative, such as a contract-testing framework, performance-testing toolkit, testing discipline, or AI-assisted test generation workflow.

  • Actively leverage AI and LLM tooling for test case generation, synthetic data creation, regression triage, documentation, and other areas where automation can accelerate QA work.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of QA engineering experience in a software product environment, with demonstrated ownership of testing strategy for complex technical domains.

    • Strong test automation engineering skills, with the ability to write production-quality tests in Java, Python, or JavaScript and build stable, maintainable suites that run effectively in CI.

    • Deep experience with API testing, including REST APIs, contract testing, integration testing, HTTP semantics, and JSON schema validation.

    • Hands-on experience with performance and load testing, including designing tests, interpreting throughput and concurrency results, identifying bottlenecks, and translating findings into engineering action.

    • Strong experience working in Java-based backend environments, with the ability to understand application architecture, read Java code, and create tests that accurately reflect system behavior.

    • High level of technical autonomy and confidence operating without a dedicated QA manager, with the ability to make sound quality decisions and represent QA practices across teams.

    • Proven ability to mentor other QA engineers, improve engineering standards, and lead through technical expertise rather than formal authority.

    • Experience in fintech, payments, or digital financial services is strongly preferred, particularly where reliability and correctness are critical.

    • Familiarity with contract testing tools such as Pact or equivalent approaches within microservices environments is a strong advantage.

    • Mobile testing experience, particularly Android, using tools such as Espresso or Appium, or structured manual testing supported by regression frameworks, is beneficial.

    • Experience contributing to a QA chapter, guild, community of practice, or internal training program is valued.

    • Familiarity with AI-assisted QA workflows, including LLM-based test generation, regression analysis, and synthetic test data creation, is a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work as a senior technical individual contributor with substantial ownership and influence.

      • Full integration into a product squad, with a direct role in engineering decisions and product delivery rather than functioning as a downstream QA resource.

      • Opportunity to shape testing standards, architecture, tooling, and quality practices beyond your immediate squad.

      • Strong platform for technical leadership and mentoring without requiring a transition into people management.

      • Exposure to complex, high-scale fintech and digital financial services systems where software quality has a direct customer and business impact.

      • Opportunity to lead organization-wide QA initiatives and introduce improved testing disciplines and tooling.

      • Flexible European-based working environment with collaboration across international engineering teams.

      • Opportunity to work with AI-assisted testing and modern QA automation practices as part of an evolving engineering environment.

title: Change Management Specialist
description:

Pearce provides technical maintenance, repair, operations, and engineering services for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, backup power generators, battery energy storage systems (BESS), critical cooling systems, and other electrical and mechanical infrastructure across end markets such as renewable energy, telecom, and data centers. title: Field Technician
description:

title: Sr. Program Manager
description:
Join Honeywell’s high-visibility F-35 Navigation Team as a Senior Program Manager and help shape the future of mission-critical aerospace navigation systems. Reporting to the F-35 Program Director, you will lead cross-functional teams responsible for planning and executing DMS projects that sustain the viability of the Inertial Navigation and Tactical Navigation Systems on the F-35, while also supporting Trade Study and Special Test Equipment programs. This role offers meaningful technical complexity, strong executive exposure, and the opportunity to expand into additional Navigation programs across the LM Aero portfolio as capacity permits.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own project scope, objectives, and deliverables while partnering closely with engineering, operations, finance, supply chain, and customer-facing teams
  • Lead matrixed teams to deliver cost, schedule, technical performance, and quality commitments on programs that directly support the F-35 mission
  • Translate business objectives into clear execution strategies, practical plans, and measurable outcomes
  • Build and execute integrated project plans within approved budget, schedule, and resource constraints
  • Adhere to Honeywell’s Integrated Product Delivery & Support (IPDS) process and its phase gate reviews
  • Employ tools and processes for setting and maintaining robust project and technical baselines
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance PM processes and practices
  • Identify and mitigate risks; identify and propose opportunities
  • Engage stakeholders with clear issue summaries, practical options, and timely corrective-action recommendations
  • Communicate complex project, technical, and financial status with confidence to internal leaders, customer stakeholders, and executive audiences
  • Comply with OPSEC, CUI, and export regulations and laws
  • Update Earned Value metrics based on project execution
  • Ensure project billings are submitted on time

WHY JOIN HONEYWELL

  • Work on a globally recognized aerospace platform with mission-critical technical impact
  • Gain visibility with senior leadership, customers, and cross-functional aerospace teams
  • Build your career through professional development, leadership opportunities, and exposure to complex program execution
  • Access comprehensive benefits, including medical, vision, dental, mental health support, paid vacation, and retirement benefits as applicable by region

U.S. CITIZENSHIP REQUIREMENT

Must be a US Citizen due to contractual requirements.

The annual base salary range for this position is $173,000-$216,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell Aerospace considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.

This position is incentive eligible

Must Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field
  • 6+ years of engineering project management experience, ideally in complex technical or regulated environments
  • PMI certification or commitment to obtain certification within 6 months, sponsored by Honeywell Aerospace

We Value

  • Master’s degree in engineering or business
  • Honeywell Global PE/PM Academy graduation
  • Proven business and financial acumen
  • Aerospace background
  • Experience managing complex Government-funded, Cost-Plus programs
  • Demonstrated leadership, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to think strategically while tactically setting and achieving goals
  • Attention to detail and ability to effectively prioritize tasks
  • Adaptability and flexibility to manage changing project requirements
  • Experience with Honeywell’s IPDS process
  • Experience with resource-loaded scheduling and critical path analysis
  • Experience with Earned Value Management
  • Strong technical writing and executive presentation skills
  • Curiosity, passion for innovation, and a commitment to continuous learning
  • Proven track record of successfully completing complex engineering projects on time and within budget
  • Strong leadership and project management skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments
  • Experience in risk management and problem solving
  • Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies

About us:

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space. We operate through three business areas:

  • Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology on board 90% of the world's aircraft
  • Engines & Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep those aircraft flying
  • Control Systems supplies the thermal and motion control systems that support takeoff, landing and the safety of everyone on board

With approximately 58,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, we are also advancing systems for autonomous and supersonic platforms — bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. Explore our businesses:

Benefits:

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

title: Structural Analysis Engineer II
description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Integrated Performance team owns the holistic view of how Terran R comes together, ensuring that every system on the vehicle and ground is capable of achieving our ambitious objectives. The team works across the full launch system, from trajectory design and aerodynamics to reliability analysis and beyond, with direct influence on all parts of the product lifecycle, from conceptual design to post-flight data review. Beyond analysis, team members engage hands-on with hardware and operations, with the mission and authority to drive meaningful programmatic change. With a unique organizational structure, the integrated performance team spans multiple technical domains and embeds directly with partner teams to solve the hardest multi-disciplinary problems. The team operates with a rare scale: large enough to support complex development, yet small enough that individual contributors have meaningful impact.

The Integrated Analysis group is responsible for accelerating Relativity's hardware engineering via advanced analysis and cutting-edge tools. The team works on a variety of complex structures analyses across all of our hardware teams, and develops tools and methods to unlock deeper insight in less time - to reduce weight, improve robustness, and deliver more flight-ready hardware to the launch pad.

About the Role:

  • Drive architecture, sizing, and development of structures like tanks, thrust structures, mechanisms, trays, lines, and other components in collaboration with peer technical teams
  • Build, execute, and validate structures analyses at the component, system, and vehicle level, including relevant tool development and automation
  • Develop novel structural analysis techniques for reusable launch vehicles
  • Direct design and development engineers in the successful application of structural mechanics and analysis principles to achieve system and component requirements
  • Develop and execute tests to support structures development and qualification, including hands-on work like test article integration, instrumentation setup, and data processing

About You:

  • Undergraduate degree in Engineering or a related discipline
  • 2+ years experience in an analysis role
  • Working knowledge of structural analysis and test (from hand calculations to advanced numerical analysis e.g., nonlinear buckling or explicit dynamics)
  • Fundamental knowledge of metallic structure behavior and failure modes like strength, stability, and fatigue
  • Proficiency in a commercial aerospace finite element package (e.g., Nastran, Abaqus) and a relevant pre/post-processor like Femap
  • Proficiency with an engineering scripting language like Python or MATLAB

Nice to haves, but not required:

  • Graduate degree in Engineering or a related discipline
  • 5+ years experience in an analysis role
  • Experience across 1 or more full product lifecycles of an integrated vehicle
  • Graduate education in structural mechanics, computer science, or numerical methods
  • Experience with Abaqus or ANSA

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

$104,000—$156,000 USD

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at accommodations@relativityspace.com.

title: MANAGING DIRECTOR, HEAD OF ADVISOR TRANSITIONS & INTEGRATION
description:
About Cresset

Cresset is a firm built by clients, for clients. As an independent, award-winning multi-family office and private investment firm, we are reimagining the way wealth is experienced. Our purpose is to help ensure that both wealth and life are fully optimized**—integrated, intentional, and aligned with each client’s vision of success.

We provide access to the caliber of talent, ideas, and investment opportunities typically available to the largest single-family offices and institutions. Our approach is personalized, entrepreneurial, and client-first.

Cresset was built to endure. We are creating a 100+ year firm—one focused on delivering an exceptional experience, not only for the families we serve but for the team that serves them. Recognized by Barron’s among the nation’s top multi-family offices,* Cresset is guided by long-term relationships, shared success, and a belief that wealth should serve a life well lived.

Job Description

As Cresset continues to grow through acquisitions, lift-outs, strategic hires, and organic expansion, exceptional onboarding and integration has become a core differentiator of our business. The Managing Director, Head of Advisor Transitions & Integration is responsible for overseeing all aspects of advisor and client transitions from initial due diligence through full integration. This leader will define the strategy, operating model, governance, and execution standards that enable Cresset to deliver a seamless experience for incoming advisors, their team, and clients. While this role is highly strategic, it is equally operational. During periods of advisor onboarding and integration, this leader is expected to be fully embedded with incoming teams, working side by side with advisors, internal Cresset subject matter experts, custodians and 3rd party partners to coordinate resources, remove obstacles, and ensure the successful transition of clients and assets.

This is not a role that leads integrations from afar; it requires a leader who is equally comfortable developing enterprise strategy and rolling up their sleeves to execute alongside the business teams. During onboarding, this leader is expected to be physically present with incoming teams for multiple, consecutive weeks. They will work directly alongside Advisory Practice Management Operations, Client Service, Technology, HR, Compliance, Legal, and other business functions to ensure resources are effectively coordinated and issues are identified and resolved quickly so advisors and their team members can remain focused on serving clients. Success requires calm leadership under pressure, sound judgment, and the ability to rapidly prioritize competing demands while maintaining an exceptional advisor and client experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as an active partner to Corporate Development and Advisory Leadership during due diligence to assess operational readiness, integration complexity, technology environments, organizational structures, client service models, and transition risks.
  • Evaluate advisor operating models and identify opportunities to accelerate integration while preserving the elements that make teams successful.
  • Lead readiness planning by developing preliminary integration strategies, day one operating models, transition timelines, pre-close checklists, break readiness, resource requirements and alignment internally and with partners, and risk mitigation and contingency plans ahead of break.
  • Quickly build trusted relationships with incoming leadership teams and team members to establish confidence and ensure a seamless transition.
  • Support late-stage conversations by clearly articulating the integration approach and advisor experience
  • Identify critical decisions that must be made prior to onboarding and ensure appropriate alignment internally and with incoming team.

Integration Execution & Delivery

  • Lead day-to-day execution of integration plans post-break, including regular integration meetings / discussions and working sessions to track progress and resolve blockers
  • Drive coordination across operations, client service, compliance, technology, reporting, finance, and HR
  • Translate strategic integration plans into detailed workstreams, timelines, and deliverables
  • Serve as the primary operator ensuring milestones, risks, and dependencies are actively managed
  • Identify and resolve issues early, pulling in subject matter experts to triage and stabilize and senior leaders as needed to support
  • Establish clear ownership and accountability across all integration workstreams

Advisor & Client Transition

  • Own the advisor transition experience from signed agreement through post-integration stabilization.
  • Serves as the face of Cresset's transition experience for incoming advisors and teams across the following activities: Advisor onboarding strategy, client transition planning, asset migration coordination, custodian conversion planning, communications, readiness and scenario planning, training coordination, service model implementation, and issue escalation and resolution.

Systems & Data Integration

  • Oversee integration of technology tools (ex. Salesforce, Addepar, custodian platforms, and financial planning)
  • Coordinate data migration, validation, and reconciliation
  • Identify and resolve system gaps, inconsistencies, and reporting issues

Investment & Platform Integration

  • Support review and mapping of portfolios, securities, and alternative assets
  • Coordinate platform approvals and transitions with investment and operations teams
  • Address custodial setup, pricing discrepancies, and account structure issues

Process & Playbook Development

  • Develop and refine integration playbooks and best practices
  • Conduct post-mortems, document lessons learned and continuously improve workflows
  • Support scaling the integration function as deal volume grows

title: Associate Director - Math and Language Arts
description:
The AoPS Academy Associate Director at our Pasadena campus is responsible for assisting with the campus’s administrative and logistical operations, teaching weekly math and language arts classes, and partnering with the Campus Director on the hiring and training of part-time staff and teachers. This role is a full-time, year-round position which includes the academic year and summer.

This may be the right job for you if you are looking to build on your management and leadership experience, have strong subject knowledge in language arts and have outstanding classroom management skills. The ideal candidate will have exceptional communication skills and pedagogical instincts to not only teach our advanced curriculum, but also coach and collaborate with other instructors.

If you’re an ambitious and creative individual with a passion for education, we want to talk to you!

The Associate Director will:

  • Teach the AoPS curriculum in dynamic, participation-oriented classes, actively engaging students and expertly managing the classroom.
  • Participate in the hiring and training of part-time staff.
  • Assist with the campus’s administrative, logistical, and customer service operations.
  • Support campus enrollment and sales efforts by meeting with prospective families to assess a student's academic ability, determine overall fit, and explain the benefits of our program.
  • Counsel current students and families as needed to provide student support.
  • Helps design and implement campus community building activities in order to build a strong campus culture and support high student retention.

The ideal candidate has:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, strongly preferred to be in education or a field closely related to their subject area
  • Advanced degree related to subject area preferred
  • Strong content knowledge in their subject area
  • Minimum 1-year teaching experience, with experience working with advanced K-12 students preferred
  • Strong organizational and priority management skills

Work Schedule

AoPS Academy is an after-school program; most of our classes and family meetings occur during the evenings and on weekends. As such, it's expected that Associate Directors work a nontraditional schedule during the academic year. Summer hours typically shift to a more standard Monday to Friday work schedule.

Benefits

This position includes a hiring range of $75,850 – $77,663. Here are some things you can look forward to:

  • Impact: Opportunity to work closely with motivated students, develop leadership and management experience, work with a team of passionate educators in pursuit of our shared mission.
  • Culture: Work and collaborate with an organization filled with builders and life-long learners who strive to discover, inspire, and train the great problem solvers of the next generation
  • Benefits: Multiple options for Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Future Planning: 401(k) with company match
  • Quality of Life: PTO Plan and supportive leadership
  • Ease of Transition: Relocation bonus for candidates living outside the greater area.

About AoPS Academy

  • AoPS Academy is a year-round educational enrichment program.
  • Since 1993, AoPS has prepared hundreds of thousands of students for college and career success through engaging curriculum, expert online instruction, and local, in-person academies.
  • AoPS Academy is a program of Art of Problem Solving, a global leader in K–12 advanced education. AoPS Academy brings the AoPS methodology to small live physical and virtual classrooms. We offer a world-class curriculum in math, science, and language arts for students in grades 1-12, creating an environment where exploration meets challenge, right in your local neighborhood. Students learn in small classes led by accomplished instructors and collaborate with a peer group who share their passion for learning.
  • We have opened 20+ academies across the nation since 2016 and are still growing!

Please note that in order to be considered for this position you must be legally authorized to work in the US. We are unable to offer sponsorship, including STEM-OPT and H-1B.

title: Junior Gameplay Programmer
description:
Mob Entertainment is a startup multimedia studio that is best known for our hit indie horror game "Poppy Playtime". This franchise is one of the hottest new properties in gaming, and our team is naturally expanding as our ambition expands. To give a taste of our brand's popularity, more than 100 billion YouTube views of Poppy Playtime related content have occurred since the game's launch 4 years ago.

Mob Entertainment is seeking a Junior Gameplay Programmer to join the team supporting development of one of our upcoming Unreal Engine projects. This role is designed for an engineer early in their career who is eager to grow their skills in gameplay programming while working alongside senior engineers and designers on real production systems.

You'll work under the guidance of senior gameplay and systems engineers, implementing and iterating on gameplay features, fixing bugs, and supporting the team's day-to-day production needs. This is a hands-on learning role, ideal for someone who wants to build a strong foundation in Unreal Engine while contributing meaningfully to a shipping title.

Responsibilities

  • Implement gameplay features and mechanics in Unreal Engine using both C++ and Blueprints, under the direction of senior engineers.
  • Assist in building and iterating on core gameplay systems (player interactions, triggers, pickups, simple AI behaviors, UI hookups, etc.).
  • Identify, reproduce, and fix bugs reported by QA, designers, or other team members, tracked through Jira.
  • Support senior engineers by prototyping mechanics, testing systems, and turning rough ideas into working in-engine examples.
  • Collaborate closely with designers to implement and tune gameplay behavior based on feedback and playtesting.
  • Write clean, readable code and follow the team's existing coding standards and conventions.
  • Participate in code reviews as both a reviewer and a recipient of feedback, using reviews as a learning opportunity.
  • Document your work (setup steps, how systems function, known issues) to help the wider team understand and extend it.
  • Take part in sprint planning, stand-ups, and design discussions, and communicate blockers or risks early.
  • Continuously build your understanding of Unreal Engine, gameplay programming patterns, and the studio's codebase.

Required Qualifications:

  • Basic working knowledge of C++.
  • Basic working knowledge of Unreal Engine Blueprints.
  • Basic familiarity with Unreal Engine (project structure, actors/components, basic editor workflow).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to ask questions and learn from senior team members.
  • Good communication skills and comfort working in a collaborative, fast-paced team environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Basic experience with multiplayer/networked gameplay concepts in Unreal (replication, RPCs, or similar).
  • Experience at a professional game studio (internship or full-time), OR a degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Personal or student projects built in Unreal Engine (game jams, portfolio projects, mods).
  • Familiarity with source control tools (e.g., Perforce).
  • Passion for horror games, narrative-driven experiences, or the Poppy Playtime franchise specifically.
  • Interest in growing toward ownership of larger systems over time.

Performance Expectations:

  • Deliver small-to-medium gameplay features and fixes reliably and on time.
  • Grow steadily in independence, requiring less guidance over time.
  • Write code that senior engineers can review and extend with minimal friction.
  • Actively contribute to team knowledge-sharing and documentation.

Salary Range:

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Final compensation within the applicable salary range will be determined based on factors such as the applicant’s experience, qualifications, and work location.

San Francisco, CA; New York City, NY; Los Angeles, CA; Seattle, WA; Boston, MA; & Seattle, WA DC Metropolitan Areas: $78,000 - $100,000 USD annually

Benefits:

Mob Entertainment offers the following benefits to all eligible U.S.-based full-time employees: profit sharing; medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) matching; FSA/HSA; paid time off; sick time; holidays; and parental leave.

title: Independent Contractor: Technical Trainer (Automotive)
description:
Independent Contractor Opportunity\: Technical Trainer (Automotive)
Location\: Richmond, BC (On-Site as Required)
Contract Type\: Independent Contractor (Incorporated Consultant)
Term\: 12 months, with potential extension
Rate\: $70 - $90/hour
Hours\: Approximately 30 – 40/week

Mercedes-Benz Canada is seeking an experienced Technical Trainer to provide technical training services supporting our dealership network and service partners across Canada.

This opportunity is intended for an incorporated contractor operating an independent business. The successful contractor will provide services under a service agreement and will be responsible for invoicing Mercedes-Benz Canada for approved hours worked. The contractor will be responsible for all applicable taxes, statutory remittances, insurance, and business expenses.

Assignment Overview
The Technical Trainer will develop and deliver programs that equip technicians to diagnose, repair, and maintain increasingly complex Mercedes-Benz vehicles, including Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle (PHEV), and Electric Vehicle (EV) platforms.

The assignment includes classroom instruction, hands-on workshop facilitation, curriculum development, and technical expertise to strengthen technician capability across the Mercedes-Benz network.

The contractor will also support the day-to-day operation and organization of the Richmond Training Academy.

Key Responsibilities

Training Delivery 60%

  • Deliver engaging instructor-led technical training in classroom and workshop environments.
  • Facilitate training for technicians at various certification levels, including apprentices, maintenance technicians, master technicians, and shop foremen.
  • Deliver training to Mercedes-Benz service partners where required.
  • Adapt training approaches to different learning styles and technical skill levels.

Curriculum Development 15%

  • Develop, update, and maintain technical training materials, presentations, lesson plans, and learning resources.
  • Support training readiness for new vehicle launches, technologies, and repair procedures.
  • Ensure training content aligns with Mercedes-Benz global standards and certification pathways.
  • Incorporate emerging technologies including EV systems, ADAS, high-voltage systems, advanced diagnostics, and oscilloscopes.

Technical Expertise 10%

  • Serve as a technical subject matter expert for vehicle systems, diagnostics, and repair processes.
  • Provide recommendations that support technical capability, repair quality, and diagnostic efficiency.
  • Maintain current knowledge of Mercedes-Benz products, service information, repair procedures, and industry developments.

Training Facility Support 10%

  • Assist with the operation and organization of the Richmond Training Academy.
  • Support maintenance and management of training tools, equipment, simulators, and training vehicles.
  • Promote and maintain safe working practices within all training environments.

Coordination and Travel 5%

  • Support training logistics and scheduling activities as required.
  • Travel to dealerships and satellite training locations to deliver training services.
  • Participate in regional or global train-the-trainer programs when applicable.

title: IT & Security Operations Intern
description:
About the role

StudyFetch is hiring an IT & Security Operations Intern to keep our people, devices and systems running as the team grows. You'll work directly with our engineer who owns IT, access and compliance, and you'll be the first person new hires meet when they need a laptop, an account or help getting unblocked.

StudyFetch builds AI-native learning products: StudyFetch for students and Honen for workforce training. We move fast, we're adding people every month, and we lean hard on AI tooling to get work done. This role is hands-on from week one.


What you'll do

title: 2027 Project Management Summer Internship
description:
Advanced Space | 2027 Summer Internship | Onsite

We’re going to the Moon. Think you’ve got what it takes?

About the Role

At Advanced Space, we're enabling humanity's return to the Moon and building the technologies that will take us to Mars and beyond. We're looking for 2027 Project Management Summer Interns to join our Project Management team and gain hands-on experience supporting the execution of complex aerospace and space-related projects.

As a Project Management Intern, you'll work alongside experienced technical staff who will provide mentorship and guidance throughout your internship. You'll contribute to projects involving schedule development and maintenance, project cost and budget tracking, technical risk management, project planning, and cross-functional coordination while learning how project management practices support real aerospace missions.

This internship is ideal for students interested in aerospace project execution, program management, technical project planning, risk management, and working at the intersection of engineering and business. You'll have the opportunity to apply your technical and organizational skills while gaining experience supporting projects from early development through execution.

About Advanced Space

Advanced Space exists to enable the sustainable exploration, development, and settlement of space through innovative software, mission services, and technology solutions. As the owner and operator of NASA's CAPSTONE™ mission and the Prime Contractor for AFRL's Oracle mission, we're helping shape the future of cislunar exploration while supporting commercial, civil, and national security customers.

Our team combines deep technical expertise with an entrepreneurial mindset. We move quickly, collaborate across disciplines, and empower every engineer to make meaningful contributions. If you're passionate about solving challenging problems and seeing your work fly in space, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Actually Do

Support aerospace project execution initiatives.

Work alongside technical staff on summer projects focused on project planning, schedule management, cost tracking, risk management, and project execution.

Gain hands-on experience with project management practices.

Support projects involving:

  • Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) projects focused on developing and maturing new technologies
  • Full end-to-end mission development
  • Project schedule development and maintenance
  • Project budget and cost monitoring
  • Technical risk identification and tracking
  • Project management process development and improvement
  • Cross-functional coordination between technical teams and project stakeholders

Learn aerospace project execution practices.

Gain exposure to:

  • Project planning and execution
  • Schedule development and tracking
  • Cost and budget management
  • Technical risk management
  • Requirements definition and tracking
  • Project documentation and reporting
  • Project management software and tools
  • Aerospace systems development and mission execution

Share your work and findings.

Present project results through technical reports, presentations, documentation, and discussions with members of the Project Management team.

Who Thrives Here

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in Project Management, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, or another related technical discipline.
  • You have a foundational understanding of aerospace project formulation and execution.
  • You have completed coursework relevant to aerospace systems, systems engineering, spacecraft design, orbital mechanics, project management, or a related field.
  • You can identify obvious technical risks by reviewing project documentation or participating in technical reviews.
  • You understand the importance of clear and concise requirements definition.
  • You have familiarity with project scheduling concepts or project schedule software tools.
  • You enjoy solving complex problems and organizing information to support successful project execution.
  • You work well in a team environment and are comfortable collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • You are curious, organized, collaborative, and excited to learn from experienced aerospace professionals.

Bonus Points if You Have Experience With

  • Project management or project scheduling software
  • Microsoft Project, Jira, or similar project management tools
  • Aerospace or spacecraft development projects
  • Systems engineering processes
  • Risk management or risk tracking
  • Requirements management
  • Cost estimation or budget tracking
  • SBIR or government-funded research and development programs
  • Mission development or systems integration
  • Technical writing or project reporting
  • Previous internship, research, or project experience in aerospace

Success is Measured By

  • Successfully contributing to meaningful aerospace project management and mission development efforts.
  • Applying technical and organizational knowledge to support real-world aerospace projects.
  • Developing project management skills through mentorship and hands-on experience.
  • Supporting accurate project schedules, cost tracking, risk management, and project documentation.
  • Communicating project information and findings clearly through presentations and documentation.
  • Building a stronger foundation for a future career in aerospace project management, program management, or technical project execution.

Why Join Advanced Space

  • Gain hands-on experience supporting real missions to the Moon and beyond.
  • Work alongside engineers solving some of the most challenging problems in space exploration.
  • Apply classroom knowledge to real aerospace projects.
  • Receive mentorship and guidance from experienced technical staff.
  • Be part of a team that's passionate about delivering innovation to orbit—and beyond.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive internship compensation: $20-29/hour
  • Housing stipend
  • Mentorship and guidance from technical staff
  • Opportunities to contribute to research projects directly tied to active space missions
  • Collaborative work environment at our Westminster, Colorado headquarters

Eligibility Requirements

  • Applicants must be a U.S. person (U.S. citizen, permanent resident/green card holder, or protected individual).
  • Must be able to work in-person at our Westminster, CO office.
  • Applications will be evaluated and interviewed on a rolling basis. Final deadline: Monday, November 2, 2026 at 11:59 pm MT.

Advanced Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

title: RF Test Technician
description:
Who we are

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We’re hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

What you will be doing

Neros is seeking an RF Test Technician to support the hands-on setup, execution, and maintenance of RF test systems used in engineering qualification, production acceptance, and flight testing. This role is ideal for someone who is strong with soldering, harnessing, lab work, and careful test execution, and who wants to grow familiarity with RF measurement equipment in a fast-moving hardware environment.

Responsibilities

  • Build, modify, and maintain RF test setups, coax assemblies, RF switch harnesses, cables, fixtures, and supporting lab hardware
  • Support qualification and acceptance test plan execution by preparing equipment, following procedures, collecting results, and escalating issues
  • Perform soldering, rework, connector installation, harness assembly, labeling, and other hands-on lab tasks
  • Help prepare RF hardware and test equipment for flight tests and support setup, troubleshooting, and teardown in the field
  • Operate or learn to operate basic RF measurement equipment such as spectrum analyzers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, attenuators, RF switches, and test radios
  • Keep lab and production test areas organized, repeatable, and ready for fast execution

You should have the following

  • 1+ year of hands-on technician, electronics lab, production test, RF lab, avionics, robotics, drone, automotive, or related hardware experience
  • Strong soldering skills, including wire, connector, and small electronics rework
  • Experience building cables, harnesses, coax assemblies, or electromechanical test fixtures
  • Comfortable following test procedures, recording results, labeling hardware, and keeping work organized and repeatable
  • Basic familiarity with electronics lab tools such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, crimpers, heat shrink, and hand tools
  • Familiarity with RF measurement equipment is preferred; ability and willingness to quickly learn spectrum analyzers, VNAs, signal generators, RF switches, and power meters is required
  • Willingness to support flight tests, production test setups, and hands-on lab work as needed
  • High attention to detail and strong ownership of build quality, cable routing, connector integrity, and test setup reliability

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in an RF lab, antenna lab, wireless test environment, drone company, aerospace company, or production test environment
  • Experience with SMA / MMCX / U.FL / N-type connectors, coax routing, RF shielding, attenuators, and RF switch matrices
  • Experience supporting field tests, flight tests, or outdoor hardware test operations
  • IPC soldering certification, J-STD-001 experience, or similar electronics workmanship training
  • Basic Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or test automation exposure

US Salary Range

$92,500-129,500 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are considered part of Neros' total compensation package.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
