title: Product Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Engineer based in Spain.

This is a high-ownership Product Engineer role within a small, senior team building foundational technology for the commercial insurance market.
You will take complex problems from an initial thesis through design, implementation, deployment, and continuous iteration, with broad freedom over how solutions are built.
The role spans the full product and engineering stack, from user interfaces and APIs to data models, background jobs, and AI-powered workflows.
You will work with large-scale, structured insurance data to create intuitive products used by brokers, lenders, underwriters, and other insurance professionals.
AI is deeply embedded in the engineering workflow, and you will be expected to use modern coding agents and AI tooling to increase development speed and leverage.
With no traditional Product Manager or QA layer, Product Engineers are expected to exercise strong product judgment, challenge assumptions, and own outcomes rather than simply execute specifications.
This is an opportunity to join an ambitious, highly empowered environment where your work can have immediate impact on a rapidly evolving financial infrastructure market.

Accountabilities

  • Own product features end to end, from defining scope and identifying dependencies through development, deployment, customer adoption, and iteration.

  • Work across the full technology stack as needed, including user interfaces, APIs, data models, backend services, background jobs, and infrastructure integrations.

  • Transform complex, data-heavy insurance information into clear, intuitive interfaces that professionals can rely on in their daily workflows.

  • Lead a product squad and take responsibility for a defined area of the platform, with ownership aligned to your strongest technical and product instincts.

  • Identify dependencies on adjacent teams or systems, clearly define what is required, and proactively address potential blockers.

  • Use AI coding tools, agents, and agentic workflows extensively to accelerate development and increase engineering leverage.

  • Contribute to model evaluation and benchmarking initiatives, helping determine which AI models and approaches are appropriate for customer-facing and data-sensitive workflows.

  • Develop and improve internal evaluation harnesses where they can outperform or provide greater reliability than direct model calls.

  • Apply strong product judgment to challenge unclear requirements, simplify solutions, prioritize high-value work, and discontinue features that do not deliver sufficient value.

  • Work closely with Product Designers and Infrastructure/Platform specialists to turn ambiguous problems into effective, production-ready experiences.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve the product, engineering workflows, and underlying data systems.

  • Take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for detailed specifications, established processes, or predefined implementation plans.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 2 years of experience building and shipping production web applications; candidates with significantly more experience are equally welcome, with demonstrated ability to take problems through to completion being the key consideration.

    • Advanced, hands-on daily experience using modern AI development tools such as Codex, Claude Code, or comparable agentic coding workflows.

    • Strong full-stack engineering capabilities and comfort moving between frontend, backend, data, and supporting systems.

    • Experience working with data-heavy products such as dashboards, analytics platforms, pricing systems, operational tools, or other applications involving complex datasets.

    • Strong product instincts and a clear bias toward shipping useful solutions rather than optimizing for process.

    • Ability to independently understand ambiguous problems, make sound technical and product decisions, and drive work through to production.

    • High autonomy and self-direction, with the ability to make meaningful progress without extensive processes or management layers.

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills within a small, senior, highly empowered team.

    • Willingness to take ownership of both technical implementation and product outcomes.

      • Nice to have:

      • Experience in insurance, financial services, or another regulated and data-intensive industry.

      • Exposure to real-time data products, market indexes, benchmarks, pricing platforms, or similar systems.

      • Experience working at an early-stage company where you have taken on multiple responsibilities across product and engineering.

      • Interest in financial markets, market structure, pricing transparency, or data infrastructure.

      • Experience working with AI evaluation, benchmarking, model selection, or production AI systems.

title: Principal Datacenter Technologist
description:
About Graphcore

Graphcore is a leading innovator in artificial intelligence computing. We develop hardware, software, and data center infrastructure that provide the specialized processing and systems capabilities needed to advance AI while improving the efficiency required for broad adoption.

As part of SoftBank Group, Graphcore works alongside companies developing advanced technologies. Our teams bring together AI researchers, silicon designers, hardware and software engineers, and systems architects to solve complex technical problems across the computing stack.

The Opportunity

As Principal Datacenter Technologist, you will turn new platform architectures into repeatable operating models for Graphcore's AI data centers. You will lead the technical definition of how Graphcore introduces, deploys, services, and sustains new compute, networking, storage, memory, power, and cooling technologies at scale.

Working within Advanced Architecture, you will connect platform design with data center engineering and site reliability operations. You will define new-product-introduction workflows, readiness criteria, diagnostics, and cross-functional handoffs so that new systems can move from architecture through deployment with clear ownership, supportability, and operational feedback.

What You Will Do

  • Own the technical operating model and new-product-introduction framework for new hardware and infrastructure technologies entering Graphcore data centers.
  • Define end-to-end workflows for installation, configuration, validation, deployment, service, repair, upgrade, and sustained operation across the product lifecycle.
  • Translate architecture requirements into data center readiness criteria covering software, firmware, compute, networking, storage, memory, rack integration, power, cooling, space, and site operations.
  • Create clear runbooks, interface definitions, ownership models, acceptance criteria, and escalation paths that align architecture, engineering, data center, and site reliability teams.
  • Lead operational readiness reviews and identify gaps in tooling, diagnostics, telemetry, serviceability, spares, documentation, and training before deployment.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex platform issues, ensuring that teams collect the right logs, telemetry, failure evidence, and environmental data to support root-cause analysis and disposition.
  • Define and guide the deployment of automated diagnostic and telemetry systems that identify systemic hardware, software, quality, handling, and site-integration issues across the fleet.
  • Establish quality and operational metrics for new technologies, analyze field trends, and feed findings back into architecture, design, supplier, and deployment decisions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional resolution of issues spanning hardware, firmware, software, networking, storage, facilities, and site operations, with clear owners, decisions, and follow-through.
  • Provide technical leadership, review implementation plans, mentor engineers, and communicate readiness, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to engineering and operations leaders.

What You Will Bring

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in information technology, computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Extensive experience in data center infrastructure build, infrastructure operations, platform deployment, or related technical fields, including leadership at Principal, Staff, or Lead Engineer scope.
  • Demonstrated experience defining processes, workflows, and readiness criteria for new-product introduction in large-scale data center or infrastructure environments.
  • Broad systems knowledge across compute, networking, storage, memory, firmware, operating systems, racks, power distribution, cooling, and data center operations.
  • Hands-on Linux experience, including scripting or automation used to collect diagnostics, telemetry, configuration, and health information.
  • Experience with failure analysis and validation of AI compute, server, networking, or other complex data center equipment.
  • Ability to define telemetry, diagnostic coverage, quality metrics, and fleet-level signals that distinguish product issues from deployment, handling, or environmental problems.
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary technical work across architecture, hardware, software, facilities, data center engineering, and site reliability teams without relying on direct authority.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce precise technical workflows and explain operational risks and decisions to engineering leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

These qualifications are helpful, not required. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every preferred qualification.

  • Experience leading data center engineering, platform introduction, or infrastructure readiness initiatives.
  • Experience operating or supporting high-density AI or high-performance computing systems at fleet scale.
  • Experience with telemetry platforms, automated diagnostics, serviceability tooling, and quality metrics for compute and networking equipment.
  • Experience with rack-as-a-system architectures, direct liquid cooling, high-power racks, and the operational controls required for safe deployment and service.
  • Experience working with suppliers, field-service teams, manufacturing, or logistics partners on equipment lifecycle, quality, repair, or failure-disposition processes.

title: Physical Design Engineer
description:
About the Company:

At SK hynix memory solutions, we're at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, developing advanced memory solutions that power everything from smartphones to data centers. As a global leader in NAND flash technology and memory solutions, we drive the evolution of advancing mobile technology, empowering cloud computing, and pioneering future technologies. Our cutting-edge memory technologies are essential in today's most advanced electronic devices and IT infrastructure, enabling enhanced performance and user experiences across the digital landscape.

We're looking for innovative minds to join our mission of shaping the future of technology. At SK hynix memory solutions, you will be part of a team that's pioneering breakthrough memory solutions while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability. We're not just adapting to technological change – we're driving it, with significant investments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and eco-friendly solutions and operational practices. As we continue to expand our market presence and push the boundaries of what's possible in semiconductor technology, we invite you to be part of our journey to creating the next generation of memory solutions that will define the future of computing.

About the Role

Join our Physical Design (SoC Integration) team responsible for delivering high-performance SoC designs from RTL to GDS. As a Sr. Staff Physical Design Engineer, you will lead physical implementation efforts for advanced-node designs, driving critical blocks through synthesis, placement, CTS, routing, and signoff. You will work closely with front-end, DFT, power, and analog teams to optimize PPA (Power, Performance, Area) while ensuring silicon success. This role requires deep hands-on expertise across the full physical design flow as well as leadership to mentor junior engineers and define methodologies for the team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead physical design implementation from synthesis through GDS for high-performance blocks or full-chip SoC designs in advanced process nodes (7nm, 5nm, 3nm)
  • Execute and optimize synthesis, placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), and routing using industry-standard P&R tools (Synopsys ICC2/Fusion Compiler or Cadence Innovus)
  • Drive timing closure and signoff using PrimeTime (PT), including advanced analysis such as SI, AOCV/POCV, crosstalk, and ECO implementation
  • Perform RC extraction using StarRC or Quantus and ensure strong correlation between extraction and STA results
  • Own physical verification signoff with Mentor/Siemens Calibre, resolving DRC, LVS, ERC, and antenna violations in complex FinFET layouts
  • Conduct power integrity analysis using Ansys RedHawk(Redhawk-SC), including static/dynamic IR drop and EM analysis; implement power grid and decap optimizations
  • Develop and maintain physical design flows and automation scripts (Tcl, Perl, Python), mentor junior engineers, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve tapeout schedules

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred)
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC physical design with proven tapeout success
  • Expert-level proficiency in synthesis, placement, CTS, and routing using Synopsys or Cadence P&R tools
  • Deep knowledge of static timing analysis (STA) and PrimeTime signoff, including multi-corner/multi-mode closure
  • Demonstrated experience with physical verification using Calibre (DRC, LVS, ERC) and IR drop/EM analysis using RedHawk

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at 5nm or 3nm process nodes with FinFET and multi-patterning design rules
  • Familiarity with low-power design techniques including UPF, clock gating, multi-Vt, and voltage islands
  • Strong programming skills in Tcl, Perl, and Python for flow automation and data analysis
  • Knowledge of ECO implementation and clock reconstruction (CRPR, useful skew) methodologies
  • Experience leading or mentoring a team of physical design engineers on complex SoC projects
  • Exposure to memory-centric interfaces and systems such as SSD SoC, HBM, or HBF (High Bandwidth Flash) base die designs (a plus, not required)
  • Familiarity with chiplet and die-to-die (D2D) interconnect technologies, including Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express (UCIe) or equivalent D2D PHY protocols (a plus, not required)

BASE COMPENSATION: $160,000/yr - $220,000/yr

REGARDING COMPENSATION:

SK hynix memory solutions America Inc. offers you the opportunity to apply your skills to exciting projects while working with innovative teams. Our compensation package is complimented by a generous benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance and a company 401(k) match, as well as cafeteria, onsite gym and much more. If you are motivated by technical challenges, we offer a collaborative work environment that encourages career growth.

The salary offered to a selected candidate will be tailored based on several factors, including the location, job grade, relevant knowledge, skills, and experience. We also take into account the internal equity among our current team members to ensure fairness and competitiveness.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
Mob Entertainment is a startup multimedia studio that is best known for our hit indie horror game "Poppy Playtime". This franchise is one of the hottest new properties in gaming, and our team is naturally expanding as our ambition expands. To give a taste of our brand's popularity, more than 100 billion YouTube views of Poppy Playtime related content have occurred since the game's launch 4 years ago.

Mob Entertainment is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to join the team supporting development of one of our upcoming Unreal Engine projects. This role is designed for a highly experienced engineer who can own core gameplay and engine-adjacent systems end-to-end, set technical direction, and raise the bar for the rest of the engineering team.

You'll be responsible for architecting, building, and maintaining systems and frameworks that other programmers and designers build on top of. This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role for someone who can solve ambiguous, complex problems with minimal oversight, while also actively mentoring and leveling up less experienced engineers.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain core gameplay systems and frameworks used across the project, ensuring they're robust, scalable, and easy for other engineers to extend.
  • Develop and maintain custom Unreal Engine plugins to support project-specific tooling and gameplay needs.
  • Architect and implement multiplayer/networked gameplay systems, including replication strategy, network optimization, and debugging desync or performance issues.
  • Own technical decisions for systems under your purview, balancing production needs, performance, and long-term maintainability.
  • Partner with designers and gameplay programmers to translate gameplay and design intent into well-structured, tunable systems.
  • Identify architectural risks and technical debt early, and drive solutions before they become blockers.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code review, pairing, and ongoing technical guidance; help grow the team's overall skill level.
  • Debug and resolve complex, systemic issues reported during production, QA, and post-launch, using Jira to track and prioritize work.
  • Document system architecture, workflows, and design patterns in Confluence to support team-wide understanding and onboarding.
  • Participate in and help lead code reviews, design discussions, and sprint planning as part of a cross-functional development team.
  • Stay current on systems programming and Unreal Engine best practices, and proactively bring forward opportunities to improve existing systems.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in game development, or 2+ shipped AAA titles, with a focus on systems or gameplay programming.
  • Strong knowledge of systems and framework design (data-driven architecture, modular/extensible system design, gameplay frameworks).
  • Strong gameplay programming knowledge, with a track record of shipping gameplay systems in Unreal Engine.
  • Experience designing and building Unreal Engine plugins.
  • Solid, hands-on multiplayer/networked gameplay experience (replication, RPCs, network optimization, debugging networked issues).
  • Excellent proficiency in both C++ and Blueprints within Unreal Engine.
  • A genuine passion for mentoring other engineers and helping them grow.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Some Unreal Engine core/engine-level knowledge (engine source, low-level systems beyond typical gameplay code).
  • Prior leadership experience (leading a team, owning a discipline, or acting as a technical lead on a project).
  • Experience shipping systems that scaled or evolved significantly beyond MVP.
  • Familiarity with performance profiling and optimization within Unreal Engine.
  • Familiarity with source control tools (e.g., Perforce) in a game production pipeline.
  • Passion for horror games, narrative-driven experiences, or the Poppy Playtime franchise specifically.

Performance Expectations:

  • Deliver stable, scalable systems that are easy for others to use and extend.
  • Reduce team-wide technical risk by identifying and resolving architectural issues proactively.
  • Visibly raise the skill level of the engineering team through mentorship.
  • Own technical implementation end-to-end with minimal supervision.
  • Contribute to the overall efficiency, maintainability, and velocity of the project.

Salary Range:

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Final compensation within the applicable salary range will be determined based on factors such as the applicant’s experience, qualifications, and work location.

San Francisco, CA; New York City, NY; Los Angeles, CA; Seattle, WA; Boston, MA; & Seattle, WA DC Metropolitan Areas: $136,000 - $177,000 USD annually

Mob Entertainment offers the following benefits to all eligible U.S.-based full-time employees: profit sharing; medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) matching; FSA/HSA; paid time off; sick time; holidays; and parental leave.

Effectively manage multiple priorities.

title: Crisis Fuel Coordinator (seasonal)
description:
Position Summary

The Crisis Fuel Program Coordinator provides day-to-day operational leadership for the Crisis Fuel program. Working under the direction of the Program Director, the Crisis Fuel Coordinator manages program contracts and compliance, coordinates state-level relationships, supervises crisis fuel program staff, coordinates with seasonal fuel program staff, and ensures that services are delivered efficiently, equitably, and in accordance with grant and program requirements. This is a full-time, non-exempt, and seasonal position (running from approximately November through May).


Primary Functions

Program and Contract Management

  • Establish, oversee, and periodically review contracts and agreements for Crisis Fuel, 3SVT, Warmth, VLITE, and other assigned fuel programs in coordination with the Program Director.
  • Maintain detailed, current knowledge of program contracts, grants, and funding agreements to provide effective guidance to Family Services and other agency staff on meeting the obligations of each award.
  • Review program recordkeeping to ensure that eligibility rules, documentation procedures, and authorization protocols are followed in accordance with state, federal, and funder requirements.
  • Submit spending requests to the Finance office in a timely manner, follow up as needed, and inform the Program Director of any problems or concerns.
  • Provide periodic reports on program expenditures, grant balances, and budget constraints, and alert the Program Director to existing or potential shortfalls.
  • Oversee and ensure coverage of emergency fuel assistance services during agency closures or other emergencies.

State-Level Liaison and Partner Coordination

  • Serve as SEVCA's primary point of contact with the State for fuel and related programs, attending bimonthly state-level meetings and managing all relevant correspondence between SEVCA and State partners.
  • Network with community partners to create and maintain emergency fuel funds through donations, grants, and other fundraising activities.
  • Collaborate with and make referrals to other SEVCA programs and community service providers to ensure clients receive the most appropriate and comprehensive services available.
  • Promote positive public awareness of SEVCA and its services through presentations, workshops, and community education, with prior approval from the Program Director for public communications.

Staff Supervision and Coverage

  • Supervise seasonal Crisis Fuel program staff, providing direction, support, and performance input in coordination with the Program Director.
  • Participate in fuel and other Family Services staff meetings and training as needed.

Compliance and Documentation

  • Prepare, maintain, and submit all necessary paperwork and documentation in a timely manner, including client records and grant compliance materials.
  • Work with the Data Coordinator to ensure accurate and timely data entry, reporting, and compliance documentation across fuel and related programs.
  • Provide programmatic data and reports as needed by the Program Director, Finance, or other designated staff.

Client Services

  • Determine eligibility for and provide direct services to program applicants as needed and appropriate, including financial assistance, case management, advocacy, and information and referral.
  • Identify client needs and mobilize resources to address them, recognizing that direct client contact is limited and is not the primary function of this role.

Additional Duties

  • Attend trainings and meetings held by SEVCA or partner organizations as appropriate and requested by the Program Director or Executive Director.
  • Perform all other duties as needed and appropriate that are consistent with the goals of Family Services and SEVCA's mission, as requested by the Program Director or Executive Director.

Job Standards / Accountability

The Crisis Fuel Coordinator will be evaluated on the following outcomes:

  • Fuel and related program contracts are current, properly documented, and in compliance with all state, federal, and funder requirements.
  • State-level relationships are actively maintained, and SEVCA's obligations as a program partner are met reliably and on time.
  • Program expenditure reports are accurate, timely, and communicated clearly to the Program Director.
  • Seasonal staff are appropriately supervised and supported, and fuel program operations run smoothly throughout the program's season.
  • Client records and grant compliance documentation are complete, accurate, and submitted on schedule, in coordination with the Data Coordinator.
  • Client interactions are handled with professionalism, dignity, and sensitivity consistent with SEVCA's mission and core values.
  • Communication with the Program Director, Finance, and other stakeholders is proactive, clear, and timely.

Working Conditions

This is a full-time, seasonal position. The program season (approximately October through May) involves high-volume program management, staff coordination, and client-facing responsibilities. The end of the season involves administrative close-out, planning, and preparation for the following year. The role requires regular travel within the service area for outreach, meetings, and state-level engagements, as well as occasional statewide and regional travel. Some work outside of normal business hours may be required to serve clients, attend meetings, or provide coverage during emergency closures.

title: AML Regulator
description:

Branch: Regulation and Identity Services

AML Regulator | Help shape the future of AML/CFT regulation in Aotearoa

New Zealand’s AML/CFT system is changing – and we are looking for people who want to help shape what comes next.

Join Te Tari Taiwhenua | Department of Internal Affairs and help protect New Zealand’s financial system from money laundering and terrorism financing.

We are building a modern regulator who is more sophisticated, more risk-based, curious, analytical and comfortable exercising judgement. One that uses data, technology and AI to see patterns earlier and targets regulatory effort where it matters most. To help us achieve this, we need people who understand risk, ask the right questions and work constructively with businesses to achieve better regulatory outcomes.

As an AML Regulator you will focus on supervision, investigations and enforcement. You will work across a diverse range of sectors, using information, intelligence and evidence to understand where the greatest risk sits and determine the right regulatory response. You’ll undertake compliance reviews, engage directly with regulated entities and contribute to investigations and other regulatory interventions.

We’re looking for a modern regulator who:

  • thinks about risk and outcomes, not simply whether a box has been ticked
  • is curious and knows how to dig beneath the surface
  • can analyse complex information and turn it into sound regulatory judgement
  • understands that effective regulation can involve education, engagement, influence and enforcement
  • communicates confidently and can have constructive but challenging conversations
  • is comfortable working with legislation and applying it to real-world situations
  • wants to continuously improve how regulation is delivered.

Your work will help ensure serious risks are identified and addressed, regulatory decisions are evidence-based and proportionate, and the reporting entities have clear expectations.

You don’t necessarily need to have spent your career in AML/CFT. Experience in regulatory compliance, investigations, fraud, audit or law could give you many of the skills we need. AML/CFT experience is desirable.

Why now?

DIA has moved to become New Zealand’s sole AML/CFT regulator, creating an opportunity to strengthen regulatory capability and build a highly effective, responsive and risk-based regulator.

title: IPS Activity Coordinator
description:
IPS Activity Coordinator

Xiente | Philadelphia, PA
Youth & Family Services | Full-Time
Pay: $20.00/hour | $41,600 annually

Make an Impact. Empower Youth. Strengthen Community.

Are you creative, energetic, and passionate about helping young people thrive?

Xiente is seeking an IPS Activity Coordinator to develop and lead engaging activities for youth ages 10–18 participating in our Intensive Prevention Services (IPS) program.

In this role, you’ll create meaningful experiences that help young people build confidence, strengthen social-emotional skills, develop positive relationships, and connect with their communities. We’re looking for someone who can bring creativity, consistency, compassion, and positive energy to every interaction.

What You’ll Do

Plan Engaging Youth Activities

  • Create and maintain a structured calendar of activities aligned with IPS program goals.
  • Design fun, age-appropriate, and trauma-informed programming.
  • Develop activities focused on life skills, teamwork, social-emotional learning, and positive youth development.
  • Adapt programming based on the interests, abilities, and individual needs of participating youth.

Engage & Mentor Youth

  • Facilitate individual and group activities in a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment.
  • Build positive, trusting relationships while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries.
  • Encourage participation and model positive behavior and healthy peer interactions.
  • Help youth build confidence, communication skills, and meaningful connections.

Collaborate with Families & the IPS Team

  • Work closely with IPS Case Managers, counselors, and program leadership.
  • Ensure activities support participants' individual service plans and overall program goals.
  • Communicate with families to promote involvement and reinforce youth progress.
  • Participate in team meetings, trainings, and interdisciplinary planning.

Documentation & Program Support

  • Maintain accurate attendance records, activity logs, and progress notes.
  • Ensure required documentation meets applicable program, city, and state requirements.
  • Track youth participation and engagement to support program improvement.
  • Help maintain a safe, organized, and welcoming environment for youth.

Build Community Connections

  • Partner with community organizations, recreation centers, cultural institutions, and service providers to expand programming opportunities.
  • Help coordinate off-site activities, special events, and guest speakers.
  • Represent Xiente professionally when working with community partners.

What We’re Looking For

Education & Experience

  • Associate Degree in Social Work, Psychology, Education, Human Services, or a related field OR equivalent experience working directly with youth in community-based or prevention programs.
  • Previous experience facilitating youth activities, recreational programming, workshops, or groups.
  • Experience working with at-risk youth, families, or community organizations.

Skills

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Creative and enthusiastic about youth programming.
  • Able to engage and build rapport with youth ages 10–18.
  • Organized, dependable, and comfortable managing multiple responsibilities.
  • A strong communicator and collaborative team member.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, community-based environment.
  • Skilled in maintaining documentation and accurate records.
  • Able to support crisis prevention and de-escalation using trauma-informed and restorative approaches.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Philadelphia neighborhoods and youth-serving systems.
  • Experience with Social-Emotional Learning (SEL), restorative practices, or trauma-informed care.
  • Bilingual Spanish/English strongly preferred.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to assist with off-site programming, if applicable.

Compensation

$20.00 per hour
Equivalent to $41,600 annually

Why This Role Matters

The IPS Activity Coordinator is more than an activity planner. You’ll have the opportunity to become a consistent, positive presence in the lives of young people while creating experiences that encourage growth, resilience, connection, and success.

If you're passionate about working with youth and want your creativity to make a difference in Philadelphia communities, we encourage you to apply and join Xiente's Youth & Family team.

title: Manufacturing Associate (Tuesday - Thursday | 4:00PM to 4:30AM)
description:
Unique 3rd Shift Opportunity!


Work just 3 days a week on a 12-hour schedule.

  • Pay: $18.00/hour base pay, plus a $2.00/hour shift premium on all 3rd shift hours, for $20.00/hour total
  • Schedule: 3 days per week, 12-hour shifts
  • Training: 2–3 weeks of paid training on 1st shift, then you move to your regular 3rd shift schedule


At National Trade Supply, the Manufacturing Associate is a versatile, cross-trained production team member who plays a direct role in the assembly, quality, and packaging of the air and water filtration products we manufacture. This is a single role that spans the full breadth of our manufacturing floor — from assembling filter components and installing gaskets, to printing and applying frame labels, inspecting finished units, and boxing completed product for shipment. Every Manufacturing Associate is expected to develop competency across all functions and rotate between stations as production needs require.


We are seeking reliable, detail-oriented team members who take pride in producing a quality product and understand that every station on the floor matters. Success in this role requires the ability to learn multiple processes, follow standard work instructions precisely, maintain consistent output throughout a full shift, and hold yourself and your work to a high standard — regardless of which station you are assigned to that day.


At National Trade Supply, we operate with a shared set of core values that guide how we work and grow together: Grit, Bias for Action, Critical Thinking, Self-Awareness, and Operational Excellence. These principles shape our culture, influence our decisions, and define what it means to succeed on our team.


Key Responsibilities


Assembly


  • Perform hands-on assembly of air or water filtration products at assigned production stations in accordance with standard work instructions and cycle time targets.
  • Follow established build sequences and techniques for each product type, ensuring every unit is assembled completely and correctly before moving downstream.
  • Maintain a consistent output rate throughout the full shift, keeping pace with line flow and daily production targets.
  • Notify the team lead promptly of any tooling issues, material shortages, or build concerns that could affect production.
  • Perform changeovers on the assembly line as required, transitioning between product types efficiently and in accordance with standard work instructions.

Pre/Post Assembly


  • Install O-rings onto water filters, including the caps, heads, and inserts, ensuring proper seating on every component.
  • Glue caps onto the carbon and confirm a secure, complete bond before the unit advances downstream.
  • Load carbon into canisters in accordance with standard work instructions and fill specifications.


Gasket Installation


  • Install gaskets on air filter frames in accordance with approved work instructions, ensuring proper alignment, seating, and compression on every unit.
  • Inspect gasket condition prior to installation — reject and set aside any gaskets that are torn, deformed, or otherwise non-conforming.
  • Verify that gaskets are fully and evenly seated before the unit advances to the next production stage.
  • Maintain awareness of gasket inventory levels at the workstation and communicate replenishment needs to the Material Handler or team lead before running out.


Frame Printing


  • Operate the frame printer to produce and apply product identification labels to air filter frames in accordance with work instructions and labeling specifications.
  • Verify that each label is printed correctly, including the correct product number, description, and any required markings, before applying it to the frame.
  • Apply labels accurately and consistently — properly aligned, fully adhered, and free of bubbles, creases, or misplacement.
  • Perform basic printer maintenance tasks including label stock loading and print head cleaning; notify the team lead of any printer errors or malfunctions.
  • Maintain label stock levels at the workstation and request replenishment as needed.


Boxing & Quality Control


  • Inspect assembled and finished filtration products against approved quality standards throughout the shift, checking for defects in construction, cosmetic appearance, labeling, gasket installation, and packaging.
  • Identify, segregate, and tag non-conforming units; communicate quality concerns to the team lead promptly and do not allow defective product to advance downstream.
  • Compare finished units against approved reference samples or visual quality standards at the workstation.
  • Raise concerns about recurring defects, process drift, or unclear quality standards to the team lead immediately rather than making independent judgment calls on borderline product.
  • Box completed filtration products in accordance with approved packaging specifications, including correct product orientation, insert placement, and box configuration.
  • Verify product count, product number, and label accuracy before sealing each box.
  • Seal, label, and stage completed boxes in designated outbound areas in a neat and organized manner.
  • Maintain packaging material levels at the workstation and communicate replenishment needs before running out.


Water Spider


  • Gather and stage raw materials, components, and supplies at each production workstation based on the daily production schedule, ensuring assembly, gasket installation, frame printing, and boxing & quality control all have what they need before the line starts.
  • Replenish materials at each station throughout the shift to keep production running without interruption, anticipating consumption rates rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Coordinate with team leads and associates to confirm material requirements, identify shortages early, and communicate any supply issues that could affect the production schedule.
  • Maintain organization of staging areas and material flow paths in accordance with 5S standards, keeping aisles clear and materials properly labeled and located.


Safety & Housekeeping


  • Adhere to all established company safety policies and procedures, with special attention to PPE requirements and safe handling practices at all times.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe workstation throughout the shift in accordance with 5S standards.
  • Report any safety hazards, near-misses, equipment issues, or injuries to the team lead immediately.
  • Clean and prepare the workstation at shift end to ensure the incoming shift can begin without delay.


The Outcome We Are Seeking


Success in this role looks like a manufacturing floor where every station is covered, every unit that leaves the line meets our quality standard, and every associate can be trusted to do the right thing — regardless of which function they are assigned to that day. The Manufacturing Associate is the core of our production operation, and the consistency they bring to assembly, pre/post assembly, gasket installation, frame printing, and quality control & boxing is what makes our products something customers can rely on.

A strong Manufacturing Associate is cross-trained, dependable, and quality-driven. They follow the process as written, raise concerns before defects multiply, and show up every day ready to contribute — no matter the station. Over time, they build the breadth of knowledge that creates real value on the floor and opens the door to advancement.


Performance will be measured by:


  • Output rate and adherence to production cycle time targets across all assigned stations
  • Product quality and defect rate at point of assembly, gasket installation, frame printing, and quality control & boxing
  • Label accuracy and frame printing compliance
  • Packaging accuracy including product count, orientation, and carton labeling
  • Safety compliance and PPE adherence
  • Attendance, reliability, and punctuality
  • Workstation cleanliness and adherence to 5S standards
  • Cross-training progress and demonstrated competency across all manufacturing functions


Why Choose Us?


  • Competitive hourly pay and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being.
  • A Tuesday - Thursday schedule (4:00 PM – 4:30 AM) that gives you four-day weekends every week.
  • Cross-training across all manufacturing functions — building skills that make you more valuable every week.
  • A clear path to grow — our tier-based pay structure rewards skill development, cross-training, and consistency.
  • A stable, team-oriented environment where your work directly impacts the products customers rely on.
  • A culture that’s always striving to improve — we invest in the people who show up and do the work.
  • Clear expectations, defined processes, and team leads/supervisors who are there to support your success.

title: SDET Intern
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

QUALITY ASSURANCE

What We Do

The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers.

SDET INTERN

What You'll Do

Epic Games Art Ops team is looking for a smart, creative Software Development Engineer in Test Intern. Art Ops is the team that builds the tools, pipelines, and Al workflows our artists use for game development and emerging tech every day. This role focuses on testing those internal tools and frameworks; you'll embed with our team of engineers and technical artists to help design and build everything from Cl pipelines, test plans, and integration tests for our web apps to checks that tell us how well our Al tools are performing.

In this role, you will

  • Write test plans for new tools and features, then turn them into automated tests
  • Help design and build the test framework our team will use going forward, with our engineers reviewing your code
  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for our web apps and pipeline tools
  • Test how Al tools and workflows perform when new models are released, and help build ways to measure their performance
  • Support weekly release testing and turn repeated manual checks into automated tests
  • Investigate test failures, determine why a test broke, and share results with the team
  • Use Al-assisted tools to help run, write, and triage tests, and review what they produce

What we're looking for

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • Comfortable writing code in at least one modern OOP language such as Python, C++, or C#, through coursework or personal projects
  • Basic understanding of software testing, such as unit and integration testing
  • Familiarity with a version control system
  • Interest in Al for content and code generation
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to confidently collaborate with senior team members and take feedback on technical topics and features
  • Willingness to dive into new things and drive them forward
  • A personal project repository or demo portfolio is required
  • Some experience with test frameworks like Jest, Pytest, or Playwright, Cl systems like GitHub Actions, or Al evaluation tools like LangChain or DeepEval is desired
  • Exposure to art tools such as Unreal Engine, Maya, or Houdini, or interest in how artists work is highly desired

This internship has a flexible start date in 2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit epicgames.com/earlycareers. This is going to be Epic!

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

We are looking for a Senior Compliance & Investigations Counsel to join our team. Reporting to the Head of Corporate Compliance and Responsibility, you will take ownership of building our legal investigations function while advancing critical compliance activities, from partner risk management to our training and awareness efforts. This is a key role on a growing team with a mission to embed integrity across our global operations. The position can be hybrid at our Santa Clara, CA headquarters or fully remote in the US.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Build our legal investigations function by collaborating closely with key stakeholders in our Finance and People & Culture teams to fine-tune investigation procedures and identify use cases for technology and AI to drive greater transparency, efficiency, robustness and awareness among employees, senior management and the Board
  • Take ownership of embedding our “speak up” & “listen up” values more deeply into our corporate culture while ensuring compliance with requirements of evolving global whistleblower laws and regulations
  • Manage the day-to-day operation and governance of our AI-enabled channel partner due diligence program, build additional analytics capabilities to monitor channel partner risk, and collaborate closely with our partners team to efficiently address legal compliance risks that may arise as the enterprise channel partner program continues to grow
  • Oversee and drive continuous improvement of our controls around gifts & business courtesies and conflicts of interest, including by fine-tuning how we utilize our compliance technology and developing of training and guidance approaches that optimize employee awareness
  • Revolutionize our formal training and awareness program to better measure and maximize impact while addressing concerns created by legacy approaches (such as learner seat time and administrative burden)

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner with a strong bias for action, operating with integrity and seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for internal and external stakeholders and anchoring decisions in solving real-world problems.
  • You are driven by innovation, bringing curiosity to complex technical challenges and leveraging technology to build secure, scalable solutions.
  • You are resilient and adaptable, maintaining composure in high-pressure situations and guiding teams through complexity with a steady hand.
  • You champion simplicity by distilling complex regulatory and technical concepts into clear, actionable plans and precise communication.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 7+ years practicing as an attorney with significant experience in corporate investigations and demonstrated expertise in anti-corruption law and practice
  • Demonstrated experience in designing investigations or other compliance processes and implementing them using technology solutions
  • Deep familiarity with the theory and practice of driving compliance within large corporate organizations and proficiency in global legal regimes addressing legal compliance obligations
  • Basic familiarity with business processes relevant to public technology companies, including channel sales, financial and other reporting, procurement processes, systems development and maintenance, and talent acquisition and management
  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • A blend of experience working for either a law firm or as a government prosecutor and in an in-house role, preferably for a technology company
  • Subject matter expertise or demonstrated proficiency in competition law, fraud, conflicts of interest, AI governance, government procurement or contracting regulations or related compliance areas
  • Proven ability to provide pragmatic, risk-calibrated legal advice that aligns with the commercial goals and operational realities of a fast-paced, publicly-traded technology company
  • Demonstrated history of integrating AI tools to enhance legal workflows and compliance monitoring

title: McKinney-Vento ESL (English to Speakers of Other Languages) Part-time – On-Call Interpreter
description:
Definition

Under general supervision provides interpretation and communication support to assist Gaston County Schools staff in effectively communicating with families who have limited English proficiency, particularly families who may be experiencing homelessness, housing instability or at risk of homelessness. The position supports communication during the McKinney-Vento identification and eligibility process, enrollment, school visits, home visits, telephone calls, meetings, and other interactions with families as needed. The interpreter may assist with communication even when a family has not yet been determined eligible for McKinney-Vento services, including helping staff communicate with families and gather information needed to determine whether the family may qualify for services.

Duties and Responsibilities
• Provide interpretation between school personnel and families with limited English proficiency.
• Assist the McKinney-Vento Liaison and school staff in communicating with families regarding housing situations, McKinney-Vento eligibility, barriers, resources and educational needs.
• Assists families with limited English proficiency with the school enrollment process.
• Participate in home visits, school visits, telephone calls, meetings, and other family contacts when interpretation is needed.
• Schedules/translates for conferences as requested by parent, or school staff.
• Uses technology to participate in video conferencing.
• Assists parents in using technology to participate in video conferencing, understanding district procedures, forms and available services.
• Interpret information related to enrollment, eligibility, school placement, transportation, attendance, records, and available community or school resources.
• Assists parents in accessing and utilizing learning platforms (ie: Canvas, Schoology, etc.).
• Respond to requests for interpretation on an as-needed/on-call basis.
• Complete required documentation related to interpretation services.
• Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
• Knowledge of the language(s) needed to communicate effectively with families served by the district.
• Knowledge of confidentiality requirements and appropriate handling of sensitive family and student information.
• Strong oral communication and active listening skills.
• Ability to accurately interpret information between English and the required language(s) without adding, omitting, or changing meaning.
• Knowledge of community resources and services that may be available to families experiencing housing instability.
• Ability to translate verbal messages to written documents and written documents to verbal messages in both Spanish and English.
• Ability to adapt language based on the level of the student and parent.
• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships as necessitated by work assignments.
• Requires the ability to deal with people beyond giving and receiving instructions.
• Must be adaptable to performing under stress and when confronted with persons acting under stress.
• Must be sensitive to cultural differences among individuals and groups of persons.
• Requires the ability to utilize a variety of technology to communicate with parents.
Physical Requirements
• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear. The employee occasionally is required to sit and stoop, kneel, or crouch.
• Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
• The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Must be able to perform light work exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or up 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
• Must possess the visual acuity to prepare data, work with record processes, and do extensive reading and research.

Minimum Training and Experience
• High School diploma.
• Minimum of 48 semester hours (earned at a Regionally Accredited College/University recognized by NCDPI accrediting agencies); official transcript required.
• Demonstrated ability to speak, understand, read and write fluently in both English and Spanish; or any equivalent combination of training and experience which provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities. Demonstration may be required as part of the interview process.
• Must score at the Advanced Mid or Superior ACTFL ratings for reading, writing, listening, and speaking.
• Preferred Social Worker Experience

This Position Reports Directly to: McKinney Vento Liaison

Salary: Grade 62

title: Campervan Fleet Expert - APAC
description:
ABOUT US

Indie Campers is the leading campervan marketplace, on a mission to make road trips accessible to everyone. With a fully digital booking experience and a customer-first approach, we’ve hosted 300,000+ travellers from 170+ countries and delivered over 1M+ nights on the road.

We offer short-term RV rentals, long-term subscriptions, and the option to buy one of our campervans. We’re a fast-growing, tech-driven company looking for top talent to help build the future of road travel.

THE ROLE

As a Campervan Fleet Expert, you will be the central point of contact and knowledge for the vehicles in your area. This role is key to optimizing fleet performance, reducing repair costs, and standardizing damage management:

  • By documenting and centralizing the information about mechanical, body, and electrical issues you will promote regional and local autonomy in van repairs.
  • You will own the development, implementation, and monitoring of SOPs for damage identification and assessment, repair approvals.
  • You will spread the van knowledge across the organization, creating lost lasting impact in customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
  • Based in Sydney, you will report to the Asset Strategy Director and collaborate with Regional Directors, Depot Managers, and Regional and Local teams.

WHAT WILL YOU WORK ON?

  • Develop and refine comprehensive damage trees and RV manuals for all relevant stakeholders: customers, local teams in contact with the customer, and technical troubleshooting for depot and customer support agents.
  • Act as the regional authority on troubleshooting, delivering specialized training to mechanics and repair technicians and resolving escalated technical tickets.
  • Serve as an On-Trip Support Expert, providing critical real-time assistance and technical guidance to customers during their rentals.
  • Manage the validation and approval of non-standard repair quotes and complex maintenance estimates.
  • Build and deploy guidelines that increase regional and local autonomy in van repairs.
  • Deliver training sessions to Asset Specialists and local teams to improve repair assessment capabilities.
  • Ensure accurate and timely reporting of repair decisions and costs across systems and stakeholders.
  • Monitor and improve cost efficiency by standardizing repair assessment and approval criteria.
  • Drive change management initiatives and address resistance to new repair processes at the regional level.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
  • 2-4 years of experience as cost estimator or quote approval for mechanical, body repair, or electrical issues.
  • In-depth knowledge of vehicle mechanics, including how cars and vans operate.
  • Understanding of market standards for vehicle repairs and maintenance.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess repair costs and optimize decision-making.
  • Resilience and ability to handle stakeholder pushback, particularly in cost-related discussions.
  • Fluent in English (mandatory)

THE INDIE COMMITMENT!

  • A fast-growing, dynamic environment where you make an impact
  • Career growth in Field Ops + potential moves to Lisbon, Mexico City, or Manila
  • Continuous training and coaching
  • Free road trips across Europe, North America, and Oceania

title: PT/TSM O2O Digital Channel Application Expert
description:
[ENG]

Mercedes-Benz Korea is looking for an O2O Digital Channel Application Expert to support and continuously improve our customer-facing digital channels.

As part of Mercedes-Benz’s global digitalization strategy, our digital landscape connects online customer journeys with offline sales and service processes. Following the successful implementation of Retail of the Future in Korea, this position will focus on the stable operation, continuous improvement, and further development of our mobile applications and online sales channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take product ownership for customer-facing mobile applications, including Mercedes-Benz Circle and the Mercedes-Benz mobile application ecosystem.
  • Manage application backends and integrations with Mercedes-Benz digital services.
  • Support the Mercedes-Benz Online Store as an entry channel to the Sales Transaction System, including integration with internal and external systems.
  • Manage application integrations involving APIs, Single Sign-On, Customer Identity and Access Management, and user entitlement handling.
  • Plan and coordinate mobile application releases through the Apple App Store and Google Play, including push notifications and WebView-based functionality.
  • Coordinate Online Store releases and local market configurations with central product teams.
  • Test and accept new releases, including content, stock visibility, pricing display, and customer journey functionality.
  • Monitor application stability, crash rates, store ratings, customer adoption, and recurring incidents.
  • Monitor the online sales funnel, including customer inquiries, direct checkout, deposit payments, and transaction transfers.
  • Manage local solution providers, including scope definition, contract management, sourcing, quality assurance, and KPI monitoring.
  • Work with cybersecurity and governance teams to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities.
  • Coordinate first, second, and third-level application support and ensure high-quality operational support.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize online sales, customer engagement, and Online-to-Offline business processes.
  • Design and implement applications, automated workflows, and data-driven solutions.
  • Collaborate with local business teams, regional colleagues, central product teams, and external partners.
  • Plan, track, and report project activities and local budgets.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable company policies, data protection, information security, and documentation requirements.

Product owner for digital channel applications

  • Manage local suppliers in terms of SoW definition, contract management, sourcing plan, quality assurance, KPI
  • Supports security vulnerability finding and its mitigation by collaboration with ISO and regional security team.
  • Maintain application documents up to date in planningIT platform and align with IT governance team for standardization and holistic report
  • Strive for a best of class support organization to our customers (business and dealers) on basis of the outsourced 1st, 2nd and 3rd level support by continuous Knowledge transfer and lessons learned
  • Run hypercare and post go-live stabilisation for the apps, monitor crash rate, store ratings and adoption, and follow up the root cause of recurring incidents
  • Monitor the Online Store funnel (Contact Me, Direct Checkout, deposit payment) and follow up on failed transfers to STS and payment incidents
  • Test and accept Online Store releases and local market configuration (content, stock visibility, pricing display) together with the central team EMH team

Business Analyst & Digital Solution Maker (training on the job)

  • Identify and analyze potential process optimization within your area of online sales, customer engagement and O2O processes in close cooperation with the business partners
  • Design to be processes and data flow to achieve maximum efficiencies with regard to throughput time, quality, needed resources, etc.
  • Deliver solutions, design and create apps and automating workflows
  • Analyze and visualize data in context of an app or automated workflow
  • Implement and manage apps and automated workflows
  • Coordinate the needed internal stakeholders
  • Continuously improve your skill set
  • Keep the tooling and the automated workflows up to date when the underlying platform changes, and migrate them when a platform is discontinued

Others

  • Align with IT but also business management about roadmaps, target processes, KPIs, KT concept etc.
  • Monitor and report the progress of the agreed milestones to eMC and SteCo
  • Management of suppliers relationships including safeguarding contractual IT supplier relationships are in place and incorporate Mercedes-Benz standard clauses to ensure data protection and data security
  • Adhere to all relevant Mercedes-Benz policies, procedures and standards in order to achieve quality and compliance of solution and services
  • Ensure that project documentation in the relevant repositories is kept up-to-date

[KOR]

Mercedes-Benz Korea는 고객 대상 디지털 채널을 지원하고 지속적으로 개선할 O2O Digital Channel Application Expert를 채용하고 있습니다.
Mercedes-Benz의 글로벌 디지털화 전략의 일환으로, 당사의 디지털 환경은 온라인 고객 여정과 오프라인 영업 및 서비스 프로세스를 연결합니다.
한국에서 Retail of the Future를 성공적으로 도입한 이후, 본 포지션은 모바일 애플리케이션 및 온라인 판매 채널의 안정적인 운영, 지속적인 개선 및 추가 개발에 중점을 두게 됩니다.

주요업무

  • Mercedes-Benz Circle 및 Mercedes-Benz 모바일 애플리케이션 생태계를 포함한 고객 대상 모바일 애플리케이션의 제품 오너십을 담당합니다.

  • API, Single Sign-On, Customer Identity and Access Management 및 사용자 권한 처리를 포함한 애플리케이션 연동을 관리합니다.
  • 푸시 알림 및 WebView 기반 기능을 포함하여 Apple App Store 및 Google Play를 통한 모바일 애플리케이션 릴리스를 계획하고 조율합니다.

  • 애플리케이션 안정성, 크래시율, 스토어 평점, 고객 이용률 및 반복적으로 발생하는 인시던트를 모니터링합니다.

  • 업무 범위 정의, 계약 관리, 소싱, 품질 보증 및 KPI 모니터링을 포함하여 로컬 솔루션 제공업체를 관리합니다.
  • 사이버보안 및 거버넌스 팀과 협업하여 보안 취약점을 식별하고 완화합니다.
  • 1차, 2차 및 3차 애플리케이션 지원을 조율하고 높은 수준의 운영 지원 품질을 보장합니다.
  • 온라인 판매, 고객 참여 및 Online-to-Offline 비즈니스 프로세스를 최적화할 수 있는 기회를 식별합니다.

  • 로컬 비즈니스 팀, 지역 담당자, 중앙 제품 팀 및 외부 파트너와 협업합니다.

  • 적용 가능한 회사 정책, 개인정보 보호, 정보보안 및 문서화 요건을 준수하도록 합니다.

Product owner for digital channel applications

  • SoW 정의, 계약 관리, 소싱 계획, 품질 보증, KPI 측면에서 로컬 공급업체 관리

  • planningIT 플랫폼 내 애플리케이션 문서를 최신 상태로 유지하고, 표준화 및 통합 보고를 위해 IT 거버넌스 팀과 협업

title: Hut Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Hut Coordinator

Location: Las Vegas, NV


Department: Operations / Deployment


Reports To: Project Manager / Deployment Manager


Position Type: Full-Time


Pay Scale: $20.00 - $32.00 / hour (Depending on Experience)


Position Overview

We are seeking an organized, technically skilled, and proactive Hut Coordinator to oversee, synchronize, and execute our infrastructure deployment projects in Phoenix, AZ. In this role, you will serve as both the operational backbone and hands-on technical lead for our fiber and network hub installations ("huts").


You will manage the end-to-end site deployment lifecycle-from initial permitting, utility coordination, and vendor tracking to hands-on equipment rack-and-stack, structured cabling, DC power, and fiber testing. The ideal candidate blends project coordination discipline with inside plant (ISP) technical expertise to ensure sites transition seamlessly from raw ground to fully active, standards-compliant network hubs.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Buildout Coordination

  • Oversee the end-to-end hut deployment process, ensuring sites transition seamlessly from raw ground to active, fully operational network hubs.
  • Coordinate critical infrastructure prerequisites, including power utility drop requests, electrical hookups, and civil site preparation.
  • Navigate local permitting and zoning requirements, submitting documentation and tracking municipal approvals to prevent deployment delays.

Schedule, Vendor & Financial Tracking

  • Maintain complete oversight of project critical paths, identifying potential bottlenecks early and implementing mitigation strategies to hit deployment deadlines.
  • Track project milestones, manage deployment schedules, and provide clear operational visibility to leadership.
  • Handle vendor accruals and track field expenditures to ensure work completed is accurately accounted for prior to formal invoicing.
  • Monitor contractor and vendor deliverables to ensure work meets construction, safety, and contract standards.

Communication & Site Documentation

  • Serve as the primary liaison between internal market teams, field technicians, contractors, municipal entities, and executive leadership.
  • Work directly from installation documentation, architectural drawings, and Method of Procedure (MOP) guidelines.
  • Maintain comprehensive project logs, site buildout records, labeling, and data documentation to guarantee full operational visibility and accuracy.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 2+ years combining project coordination/management with hands-on Inside Plant (ISP), Central Office, Data Center, telecom, or civil infrastructure deployment experience.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Hands-on experience with equipment rack-and-stack, structured cabling (CAT5/6, fiber), and cable management systems.
  • Familiarity with grounding, bonding, basic DC power concepts, and fiber/copper testing tools.
  • Practical understanding of utility provisioning, electrical hookups, and municipal permitting workflows.
  • Financial Literacy: Basic understanding of project accounting principles, vendor accruals, purchase orders, and site budget tracking.
  • Software & Tools: Proficiency with Google Suite/Microsoft Excel and project management tracking platforms (e.g., Smartsheet, Asana, or Jira).
  • Soft Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication, strong problem-solving skills, and the self-motivation needed to manage high-volume, multi-faceted projects independently.

Benefits & Work Schedule

  • Work Schedule: Full-time hours, Monday through Friday (flexible for scheduled night/overnight cutover work as needed).
  • Benefits Package: Comprehensive benefits including W-2 employment, Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Holidays, Health/Dental/Vision Insurance, 401(k), HSA, and long-term growth opportunities.

Las Vegas, NV

title: Product Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Engineer based in Ireland.

This is a high-ownership Product Engineer role within a small, senior team building foundational technology for the commercial insurance market.
You will take complex problems from an initial thesis through design, implementation, deployment, and continuous iteration, with broad freedom over how solutions are built.
The role spans the full product and engineering stack, from user interfaces and APIs to data models, background jobs, and AI-powered workflows.
You will work with large-scale, structured insurance data to create intuitive products used by brokers, lenders, underwriters, and other insurance professionals.
AI is deeply embedded in the engineering workflow, and you will be expected to use modern coding agents and AI tooling to increase development speed and leverage.
With no traditional Product Manager or QA layer, Product Engineers are expected to exercise strong product judgment, challenge assumptions, and own outcomes rather than simply execute specifications.
This is an opportunity to join an ambitious, highly empowered environment where your work can have immediate impact on a rapidly evolving financial infrastructure market.

Accountabilities

  • Own product features end to end, from defining scope and identifying dependencies through development, deployment, customer adoption, and iteration.

  • Work across the full technology stack as needed, including user interfaces, APIs, data models, backend services, background jobs, and infrastructure integrations.

  • Transform complex, data-heavy insurance information into clear, intuitive interfaces that professionals can rely on in their daily workflows.

  • Lead a product squad and take responsibility for a defined area of the platform, with ownership aligned to your strongest technical and product instincts.

  • Identify dependencies on adjacent teams or systems, clearly define what is required, and proactively address potential blockers.

  • Use AI coding tools, agents, and agentic workflows extensively to accelerate development and increase engineering leverage.

  • Contribute to model evaluation and benchmarking initiatives, helping determine which AI models and approaches are appropriate for customer-facing and data-sensitive workflows.

  • Develop and improve internal evaluation harnesses where they can outperform or provide greater reliability than direct model calls.

  • Apply strong product judgment to challenge unclear requirements, simplify solutions, prioritize high-value work, and discontinue features that do not deliver sufficient value.

  • Work closely with Product Designers and Infrastructure/Platform specialists to turn ambiguous problems into effective, production-ready experiences.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve the product, engineering workflows, and underlying data systems.

  • Take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for detailed specifications, established processes, or predefined implementation plans.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 2 years of experience building and shipping production web applications; candidates with significantly more experience are equally welcome, with demonstrated ability to take problems through to completion being the key consideration.

    • Advanced, hands-on daily experience using modern AI development tools such as Codex, Claude Code, or comparable agentic coding workflows.

    • Strong full-stack engineering capabilities and comfort moving between frontend, backend, data, and supporting systems.

    • Experience working with data-heavy products such as dashboards, analytics platforms, pricing systems, operational tools, or other applications involving complex datasets.

    • Strong product instincts and a clear bias toward shipping useful solutions rather than optimizing for process.

    • Ability to independently understand ambiguous problems, make sound technical and product decisions, and drive work through to production.

    • High autonomy and self-direction, with the ability to make meaningful progress without extensive processes or management layers.

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills within a small, senior, highly empowered team.

    • Willingness to take ownership of both technical implementation and product outcomes.

      • Nice to have:

      • Experience in insurance, financial services, or another regulated and data-intensive industry.

      • Exposure to real-time data products, market indexes, benchmarks, pricing platforms, or similar systems.

      • Experience working at an early-stage company where you have taken on multiple responsibilities across product and engineering.

      • Interest in financial markets, market structure, pricing transparency, or data infrastructure.

      • Experience working with AI evaluation, benchmarking, model selection, or production AI systems.

      • Experience building products where data quality, reliability, and customer trust are critical.

title: Finance Associate
description:
LOCATION

Houston, TX

REPORTS TO

Chief Financial Officer

TEAM

Finance

Full-Time

Arva Intelligence is an agricultural data and environmental asset company headquartered in Houston.   • Build pricing and deal economics models for carbon, environmental asset, and 45Z tax credit transactions
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly board materials, KPI dashboards, and management reporting
  • Assist with the annual budget and rolling forecast process in partnership with department heads

  • Evaluate strategic alternatives, partnerships, and potential acquisitions

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, or as a finance analyst or associate at a PE or VC backed company

  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; comfortable with Google Sheets
  • Working knowledge of GAAP financial statements
  • Ability to turn analysis into clear, concise materials for executives, boards, and investors
  • Ownership mentality and comfort with ambiguity in a growth-stage company

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in agriculture, energy, renewable fuels, carbon markets, or environmental commodities
  • Familiarity with tax credit structures, project finance, or structured transactions
