title: Veterans Direct Care Options Counselor
description:
The Veterans Directed Care (VDC) Options Counselor provides person-centered guidance and support to veterans and their caregivers as they make informed decisions about home-based care.

The role involves assessing needs, identifying services and resources, developing individualized care and spending plans, and providing ongoing support to participants and caregivers.

This is a fully remote, home-office-based position. The employee must be able to work independently from a professional home office and travel regularly throughout the assigned service area. Travel may account for up to 50% of working time, with the service area extending up to approximately 2 hours from Durham.

A monthly in-person visit to the Norfolk headquarters is required. The VDC Options Counselor reports to the VDC Program Manager.

Key Responsibilities

· Complete initial assessments and required documentation.

· Work with veterans and caregivers to identify needs, preferences, and appropriate services.

· Develop and monitor individualized care and spending plans.

· Help participants and caregivers understand their responsibilities and available services.

· Provide guidance, training, and ongoing support as needed.

· Conduct required monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual participant contacts.

· Follow up on referrals and ensure services are implemented appropriately.

· Maintain accurate and confidential participant records in electronic databases.

· Monitor participant spending, maintain accurate financial records, and complete required reports.

· Coordinate with healthcare providers, community organizations, and other agencies to connect veterans with additional resources.

· Build and maintain positive working relationships with veterans, caregivers, professionals, and community partners.

· Provide education and presentations to community and professional groups.

· Use Cumulus and other web-based systems to maintain participant information, documentation, and program records.

· Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Skills

· Bachelor’s degree in social work, human services, or a related field, or at least two years of experience providing community-based services to older adults, people with disabilities, or veterans.

· Knowledge of aging, disability, veteran, consumer-directed, Medicaid, Medicare, or other benefit systems is preferred.

· Strong ability to research and connect individuals with community resources and services.

· Excellent listening, interviewing, assessment, communication, and relationship-building skills.

· Ability to empower and guide veterans and caregivers while maintaining a person-centered approach.

· Strong organizational and time-management skills.

· Ability to work independently, exercise sound professional judgment, and manage changing priorities.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and web-based software systems.

· Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and applicable ethical standards.

· Comfortable working remotely while maintaining productivity, communication, and accountability.

· Comfortable traveling independently and conducting regular in-person visits in the field

title: Senior PHP Software Engineer Backend & DevOps b... Capelle aan den IJssel ·
description:
Senior PHP Software Engineer Backend & DevOps bij Enova

Locatie: Capelle aan den IJssel
Dienstverband: Fulltime
Startdatum: Zo snel mogelijk
Hybride werken: In overleg

Over Enova

Enova is een snelgroeiend en innovatief bedrijf in de energiesector. We ontwikkelen slimme software voor energiemanagement en automatiseren de handel in gas en elektriciteit. Daarmee helpen we organisaties hun energieverbruik te optimaliseren en dragen we bij aan een efficiëntere en duurzamere energiemarkt.

Enova bestaat inmiddels ruim 20 jaar en bevindt zich in een ambitieuze scale-upfase. We groeien snel in Nederland en breiden onze activiteiten uit naar andere Europese landen. Als onderdeel van Vitec Software Group combineren we de wendbaarheid van een groeiende onderneming met de stabiliteit en slagkracht van een internationale softwaregroep.

Wat ga je doen als Senior Software Engineer Backend & DevOps?

Als Senior Software Engineer Backend & DevOps werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling en technische verbetering van ons energieplatform. Je combineert backendontwikkeling met het verbeteren en beheren van de infrastructuur waarop onze software draait.

Je kijkt verder dan het oplossen van het probleem van vandaag. Je denkt na over hoe onze software en infrastructuur op langere termijn betrouwbaar, onderhoudbaar en schaalbaar kunnen blijven. Je kunt je goed bewegen in een omvangrijke bestaande codebase en weet verbeterpunten in architectuur en ontwerp te herkennen.

Binnen onze Azure-omgeving werk je aan geautomatiseerde deployments, monitoring, development tooling en de verdere verbetering van onze CI/CD-processen. Daarnaast help je onze backend structureel te verbeteren door grotere refactors uit te voeren en passende design patterns en best practices toe te passen.

Je blijft daarbij zelf actief software ontwikkelen. Je duikt in bestaande code, bouwt nieuwe functionaliteit en werkt samen met andere developers om technische verbeteringen daadwerkelijk te realiseren.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

  • Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van de backend van ons energieplatform
  • Beheren en optimaliseren van onze Azure-infrastructuur
  • Verbeteren en automatiseren van CI/CD-processen
  • Werken aan monitoring, development tooling en deploymentprocessen
  • Uitvoeren van grotere refactors binnen de bestaande codebase
  • Doorontwikkelen van de softwarearchitectuur
  • Verbeteren van de betrouwbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid van onze software
  • Toepassen van passende design patterns en ontwikkelstandaarden
  • Uitvoeren van constructieve code reviews
  • Onderbouwen en bespreken van technische keuzes
  • Begeleiden en ondersteunen van andere developers
  • Kennis delen binnen het developmentteam

Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken een ervaren software engineer die sterk is in backenddevelopment en zich thuis voelt in een DevOps-omgeving. Je hebt gedegen ervaring met Linux, Docker, shell-scripting, CI/CD en cloudinfrastructuur.

Je kunt je weg vinden in een omvangrijke bestaande codebase en ziet waar architectuur, ontwerp en onderhoudbaarheid kunnen worden verbeterd. Je weet grotere technische verbeteringen op een pragmatische en stapsgewijze manier door te voeren.

Daarnaast neem je initiatief, kun je technische keuzes goed onderbouwen en werk je graag samen met andere developers. Je deelt je kennis, geeft constructieve feedback en helpt collega’s verder.

Onze technische omgeving

  • Backend: PHP en CodeIgniter
  • Frontend: Angular en TypeScript
  • Databases: MySQL en MongoDB
  • DevOps: Azure DevOps
  • Cloud: Microsoft Azure
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
  • Overige technologie: Linux, Docker en shell-scripts

Wat breng je mee?

  • Ruime ervaring met backenddevelopment
  • Ervaring met Linux, Docker en shell-scripting
  • Ervaring met CI/CD en geautomatiseerde deployments
  • Ervaring met cloudinfrastructuur
  • Ervaring met Infrastructure as Code
  • Ervaring met het onderhouden en verbeteren van grotere bestaande codebases
  • Kennis van softwarearchitectuur, design patterns en refactoring
  • Het vermogen om zelfstandig technische problemen te analyseren
  • Goede communicatieve en samenwerkingsvaardigheden
  • Een pragmatische en kwaliteitsgerichte manier van werken

Mooi meegenomen

  • Ervaring met PHP en CodeIgniter
  • Ervaring met Microsoft Azure en Azure DevOps
  • Ervaring met Terraform
  • Ervaring met MySQL en MongoDB
  • Ervaring met Angular of TypeScript
  • Ervaring met agentic software development
  • Ervaring binnen een scale-up, SaaS-organisatie of energiegerelateerde omgeving

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een seniorfunctie waarin backenddevelopment en DevOps samenkomen
  • Veel invloed op de architectuur en technische ontwikkeling van ons platform
  • De mogelijkheid om technische processen en infrastructuur verder te professionaliseren
  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling
  • Een informele en collegiale werksfeer met korte lijnen
  • Een marktconform salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring
  • Een aantrekkelijk aandelenprogramma voor medewerkers via het Employee Stock Savings Plan
  • De stabiliteit van Vitec Software Group gecombineerd met de dynamiek van een groeiende organisatie

Over Vitec Software Group

Vitec Software Group is een toonaangevende leverancier van verticale software en heeft zijn hoofdkantoor in Umeå, Zweden. De groep bestaat uit autonome business units die bedrijfskritische software ontwikkelen voor specifieke nichemarkten in Europa.

Taalvereiste

Vanwege de samenwerking met klanten en collega's in Nederland is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, vereist.

title: Fitness Director
description:
Villa Sport offers exciting and fulfilling career opportunities for those who thrive in a fast-paced, energizing environment. Our portfolio includes clubs across multiple states, including California, Texas, Colorado, Idaho, and Oregon. Our resort-style clubs are more than just gyms; they are communities where fitness, family, and fun come together. We are on a mission to create energizing environments where you can thrive and grow with us.

If you're a high-performing, outgoing, service-oriented superstar looking for a chance to make a difference, you've found your home. At Villa Sport, we offer a fantastic work environment, competitive wages, and a 401(k) plan with a company match of up to 4% of your compensation. Ready to join a team that’s going places? Your journey starts here!

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Fitness Director leads a team of fitness professionals in providing 5-star service to all Villa Sport members in the fitness center and in delivering high quality fitness training services, small group training programs, and educational seminars that help members achieve their health and personal goals. The Fitness Director ensures that all members feel knowledgeable and comfortable in the fitness center and that all Fitness Staff are genuinely friendly, outgoing, approachable, helpful and credible. The Fitness Director ensures that new members are properly integrated so they can exercise effectively and safely, are informed about all the program offerings and complimentary services available and are advised as to the fitness programs and services that would best meet their needs and goals. The Fitness Director is responsible for achieving or exceeding departmental budget expectations and for ensuring that all fitness equipment is properly maintained, operational and safe.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS INCLUDE:

  • $83,600-$88,000 annual base salary based on experience.
  • Monthly bonus and commission opportunities.
  • PTO.
  • Benefits package.
  • 401K with dollar for dollar match up to 4%.
  • Complimentary club membership.
  • Discounts on club products and services.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Club and/or hospitality industry experience (high-end, resort-style, family-oriented facilities) preferred
  • Relationship-based selling/servicing skills and training/presentation skills
  • Word, Excel and PowerPoint basic proficiency
  • Budgeting and analysis skills
  • Knowledge and expertise in individual and group training protocols and standards; current fitness trends; and anatomy/physiology (a plus but not required)
  • In customer engagement and retention
  • In directing a revenue-generating department or business
  • In managing and achieving a budget
  • In leading a team of 25+ people (2 years minimum preferred)
  • In developing and delivering educational workshops and seminars
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; great listening skills
  • Comfortable with striking up conversations with members, with approaching members at the club, with providing advice and assistance, with calling members on the phone, and with handling and resolving member complaints
  • Excellent customer service and people skills
  • Skilled at rapport and relationship-building
  • Calm under fire; maintains composure
  • Healthy lifestyle habits
  • First Aid/CPR certification required prior to hire date
  • College Degree preferred
  • Occasional bending and kneeling, and infrequent lifting of weights up to 50 lbs.
  • Frequent standing, walking, reaching.
  • The noise level is usually moderate to high

For more information about Villa Sport, please visit our website at .

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

It is the Company’s policy to employ, train, promote, transfer, discipline, terminate, and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and abilities as they relate to the Company’s needs. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or domestic partnership status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military and veteran status any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

PRIVACY NOTICE TO CALIFORNIA JOB APPLICANTS

Villa Sport and/or any affiliated entities (collectively, the “Company” or “we”) provide this California Privacy Notice (“Notice”) to describe our privacy practices with respect to our collection of Personal Information as required under the California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (“CPRA”). This Notice applies only to job applicants and candidates for employment who are residents of the State of California (“Consumers”) and from whom we collect “Personal Information” as defined in the CCPA. We provide you this Notice because under the CCPA, California residents who are job applicants qualify as Consumers. For purposes of this Notice, when we refer to Consumers, we mean you only to the extent you are a job applicant who resides in California.

1. Information We Collect From or About Job Applicants

We may directly or indirectly collect Personal Information from you in a variety of different situations and using a variety of different methods, including, but not limited to, on our website, your mobile device, through email, in physical locations, through written applications, through the mail, and/or over the telephone. Generally, we may collect, receive, maintain, and use the following categories of Personal Information, depending on the particular purpose and to the extent permitted under applicable law:

To comply with local, state, and federal law and regulations requiring employers to maintain certain records (such as immigration compliance records, travel records, personnel files, wage and hour records, payroll records, accident or safety records, and tax records), as well as local, state, and federal law, regulations, ordinances, guidelines, and orders relating to COVID-19.

To communicate with job applicants and other consumers (including employees and visitors to our workplace) regarding potential exposure to COVID-19 and properly warn others who have had close contact with an infected or symptomatic individual so that they may take precautionary measures, help prevent further spread of the virus, and obtain treatment, if necessary.

3. Sale/Sharing of Information to Third Parties

title: 2027 Asset Management Internship
description:
The Asset Management Intern position provides the opportunity to work with a well-established real estate investment team with more than 35 years of experience. Interns will develop multifamily and commercial real estate asset management skills by reviewing property financials, monitoring operating performance, tracking capital expenditures, and evaluating key performance indicators. Interns will work with asset management, acquisitions, property management, construction management, and fund accounting throughout the life cycle of real estate investments. The role also provides exposure to budgeting, forecasting, due diligence, investor reporting, valuations, financing, and hold-versus-sell analysis.

Duties and Responsibilities:

· Create and utilize financial models to evaluate property cash flow, valuations, supplemental loans, refinancings, and hold-versus-sell decisions.

· Review and analyze monthly property reports, including rent rolls, income statements, balance sheets, budget comparisons, cash flow statements, and delinquency reports.

· Analyze property operating performance and communicate significant budget variances and trends.

· Track key performance indicators, including occupancy, rental rates, lease trade-outs, operating expenses, and capital expenditures.

· Assist with annual operating budgets, property forecasts, cash requirements, and distribution projections.

· Compare acquisition underwriting and approved business plans to actual asset performance.

· Assist in monitoring asset strategies, construction projects, interior improvement plans, and capital budgets.

· Participate in property site visits and help document inspection findings and follow-up items.

· Assist with due diligence and closing activities for newly acquired assets.

· Assist with loan administration, including covenant monitoring, reserve and loan draws, escrows, lender reporting, and required repairs.

· Prepare asset management reports, investor reporting materials, and internal portfolio review presentations.

· Support recurring asset management projects through data organization, process documentation, and coordination with internal and external partners.


Reporting Relationship: Interns will report to Associates, AVPs and VPs within Asset Management and will have exposure to senior leadership and other MLG business units.

title: Fire Suppression Technician
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The purpose of the Fire Suppression Technician is to provide installation, inspection, service and/or repair of Fire Extinguishers and any Pre-Engineered Suppression Systems.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:

  • Use required tools and test equipment such as power machine groovers, cutters, band saws, lifts, etc. to repair or replace fire extinguishers, pre-engineered systems.

  • Comprehensive working knowledge of NFPA codes, standards, and systems such as all types of fire extinguishers, pre-engineered suppression systems and/or fire alarm & security systems.

  • Troubleshoot and identify defective components of pre-engineered suppression systems.

  • Repair or replace damaged components of pre-engineered suppression systems as well as fire extinguishers

  • Communicate with internal and external customers in a professional manner.

  • Required to be punctual to required work locations and complete scheduled projects in timely manner.

  • Use Field Service Lightning to track work orders, materials needed, time on job, etc.

  • Complete documentation on work orders.

  • Understand and follow SFP’s Safety program, SDS book, Hazardous communication program, policies and procedures. Participate in weekly Toolbox talks. Employee must always know location all related safety documentation on each project.

  • Ensure company provided vehicle is clean and well maintained as required by company policies.

  • Periodically attend seminars or similar education/training sessions to stay abreast of latest technology, codes, and standards changes.

  • Train service technician trainees in all applicable aspects of this job description. Communicate with internal and external customers in a professional manner.

  • Other duties may be assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

The qualifications listed below are representative of the elements required to perform the job successfully, however in some cases, an equivalent combination of Education, Training, Certifications and Experience may meet the job qualifications.

Education, Training, Certifications:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent, required.
  • State or any required certification, preferred.

Experience, Knowledge, Skill Requirements:

  • 2 Industry experience specifically within Fire Suppression.
  • 2 years of professional computer skills

Communication Skills:

  • Must have the ability to effectively read, write and communicate in English with employees and customers.

Other Qualifications:

  • Valid driver’s license with acceptable driving record required.
  • Must be able to comply with SFP’s Drug and Alcohol Policy and Background screening requirements, which may also include customer-specific requirements based on contractual agreement.
  • Must be able to travel 20% of the time. (Possible overnight stays)

PHYSICAL & WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform Essential Job Duties.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to bend, ascend, and descend step stools, ladders, and stairs, kneel, lift < 50 lbs., reach above and below shoulders, and stand and walk for extended periods. The employee is required to see in color, close and far distances, peripheral, depth, and adjust focus. The employee will occasionally be required to balance, crouch, drive, kneel, lift > 50 lbs, sit, stoop, twist, and work at heights.

Work Environment:

Employees will regularly be required to work outside and be exposed to hot/cold temperatures, dust, fumes, chemicals, electrical hazards, and noise. Employees will occasionally be required to work indoors in an office setting, work alone and with others. Employees must consistently wear all appropriate personal protective equipment, as required by company safety policies while visiting locations.

We are fully committed to equal opportunities for employment to all individuals regardless of race, national origin, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, familial status, and any other classification protected under the law. We are an Equal Opportunity, Affirmative Action employer.

While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the position, management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary.

title: Director Philanthropy - Alaska
description:
Calling All Esteemed Leaders! Are you a philanthropy leader who excels in major gifts, planned giving, donor engagement, and fundraising strategy? Do you thrive in environments where relationship building, leadership development, volunteer engagement, and mission-driven philanthropy come together to support meaningful healthcare initiatives? If so, we invite you to explore this leadership opportunity with Providence.

The Role

Under the direction of the Region Chief Philanthropy Officer, the Director of Philanthropy directs the major gift (including planned gift) programs across all Alaskan ministries. Develops and manages activities across all Alaskan ministries that will directly result in prospect identification, engagement, and successful solicitations.

The Director guides major giving donor engagement strategies and maintains a portfolio of donors. The Director participates in the management of relevant board committees involving caregivers and volunteer leaders as appropriate. The Director cultivates caregiver and volunteer leadership support and utilizes their expertise to increase major giving to the Region.

What You'll Do

  • Under the direction of the Region Chief Philanthropy Officer, provides strategic leadership of major and planned gifts programs for the Region.
  • With support from the Region Chief Philanthropy Officer, develops single and multi-year fundraising targets.
  • Prepares an annual major gift plan to achieve revenue targets in consultation with Foundation colleagues, with an emphasis on increasing major giving to the Foundation and ensures the quality and quantity of major gift activity in the Region.
  • Using sophisticated fundraising methodologies, reports and measurements, ensures that prospects capable of major gifts are cultivated, solicited and stewarded in a meaningful, appropriate, and deliberate manner.
  • Provides support and leadership to ensure the highest level of productivity for philanthropy officers, including recruitment, hiring, evaluating, training, and coaching, and providing a structure for collaborative, consistent, and supportive donor development as a team.
  • Ensures that all major gift materials, proposals and applications are of the highest quality, effective, share a consistent message, and appropriate to the donor or funder.
  • Responsible for documentation and up to date procedures for major gift processes.
  • Builds and manages structures that ensure individualized, meaningful and appropriate stewardship for major donors.
  • Monitors and maximizes major donor retention.
  • Uses appropriate interpersonal skills to guide others to accomplish objectives, facilitates teamwork, participation and cooperation.
  • Develops and manages a portfolio of major gift prospects with emphasis on prospects who require a multi-discipline approach.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in United Kingdom.

This is a senior individual-contributor role embedded directly within a product squad working on complex, high-risk technology domains.
You’ll act as the squad’s technical authority on quality, shaping test strategy, automation, performance, and integration practices.
The role goes beyond test execution, giving you ownership of architecture, quality gates, and the most challenging testing problems.
You’ll work closely with engineering and product teams from the earliest stages, challenging ambiguity before development begins.
You’ll also contribute to broader QA standards, mentor engineers, and lead initiatives that improve testing across the wider organization.
The environment values technical depth, autonomy, continuous improvement, and practical use of modern AI-assisted QA tooling.
It’s an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on reliable, high-scale financial technology as a senior technical leader without moving into management.

Accountabilities

  • Embed fully within an engineering squad, participating in sprint planning, daily standups, reviews, retrospectives, and other ceremonies as a core technical contributor.

  • Define and refine acceptance criteria with Product Owners, identifying ambiguity and quality risks before implementation begins.

  • Own the squad’s test architecture and strategy, determining how unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing work together and identifying coverage gaps.

  • Lead performance and load testing, establishing baselines, evaluating throughput and concurrency limits, and translating findings into actionable engineering improvements.

  • Own the squad’s Definition of Done and quality gates, serving as a final internal quality check before releases progress to staging or production.

  • Design, maintain, and improve automated test suites that remain reliable, readable, maintainable, and effective within CI environments.

  • Triage complex test failures and distinguish flaky tests from genuine regressions, particularly across high-traffic, high-risk, or highly integrated areas.

  • Mentor QA Engineers within the squad and across the wider QA community, raising standards around automation, test design, and engineering practices.

  • Represent the squad in broader QA initiatives and contribute to chapter-wide standards, tooling decisions, onboarding resources, and testing practices.

  • Take ownership of a strategic QA initiative, such as a contract-testing framework, performance-testing toolkit, testing discipline, or AI-assisted test generation workflow.

  • Actively leverage AI and LLM tooling for test case generation, synthetic data creation, regression triage, documentation, and other areas where automation can accelerate QA work.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of QA engineering experience in a software product environment, with demonstrated ownership of testing strategy for complex technical domains.

    • Strong test automation engineering skills, with the ability to write production-quality tests in Java, Python, or JavaScript and build stable, maintainable suites that run effectively in CI.

    • Deep experience with API testing, including REST APIs, contract testing, integration testing, HTTP semantics, and JSON schema validation.

    • Experience in fintech, payments, or digital financial services is strongly preferred, particularly where reliability and correctness are critical.

    • Familiarity with contract testing tools such as Pact or equivalent approaches within microservices environments is a strong advantage.

    • Mobile testing experience, particularly Android, using tools such as Espresso or Appium, or structured manual testing supported by regression frameworks, is beneficial.

    • Experience contributing to a QA chapter, guild, community of practice, or internal training program is valued.

    • Familiarity with AI-assisted QA workflows, including LLM-based test generation, regression analysis, and synthetic test data creation, is a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Full integration into a product squad, with a direct role in engineering decisions and product delivery rather than functioning as a downstream QA resource.

      • Opportunity to shape testing standards, architecture, tooling, and quality practices beyond your immediate squad.

title: Sr. Program Systems Engineer
description:
Astrolab is The Lunar Operations Company. We design and build the systems and hardware the lunar economy will come to depend on — rovers, power, and data networks for sustained operations on the Moon. We are focused on the problems that must be solved before the next chapter of human exploration can scale. The Moon does not forgive untested assumptions. The people who work here know that, and they wouldn't have it any other way.

The LTVS Sr. Program System Engineer will be responsible for the integration of the Lunar Terrain Vehicle System (LTVS) project systems and interfaces across all mission phases to ensure the product and systems meet customer (NASA Moon Base and LTV Project) needs and mission objectives. You will report to the LTV Deputy Program Manager (Technical) as a member of the System Engineering and Integration (SEI) team and will collaborate with Responsible Engineers across the program.
  • Integration of Program elements (vehicle, delivery system, NASA, ground systems) for program requirements and objectives, including negotiation with customer (NASA) on requirements and deliverables

  • Collaboration with integrators from Mission Operations, software, and Engineering to ensure consistency across specific mission phases: Lunar transit, Lander deployment and egress, Initial checkouts and first lunar day, Hibernation, and Crewed campaign. This includes collaboration with NASA counterparts for joint definitions
  • Ownership or review of scenario-based analysis for technical resources (power/energy, data volume) and surface productivity
  • Develop, coordinate, and execute Verification and Validation (V&V) activities for integrated system tests, interface tests with external elements (lander, suits)
  • Identify, quantify, and mitigate phase-level program risks

  • 5+ years of experience with spacecraft telecommunications, Guidance Navigation & Control (GNC), power, and flight software systems
  • Experience with cross-functional engineering projects involving multiple technical disciplines and subject matter experts
  • Experience with developing and executing verification and validation (V&V) plans, conducting system-level trade studies, developing requirements, and managing risks, including proficiency with at least one requirements management system
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with spacecraft systems in both development and operations
  • Spacecraft operations experience, particularly developing early operations and checkout activities
  • Hardware-in-the-loop testing experience at the subsystem or system level
  • Prior ownership and delivery of major systems engineering products, including design reviews, V&V plans, requirements closure, or system-level analyses
  • In-depth technical expertise in at least one spacecraft subsystem, preferably two
  • Experience with statistical analysis, such as Monte Carlo simulations
  • Experience with Python and MATLAB
  • Join a team of best-in-class engineers building the foundation of planetary surface exploration

  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Flexible PTO and parental leave
  • Weekly lunch stipend, plus complimentary snacks and beverages on-site
  • Once a month social hour on-site with food and drinks

title: Director, Global PMO
description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

As the Director, Global PMO, you will lead the Global PMO within Operational Excellence and Transformation, elevating Crunchyroll's execution discipline by providing a consistent approach to planning, governing, and delivering complex cross-functional programs. You will lead the PMO as both a center of excellence and an execution team - establishing common standards, tools, governance, and reporting while directly providing program leadership for Crunchyroll’s highest-priority initiatives where dedicated PM capability is required.

You will be an execution leader and a capability builder: able to turn ambiguous priorities into integrated plans, create clarity across functions and regions, surface risks and decisions early, and drive teams to measurable outcomes. While your role may not own the underlying business strategy or functional execution, it provides the program structure, governance, leadership, and accountability required to deliver complex initiatives predictably and strengthen project management capability across Crunchyroll.

Core Areas of Responsibility

  • Global PMO Leadership & Operating Model: Lead the day-to-day Global PMO as a COE + Execution team; translate enterprise and OXT priorities into a focused PMO portfolio; establish operating cadences, performance expectations, and resource-allocation principles; and build a high-performing team capable of leading complex work across the organization.
  • Complex Program Leadership: Lead or oversee high-priority cross-functional programs such as territory launches, pricing changes, operating-model changes, and other strategic initiatives; build integrated plans across workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, and outcomes; and maintain momentum from mobilization through implementation and handoff.
  • Governance, Risk & Decision Management: Establish fit-for-purpose governance forums, RAID management, decision pathways, escalation mechanisms, and executive-sponsor engagement; ensure risks, dependencies, and blockers are surfaced early, owners are clear, decisions are made at the right level, and commitments are followed through.
  • Portfolio Visibility & Executive Reporting: Maintain a transparent, fact-based view of the PMO portfolio covering priorities, progress, readiness, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, capacity constraints, and expected benefits; synthesize complex information into concise executive reporting and actionable recommendations for the Senior Director and senior stakeholders.
  • PM Standards, Tools & Capability Building: Define and continuously improve common project and program-management methodologies, templates, tools, reporting standards, and governance practices; coach embedded PMs and business teams on effective execution; and raise project-management maturity without becoming the default PM resource for teams that can build or sustain their own capability.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment & Transformation Integration: Build strong partnerships across Regional teams, Content, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Engineering, Business Development, Enterprise Technology, and other functions; work closely with Campaign Operations, Business Analysis, Process Transformation, Operations Transformation, and Knowledge Management so programs have the right analytical support, change discipline, and sustainable handoff.
  • Outcomes & Continuous Improvement: Partner with business owners and Business Analysis to define success measures, track program outcomes, and identify performance or adoption gaps; use lessons learned and portfolio insights to improve PMO practices, strengthen predictability, and create a culture focused on measurable business outcomes rather than project activity.

In the role of Global, Director PMO, you will report to the Senior Director, Global PMO & Transformation.

We are considering applicants for the location of Los Angeles.

About You

  • 12+ years of professional experience in program/project management, business operations, strategy, transformation, or management consulting, including significant experience leading large cross-functional programs and managing project or program-management professionals.
  • 5+ years of experience managing program managers.
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling global programs, operating models, or PMO frameworks from the ground up—including establishing the governance, processes, tools, and cross-functional alignment needed to drive consistent execution across regions.
  • Proven track record delivering complex, multi-workstream programs from ambiguity through implementation, including initiatives with global or regional stakeholders and significant business, operational, and technology dependencies.
  • Deep expertise in integrated planning, program governance, portfolio management, RAID management, executive reporting, and decision/escalation mechanisms, with demonstrated experience designing or scaling PMO standards and operating practices.
  • Exceptional executive presence, communication, analytical synthesis, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to create clarity, influence senior leaders, and drive accountability across teams without relying on direct authority.
  • Experience with project management tools (i.e. Asana, JIRA, etc.)

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in media, entertainment, streaming, digital platforms, or technology, with exposure to content, marketing, localization, or digital supply-chain operations.
  • Experience with large-scale business transformation, operational excellence, management consulting, and/or change-management programs.
  • Experience working across global and regional operating models and with technology-enabled transformation, including automation or AI initiatives delivered in partnership with enterprise technology teams.

About the Team

The Global PMO & Transformation team is being established as the execution engine for Crunchyroll’s most complex, high-impact initiatives, bringing together program leadership, portfolio oversight, and scalable ways of working.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

  • Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
  • Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.

description:
Ninja Van is a tech-enabled logistics company on a mission to provide hassle-free delivery services for businesses of all sizes across Southeast Asia. Launched in 2014, we started operations in Singapore and have become the region's largest and fastest growing last-mile logistics company, partnering with over 35,000 merchants and delivering more than 1,000 parcels every minute across six countries.

At our core, we are a technology company that is disrupting a massive industry with cutting-edge software and operational concepts. Powered by algorithm-based optimisation, dynamic routing, end-to-end tracking and a data-driven approach, we provide best-of-class delivery services that delight both the shippers and end customers. But we are just getting started! We have much room for improvement and many ideas that will further shape the industry.

Responsibiltiies

  • Oversee daily end-to-end warehouse operations, including inbound, storage, inventory, picking, packing, dispatch, and returns, ensuring service levels and operational SLAs are consistently met.

  • Monitor key operational metrics such as labor productivity, Cost per Parcel (CPP), overtime, fulfillment accuracy, and operational costs to support efficiency and contribution margin targets.

  • Maintain high inventory and order accuracy through cycle counts, proper system transactions, reconciliation, and process controls, while minimizing fulfillment errors and claims.

  • Plan shift schedules and manpower allocation and lead supervisors and warehouse staff toward productivity targets.

  • Ensure compliance with SOPs, WMS/ERP procedures, safety standards, and 5S practices across warehouse operations.

  • Identify operational gaps and implement root-cause analysis and process improvement initiatives to improve productivity, accuracy, and overall warehouse efficiency.

Qualification

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in warehouse, 3PL, e-commerce, or fulfillment operations.

  • At least 2 years of supervisory or team leadership experience in a warehouse or fulfillment environment.

  • Hands-on experience with WMS or ERP systems. Experience with Anchanto WMS is a strong advantage.

  • Strong knowledge of warehouse KPIs, manpower planning, productivity management, inventory control, and root-cause analysis.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for operational reporting and analysis.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in English and Tagalog, both written and spoken.

  • Willing to work flexible schedules or shifts, particularly during peak campaign periods.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Chief Technology Officer based in United States .

This is a senior technology leadership opportunity focused on shaping the future of enterprise software that supports critical public-sector and justice systems. You will own the technology strategy, architecture, product development, and engineering direction across a complex software portfolio. The role combines long-term technical vision with hands-on organizational leadership, modernization, product thinking, and operational excellence. You will work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to align technology investments with customer needs and business priorities. A major part of the mandate will be building a high-performing technology organization while advancing secure, scalable, reliable, and configurable platforms. You will also help identify emerging technologies and new opportunities, including the practical application of AI and data-driven capabilities.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and lead a multi-year technology strategy and roadmap aligned with long-term organizational goals, ensuring the technical vision is understood and adopted across the business.

  • Establish a customer-centric, problem-first product development approach that ensures teams understand user needs, business challenges, and desired outcomes before committing to technical solutions.

  • Identify emerging technologies, market opportunities, partnerships, and potential acquisitions that can strengthen existing products and create new sources of value.

  • Advise executive leadership on technology investments, build-versus-buy decisions, strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and other major technology initiatives.

  • Define the architectural vision and engineering principles for secure, scalable, configurable, modular, repeatable, and maintainable systems that can evolve as customer and business needs change.

  • Promote platform thinking through reusable services, APIs, shared components, and common capabilities that can support multiple products and business units.

  • Lead modernization of the technology portfolio by balancing investment in existing platforms with technical debt reduction, consolidation, modernization, and next-generation capabilities.

  • Lead the engineering organization with a culture centered on ownership, craftsmanship, continuous improvement, pragmatic decision-making, quality, reliability, and security.

  • Advance modern engineering practices while balancing speed of delivery with operational resilience, product quality, cybersecurity, and long-term maintainability.

  • Support the organization's transition toward Agile methodologies and Scrum-at-Scale, helping teams adopt effective delivery practices and continuous improvement.

  • Build strong partnerships across departments, creating alignment around technology priorities, timelines, resources, dependencies, and organizational goals.

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business language for executives and non-technical stakeholders while bringing business context and customer priorities back to technical teams.

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing technology organization through organizational design, leadership development, succession planning, workforce strategy, and recruitment of critical technical talent.

  • Establish and maintain appropriate standards for security, privacy, compliance, and data governance, including requirements relevant to government agencies, courts, and criminal justice environments such as CJIS.

  • Oversee technology investment, performance, operational resilience, and resource allocation to ensure systems remain reliable, scalable, secure, and prepared for business continuity.

  • Establish effective technology governance and risk-management practices in partnership with Security, Cloud Operations, IT, Legal, and business leadership to manage architectural, cybersecurity, regulatory, and third-party technology risks.

    • Possess deep expertise in software and systems architecture, including distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, APIs, data platforms, scalability, security, and modern engineering practices.

    • Bring strong product judgment and experience making customer-driven product and technology decisions based on real user needs and business outcomes.

    • Demonstrate a track record of establishing compelling technical visions and successfully aligning engineering teams, executives, and other stakeholders around strategic priorities.

    • Have excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with executives, engineers, customers, partners, and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Experience incubating new products or working within a startup, innovation lab, venture environment, or similarly entrepreneurial setting is preferred.

    • Hands-on experience applying artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven technologies to real-world products is preferred.

    • Experience working in Agile environments or formal training in Scrum or Agile methodologies is expected.

    • Hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; an advanced degree is considered an advantage.

This is an opportunity to join an ambitious, highly empowered environment where your work can have immediate impact on a rapidly evolving financial infrastructure market.

Accountabilities

  • Identify dependencies on adjacent teams or systems, clearly define what is required, and proactively address potential blockers.

  • Use AI coding tools, agents, and agentic workflows extensively to accelerate development and increase engineering leverage.

  • Contribute to model evaluation and benchmarking initiatives, helping determine which AI models and approaches are appropriate for customer-facing and data-sensitive workflows.

  • Develop and improve internal evaluation harnesses where they can outperform or provide greater reliability than direct model calls.

  • Apply strong product judgment to challenge unclear requirements, simplify solutions, prioritize high-value work, and discontinue features that do not deliver sufficient value.

  • Work closely with Product Designers and Infrastructure/Platform specialists to turn ambiguous problems into effective, production-ready experiences.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve the product, engineering workflows, and underlying data systems.

  • Take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for detailed specifications, established processes, or predefined implementation plans.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 2 years of experience building and shipping production web applications; candidates with significantly more experience are equally welcome, with demonstrated ability to take problems through to completion being the key consideration.

    • Advanced, hands-on daily experience using modern AI development tools such as Codex, Claude Code, or comparable agentic coding workflows.

    • Strong full-stack engineering capabilities and comfort moving between frontend, backend, data, and supporting systems.

    • Experience working with data-heavy products such as dashboards, analytics platforms, pricing systems, operational tools, or other applications involving complex datasets.

    • Strong product instincts and a clear bias toward shipping useful solutions rather than optimizing for process.

    • Ability to independently understand ambiguous problems, make sound technical and product decisions, and drive work through to production.

    • High autonomy and self-direction, with the ability to make meaningful progress without extensive processes or management layers.

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills within a small, senior, highly empowered team.

    • Willingness to take ownership of both technical implementation and product outcomes.

      • Nice to have:

      • Experience in insurance, financial services, or another regulated and data-intensive industry.

At For Eyes, we are an optical retailer that offers high-quality brands and products with great pricing. We are as unique as our customers and patients. Our diverse team consists of more than 500 dedicated associates across 105 stores in the United States and Puerto Rico. Our highly qualified associates are passionate about customer satisfaction. We proudly offer every For Eyes customer a perfect blend of expert eye care and affordable eyewear.

When you join For Eyes, you are starting a career with endless possibilities for growth. We strive for continuous improvement and ways to collaborate to raise the potential of our company. Our commitment is to support and develop our people who have the desire, ambition, and potential to grow.

For Eyes is part of EssilorLuxottica, a global leader in the design, manufacture and distribution of world-class vision care products, including iconic eyewear, advanced lens technology and cutting-edge digital solutions. Join our global community of over 200,000 dedicated employees around the world in driving the transformation of the eyewear and eyecare industry. Discover more by following us on LinkedIn!

JOB DESCRIPTION

GENERAL FUNCTION

The Licensed Optician delivers the brand value proposition & helps establish Clearly as the premier destination for all vision needs within the community. Creates exceptional value in the lives of customers by delivering legendary customer service & perfectly crafted high quality eyewear which exceeds our customers’ expectations.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Greets all customers with a warm welcome right away, exchanges names, & ensures they know what to expect. Shows urgency in providing service to customers & satisfying their needs.
  • Custom fits glasses & precisely places prescription in lenses.
  • Acts as a leader in optical acumen that provides a voice for associates.
  • Takes & records measurements, adjusts or fits eyewear correctly, thorough & exact in details; ensures finished eyewear meets standards & customer requirements.
  • Attracts new customers.
  • Explores the needs & priorities of customers by asking open ended questions.

  • Assists co-workers with difficult or complex areas of product needs & prescriptions.
  • Utilizes store tools & adheres to Brand Store Commitments.
  • Performs work accurately & thoroughly utilizing all technology despite time pressure & customer volume. Demonstrates superior product knowledge; takes the initiative to accurately describe the features & benefits of various lenses & frames using appropriate tools. Reinforces customers’ final selection.
  • Anticipates problems; explores underlying reasons for customer issues; strives to develop long-term solutions to problems & ensures customers are satisfied & expectations are exceeded. Acts quickly for resolution. Partners with management as necessary.
  • Possesses the ability to multi-task, prioritize & manage time with competing priorities.
  • Commits to delivery date & time, seeks feedback & asks for referrals.
  • Strives to achieve exceptional results on Brand KPIs & competencies.
  • Presents, celebrates & educates at pick up.
  • Takes pride in store appearance, shows initiative to keep store clean, attractive & organized. Secures & protects company assets in your control.
  • Informs management of safety opportunities; demonstrates safe work practices.
  • Possesses a “can do” spirit & strong drive for results; self-motivated with a desire for continual learning & improvement.
  • Adheres to company policies & procedure, including but not limited to discounting, promotions & inventory management.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Optical dispensing experience
  • Strong customer service skills: communicator, listener & team builder
  • Knowledge of current store merchandise
  • Strong basic math skills
  • Awareness of current fashion trends

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer based in Canada.

This is a highly technical, customer-facing engineering role supporting complex enterprise deployments and tailored technology solutions. You will work across implementation, solution engineering, technical support, integrations, and software development to turn customer requirements into production-ready outcomes. The role combines hands-on technical problem solving with direct collaboration across customers, partners, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders. You will work with APIs, code, logs, integrations, virtual agents, and AI-powered customer experiences to diagnose issues and build practical solutions. The position offers significant ownership, requiring you to navigate ambiguity and take challenging technical problems through to resolution. You will also help create reusable tools, patterns, and processes that improve future deployments and strengthen the broader engineering organization.

Accountabilities

  • Serve as a hands-on technical resource for complex customer programs, translating business requirements and solution designs into executable implementation activities.

  • Configure, test, validate, and document customer-specific solutions across supported products and services while ensuring alignment with technical architecture and program milestones.

  • Identify technical blockers, risks, dependencies, and implementation gaps early, and develop practical solutions when standard configurations do not fully meet customer requirements.

  • Build and maintain lightweight scripts, technical workarounds, proofs of concept, utilities, and tailored solutions using appropriate technologies.

  • Support customer testing, user acceptance testing, production readiness, launch, and post-launch stabilization, taking ownership of assigned technical deliverables through completion.

  • Design, configure, test, and troubleshoot integrations between enterprise platforms and customer or third-party systems using REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, webhooks, authentication mechanisms, and structured data.

  • Analyze API requests and responses, validate endpoint behavior, troubleshoot integration failures, and document requirements, mappings, dependencies, assumptions, and limitations.

  • Read, understand, troubleshoot, and modify application, integration, and sample code using technologies such as Python, JavaScript, and HTML.

  • Review code and technical implementations to identify issues involving parameters, authentication, data transformation, endpoint usage, configuration, error handling, and application logic.

  • Analyze application, platform, API, and integration logs to diagnose complex issues, correlate events across systems, develop technical hypotheses, reproduce problems, and determine root causes where possible.

  • Clearly document technical findings, reproduction steps, observed and expected behavior, diagnostic evidence, and recommended remediation, preparing high-quality escalations when deeper engineering support is required.

  • Configure and optimize AI-powered customer experiences by developing prompts, testing responses, establishing validation scenarios, and improving accuracy, relevance, consistency, safety, and adherence to business requirements.

  • Evaluate the probabilistic behavior of generative AI systems, identify limitations and edge cases, and refine prompts, instructions, context, workflows, and guardrails.

  • Design and configure virtual-agent experiences by translating business processes into conversational workflows involving intents, entities, parameters, routing, APIs, webhooks, error handling, escalation paths, and live-agent handoffs.

  • Test conversational experiences across expected scenarios and edge cases, troubleshoot virtual-agent behavior using logs and session data, and validate production readiness.

  • Act as a trusted technical resource for customers, partners, developers, architects, administrators, IT teams, contact center teams, and business stakeholders throughout assigned engagements.

  • Participate in technical discovery, implementation, troubleshooting, readiness, and launch sessions while communicating technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Partner with program managers, solution architects, product teams, engineering, and customer support to resolve blockers, manage dependencies, and ensure successful customer outcomes.

  • Maintain visibility into technical deliverables, risks, dependencies, decisions, and outstanding issues, providing accurate status updates and proactively escalating timeline-impacting concerns.

  • Identify recurring deployment challenges and develop reusable scripts, integration patterns, technical templates, troubleshooting guides, documentation, and automation opportunities.

  • Share lessons learned across the engineering organization and provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams regarding recurring implementation challenges, product gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

    • Requirements:

    • Bring at least 3 years of experience in a technical customer-facing role such as Technical Implementation, Professional Services, Solution Engineering, Integration Engineering, Deployment Engineering, Technical Support, Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, or Software Development.

    • Demonstrate experience working with complex enterprise software deployments, implementations, integrations, or customer-specific technical solutions.

    • Have working knowledge of Python, JavaScript, and HTML, with the ability to read, understand, troubleshoot, and modify lightweight code and scripts.

    • Demonstrate hands-on experience with REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, webhooks, authentication, request and response payloads, and API integrations.

    • Be comfortable testing and troubleshooting API endpoints and diagnosing issues across integrated software systems.

    • Have the ability to read and interpret application, platform, API, and integration logs and use technical evidence to identify likely causes of issues.

    • Demonstrate strong troubleshooting, analytical reasoning, and root-cause analysis skills, including the ability to work systematically when the solution is not immediately obvious.

    • Be capable of translating customer requirements into concrete technical implementation activities and practical solutions.

    • Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

    • Have experience collaborating directly with customers, partners, engineers, architects, administrators, and business stakeholders.

    • Demonstrate strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple technical priorities and customer engagements simultaneously.

    • Take ownership of technical problems through resolution and remain accountable for assigned deliverables.

    • Be comfortable working independently and navigating ambiguous situations that require judgment, investigation, and creative problem solving.

    • Collaborate effectively across engineering, product, support, professional services, solution architecture, and other customer-facing teams.

      • Preferred Qualifications:

      • Experience with Contact Center as a Service, customer experience platforms, or enterprise contact center technologies.

      • Experience with conversational AI, generative AI, large language models, or AI-powered customer experiences.

      • Experience designing or implementing virtual agents, chatbots, voice bots, or automated customer-service workflows.

      • Experience with prompt engineering, AI response validation, or LLM testing.

      • Experience with CRM, contact center, telephony, or enterprise application integrations.

      • Experience with webhooks, event-driven integration patterns, and API testing tools.

      • Familiarity with observability, application logging, monitoring, or diagnostic platforms.

      • Familiarity with cloud platforms, cloud-native development environments, Git, and other version-control systems.

      • Experience working in SaaS, Professional Services, Implementation Services, Solution Engineering, or Forward Deployed Engineering environments.

      • Experience developing technical proofs of concept, reusable integration patterns, customer-specific solutions, or deployment tooling.

      • Experience collaborating with Product Management and Product Engineering to identify product gaps or escalate confirmed defects.

      • Understanding of software development lifecycle concepts across development, testing, staging, and production environments.

      • Familiarity with authentication, authorization, configuration management, and basic application security practices.

      • Experience supporting enterprise customers in technically complex or high-touch environments.

        • Benefits:

        • Competitive annual compensation ranging from $85,000 to $140,000 CAD, with placement within the range based on factors such as geographic location, experience, education, and skill level.

        • Fully remote position based in Canada.

        • Opportunity to work at the intersection of software engineering, customer experience, AI, integrations, and enterprise technology.

        • Hands-on exposure to complex customer deployments and technically challenging implementation projects.

        • Opportunity to work with APIs, cloud-native platforms, conversational AI, virtual agents, and AI-powered customer experiences.

        • Cross-functional collaboration with engineering, product, support, professional services, solution architecture, and customer teams.

        • Opportunity to build reusable technical solutions, automation, documentation, and deployment practices that can influence future customer programs.

        • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, and wellness benefits.

        • Collaborative and inclusive environment focused on innovation, creative problem solving, and strong customer relationships.

        • Opportunity to contribute directly to the evolution of modern AI-powered customer experience and contact center technology.

title: Editor, Silver Dolphin & Studio Fun
description:
Silver Dolphin Books & Studio Fun International, the children’s publishing imprints of the Printers Row Publishing Group, are seeking an Editor to join a high-performing, dynamic, and innovative team dedicated to creating engaging novelty, licensed, and educational titles for children ages 0-12. This hybrid role, based in San Diego with three days in-office and two remote days, offers the opportunity to shape and oversee projects from concept through approval to print, hire and oversee freelance writers, and collaborate across editorial, production, and design teams in a very fast-paced, creative environment. Reporting to the Vice President and Publisher of PRPG, the Editor will help drive the development of books that delight and inspire young readers while maintaining the highest standards of quality and excellence.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Oversee and assist in the development, planning, and execution of Silver Dolphin and Studio Fun books (approximately 35 titles per year), managing projects from launch through approval to print.
  • Edit, proofread, and fact-check books ranging from board books for toddlers to movie-based novelty titles to book-plus fiction and nonfiction titles for middle-schoolers, ensuring a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Write up to 8–10 manuscripts per year.
  • Write back cover and marketing copy.
  • Hire and oversee freelance writers.
  • Communicate with production, editorial, and design teams during all phases of development, proactively identifying issues and applying strong problem-solving skills to troubleshoot, including reviewing cover concepts, layouts, and overall book design.
  • Attend weekly production and scheduling meetings and communicate the status of each title related to the schedule, changes to format, and art or design concerns.
  • Maintain accuracy of all information related to titles in the title management database.
  • Upload materials in an organized and timely fashion to online approval systems for licensed titles; experience with licensing is a plus.
  • Prepare title cost sheets to ensure projects are profitable by examining specs and budgets.
  • Manage author, licensor, and packager correspondence with a high degree of organization and professionalism.
  • Be comfortable presenting titles and updates clearly in meetings and to internal stakeholders.
  • Follow established processes for book development, including schedule adherence, routing passes, and reviewing key information with a high degree of organization.
  • Collaborate and brainstorm with a larger creative team while also demonstrating the ability to work independently.
  • Ensure all titles meet PRPG’s standard of quality and artistic excellence.
  • Other duties may be assigned, directed, or requested.

What You Will Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field is required.
  • Four (4) to seven (7) years of relevant editorial or publishing experience is preferred.
  • Experience with licensed publishing is preferred.
  • Experience with graphic novels is preferred.
  • Strong to advanced experience in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook is required.
  • Excellent administrative, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Strong editing and developmental editing skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a very fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for children’s books and awareness of current market trends.
  • Must have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to speak with all levels of the organization and outside partners.
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
  • A methodical and organized approach to problem-solving.
  • The work performed is in an office environment.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate at low decibels.
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced, team environment.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Performance Marketer based in India.

This is a hands-on performance marketing role focused on developing, executing, and optimizing paid media campaigns for multiple clients. You will translate business objectives into measurable media strategies across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant platforms. The role combines campaign management with data analysis, conversion optimization, attribution, and performance reporting. You will take ownership of tracking systems and help resolve measurement and attribution challenges across lead generation and e-commerce campaigns. The position also involves direct client communication, presenting actionable insights, and collaborating with internal teams to improve campaign outcomes. You will have the opportunity to work independently, contribute to client growth, and support the development of junior team members in a fast-paced digital marketing environment.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and execute performance marketing strategies across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant advertising platforms, aligning campaigns with client objectives, budgets, and performance KPIs.

title: Hut Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Hut Coordinator

Location: Phoenix, Arizona


Department: Operations / Deployment


Reports To: Project Manager / Deployment Manager


Position Type: Full-Time


Pay Scale: $20.00 - $32.00 / hour (Depending on Experience)


Position Overview

We are seeking an organized, technically skilled, and proactive Hut Coordinator to oversee, synchronize, and execute our infrastructure deployment projects in Phoenix, AZ. In this role, you will serve as both the operational backbone and hands-on technical lead for our fiber and network hub installations ("huts").


You will manage the end-to-end site deployment lifecycle-from initial permitting, utility coordination, and vendor tracking to hands-on equipment rack-and-stack, structured cabling, DC power, and fiber testing. The ideal candidate blends project coordination discipline with inside plant (ISP) technical expertise to ensure sites transition seamlessly from raw ground to fully active, standards-compliant network hubs.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Buildout Coordination

  • Oversee the end-to-end hut deployment process, ensuring sites transition seamlessly from raw ground to active, fully operational network hubs.
  • Coordinate critical infrastructure prerequisites, including power utility drop requests, electrical hookups, and civil site preparation.
  • Navigate local permitting and zoning requirements, submitting documentation and tracking municipal approvals to prevent deployment delays.

Schedule, Vendor & Financial Tracking

  • Maintain complete oversight of project critical paths, identifying potential bottlenecks early and implementing mitigation strategies to hit deployment deadlines.
  • Track project milestones, manage deployment schedules, and provide clear operational visibility to leadership.
  • Handle vendor accruals and track field expenditures to ensure work completed is accurately accounted for prior to formal invoicing.
  • Monitor contractor and vendor deliverables to ensure work meets construction, safety, and contract standards.

Communication & Site Documentation

  • Serve as the primary liaison between internal market teams, field technicians, contractors, municipal entities, and executive leadership.
  • Work directly from installation documentation, architectural drawings, and Method of Procedure (MOP) guidelines.
  • Maintain comprehensive project logs, site buildout records, labeling, and data documentation to guarantee full operational visibility and accuracy.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 2+ years combining project coordination/management with hands-on Inside Plant (ISP), Central Office, Data Center, telecom, or civil infrastructure deployment experience.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Hands-on experience with equipment rack-and-stack, structured cabling (CAT5/6, fiber), and cable management systems.
  • Familiarity with grounding, bonding, basic DC power concepts, and fiber/copper testing tools.
  • Practical understanding of utility provisioning, electrical hookups, and municipal permitting workflows.
  • Financial Literacy: Basic understanding of project accounting principles, vendor accruals, purchase orders, and site budget tracking.
  • Software & Tools: Proficiency with Google Suite/Microsoft Excel and project management tracking platforms (e.g., Smartsheet, Asana, or Jira).
  • Soft Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication, strong problem-solving skills, and the self-motivation needed to manage high-volume, multi-faceted projects independently.

Benefits & Work Schedule

  • Work Schedule: Full-time hours, Monday through Friday (flexible for scheduled night/overnight cutover work as needed).
  • Benefits Package: Comprehensive benefits including W-2 employment, Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Holidays, Health/Dental/Vision Insurance, 401(k), HSA, and long-term growth opportunities.

• Experience with GIS, spatial econometrics, remote-sensing data, or spatial models is highly desirable.
• Knowledge of tariff modeling, cost-of-service analysis, regulatory benchmarking, affordability analysis, microsimulation, or utility financial modeling is highly desirable.
• Ability to communicate complex quantitative findings through clear graphics, maps, and presentations.
• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English; proficiency in another language relevant to World Bank Group operations is an asset.

Duties and accountabilities:
A. Applied Empirical Research and Data Analysis
• Design and implement rigorous empirical analyses using household, utility, firm, administrative, fiscal, and geospatial data.
• Apply advanced econometric methods, including panel-data analysis and causal inference approaches using quasi-experimental and other credible identification strategies.
• Apply spatial econometric and geospatial methods where relevant to analyze geographic variation and spatial dimensions of water-sector outcomes.
• Develop clear visualizations, maps, tables, and analytical code that meet high standards of transparency and replicability.
B. Regulatory Economics, Tariffs, and Utility Performance
• Analyze regulatory and institutional frameworks and the design and implementation of economic instruments across water supply and sanitation, irrigation, and water resources management, including tariffs and user charges, abstraction and pollution charges, subsidies, water rights and allocation mechanisms, and other incentive-based instruments.
• Assess pricing, tariff, subsidy, and other reform options against objectives of economic efficiency, financial sustainability, and affordability and equity, taking account of institutional and political-economy conditions.
• Evaluate the distributional, fiscal, and performance implications of water-sector policies and reforms, including distributional impacts across income groups, users, sectors, and assess appropriate mechanisms for affordability, subsidy targeting, and social protection.
C. Knowledge Products and Operational Support
• Contribute to flagship reports, policy notes, country diagnostics, and operational guidance. Support the development and refinement of standardized analytical tools, methodologies, and scalable solutions related to regulation, tariffs, subsidies, and utility performance.
• Contribute to the preparation of high-quality analytical reports, including developing report narrative, synthesizing quantitative and qualitative evidence, drafting and revising substantive chapters, integrating peer-review comments, and producing publication-ready outputs for technical and senior policy audiences.
• Translate analytical findings into concise, actionable recommendations for governments, private investors, and development partners.
• Provide just-in-time analytical support to regional and country teams, including data diagnostics, tariff and affordability analysis, regulatory assessments, and inputs to project design and implementation.
D. Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing
• Work collaboratively with economists, water specialists, engineers, financial specialists, social inclusion, and operational teams across the World Bank Group.
• Present work at seminars, workshops, clinics, and knowledge-exchange events and respond constructively to peer review. Contribute to team learning.
