title: Life Enrichment Coordinator
description:
Nestled in San Francisco's Excelsior neighborhood on a nine-acre campus, the San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living (SFCJL) is the leading senior services organization in Northern California. Our continuum of care includes: the Frank Residences assisted living and memory care; the Jewish Home and Rehabilitation Center, offering long-term skilled nursing, short-term rehabilitation, an acute geriatric psychiatric unit for adults over the age of 65; and our Foundation.

Founded in 1871 and formerly known as the Jewish Home, our legacy grounds us as our vision propels us forward. Today, we've evolved to support more than 2,500 older adults each year through innovative, comprehensive programs rooted in the Jewish values of compassion, community, and excellence. We are equally proud of our inclusive culture, where 950 team members of diverse faiths and backgrounds work together in shared purpose.

WHY WORK WITH US

  • Mission-driven nonprofit organization
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits
  • Meaningful work that positively impacts the lives of older adults every day
  • Inclusive community, welcoming to all (you do not need to be Jewish to live or work here)
  • Supportive, team-oriented environment
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Collaborative leadership focused on enhancing the employee experience

POSITION SUMMARY

As a Life Enrichment Coordinator (LEC), you will plan and lead a variety of person-centered programs designed to enhance the emotional, social, and recreational well-being of residents in assisted living and memory care settings. You will foster a positive and engaging environment through group, one-on-one, and self-directed activities while promoting inclusion, creativity, and meaningful resident connection. This role supports interdisciplinary collaboration, documentation compliance, and the overall quality of life across campus.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide ongoing opportunities for therapeutic self-expression for residents at all stages of memory loss, utilizing a wide variety of modalities to optimize quality of life and functional ability.
  • Facilitate programs that encourage social interaction, reduce isolation and boredom, and decrease the frequency and severity of behaviors associated with dementia.
  • Create a positive, caring, and stimulating environment that respects the diverse personalities and cultural backgrounds of all residents.
  • Motivate residents to actively participate in Life Enrichment programs to enhance quality of life and maintain cognitive functioning.
  • Encourage participation from families, volunteers, and caregiver staff as appropriate.
  • Understand and respond to the individual needs and abilities of residents and families, adapting activities accordingly.
  • Provide one-on-one engagement for residents who decline or are unable to participate in group activities.
  • Support the psychosocial needs of residents and families by providing emotional support during times of crisis or decline.
  • Complete required documentation in a timely manner, including attendance records, care plans, activity notes, and mandated reports as required.
  • Collaborate with caregiver staff, Byer Square staff, and Life Enrichment teams across campus to promote teamwork, quality outcomes, and meaningful programming.
  • Mentor and support student interns and volunteers involved in activities.

JOB DETAILS

  • Pay Rate: $27.00 to 29.00 per hour
  • Hours: 40 hours per week
  • Shift Schedule: 8:00 to 5:00 PM
  • Days Off: Wednesday, Thursday
  • Working Days: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Monday, Tuesday

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in recreational therapy, psychology, social work, healthcare, recreation administration, or related field preferred.
  • Two (2) years of experience working with older adults in group or long-term care settings.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and group facilitation skills.
  • Demonstrated creativity, flexibility, and resourcefulness in program development.
  • Sensitivity to diverse physical, emotional, cognitive, and cultural needs.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an interdisciplinary team.
  • Ability to engage individuals from diverse cultural, religious, and social backgrounds.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to lift a minimum of twenty-five (25) pounds.
  • Ability to exert maximum muscle force to lift, push, pull, or carry.
  • Ability to use abdominal and lower back muscles over time without fatigue.
  • Ability to stand and/or sit for extended periods.
  • Ability to bend, stoop, stretch, twist, sit, and reach.
  • Fine motor skills and good visual and auditory acuity.
  • Ability to safely transport residents in wheelchairs without fatigue over extended periods.

OUR INVESTMENT IN YOU

Comprehensive benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage; a 403(b) Retirement Plan; Paid Time Off (PTO); Tuition Reimbursement; Commuter Benefits; and Weekday Shuttle Service to and from Glen Park BART Station.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in Netherlands.

This is a senior individual-contributor role embedded directly within a product squad working on complex, high-risk technology domains.
You’ll act as the squad’s technical authority on quality, shaping test strategy, automation, performance, and integration practices.
The role goes beyond test execution, giving you ownership of architecture, quality gates, and the most challenging testing problems.
You’ll work closely with engineering and product teams from the earliest stages, challenging ambiguity before development begins.
You’ll also contribute to broader QA standards, mentor engineers, and lead initiatives that improve testing across the wider organization.
The environment values technical depth, autonomy, continuous improvement, and practical use of modern AI-assisted QA tooling.
It’s an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on reliable, high-scale financial technology as a senior technical leader without moving into management.

Accountabilities

  • Embed fully within an engineering squad, participating in sprint planning, daily standups, reviews, retrospectives, and other ceremonies as a core technical contributor.

  • Define and refine acceptance criteria with Product Owners, identifying ambiguity and quality risks before implementation begins.

  • Own the squad’s test architecture and strategy, determining how unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing work together and identifying coverage gaps.

  • Lead performance and load testing, establishing baselines, evaluating throughput and concurrency limits, and translating findings into actionable engineering improvements.

  • Own the squad’s Definition of Done and quality gates, serving as a final internal quality check before releases progress to staging or production.

  • Design, maintain, and improve automated test suites that remain reliable, readable, maintainable, and effective within CI environments.

  • Triage complex test failures and distinguish flaky tests from genuine regressions, particularly across high-traffic, high-risk, or highly integrated areas.

  • Mentor QA Engineers within the squad and across the wider QA community, raising standards around automation, test design, and engineering practices.

  • Represent the squad in broader QA initiatives and contribute to chapter-wide standards, tooling decisions, onboarding resources, and testing practices.

  • Take ownership of a strategic QA initiative, such as a contract-testing framework, performance-testing toolkit, testing discipline, or AI-assisted test generation workflow.

  • Actively leverage AI and LLM tooling for test case generation, synthetic data creation, regression triage, documentation, and other areas where automation can accelerate QA work.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of QA engineering experience in a software product environment, with demonstrated ownership of testing strategy for complex technical domains.

    • Strong test automation engineering skills, with the ability to write production-quality tests in Java, Python, or JavaScript and build stable, maintainable suites that run effectively in CI.

    • Deep experience with API testing, including REST APIs, contract testing, integration testing, HTTP semantics, and JSON schema validation.

    • Hands-on experience with performance and load testing, including designing tests, interpreting throughput and concurrency results, identifying bottlenecks, and translating findings into engineering action.

    • Strong experience working in Java-based backend environments, with the ability to understand application architecture, read Java code, and create tests that accurately reflect system behavior.

    • High level of technical autonomy and confidence operating without a dedicated QA manager, with the ability to make sound quality decisions and represent QA practices across teams.

    • Proven ability to mentor other QA engineers, improve engineering standards, and lead through technical expertise rather than formal authority.

    • Experience in fintech, payments, or digital financial services is strongly preferred, particularly where reliability and correctness are critical.

    • Familiarity with contract testing tools such as Pact or equivalent approaches within microservices environments is a strong advantage.

    • Mobile testing experience, particularly Android, using tools such as Espresso or Appium, or structured manual testing supported by regression frameworks, is beneficial.

    • Experience contributing to a QA chapter, guild, community of practice, or internal training program is valued.

    • Familiarity with AI-assisted QA workflows, including LLM-based test generation, regression analysis, and synthetic test data creation, is a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work as a senior technical individual contributor with substantial ownership and influence.

      • Full integration into a product squad, with a direct role in engineering decisions and product delivery rather than functioning as a downstream QA resource.

      • Opportunity to shape testing standards, architecture, tooling, and quality practices beyond your immediate squad.

      • Strong platform for technical leadership and mentoring without requiring a transition into people management.

      • Exposure to complex, high-scale fintech and digital financial services systems where software quality has a direct customer and business impact.

      • Opportunity to lead organization-wide QA initiatives and introduce improved testing disciplines and tooling.

      • Flexible European-based working environment with collaboration across international engineering teams.

      • Opportunity to work with AI-assisted testing and modern QA automation practices as part of an evolving engineering environment.

title: Director, Pipeline Engineering
description:
About Nscale

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for the AI revolution. Nscale is developing cutting-edge, sovereign generative AI solutions powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centers and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads.

The rapid growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Positioned at the heart of this transformation, Nscale is delivering the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation.

Working closely with the world's most advanced AI technology providers, including Microsoft and NVIDIA, Nscale integrates next-generation compute hardware and Next GPU clusters across both partner and self-delivered facilities. This is a unique opportunity to join Nscale's journey, play a pivotal role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across North America, Europe, and beyond.

About the Role

We are hiring a Director, Pipeline Engineering to own the engineering of the natural gas transmission pipelines that fuel Nscale's generation campuses, from upstream interconnect to plant fence.

Nscale's Power and Energy group develops behind-the-meter generation colocated with our data center campuses: large reciprocating engine fleets served by dedicated, large-diameter gas transmission pipelines moving hundreds of millions of cubic feet per day. These are not ordinary laterals. The pipeline is also the storage: line pack is the operating inventory that buffers nominations against engine demand, pressure is governed by that inventory balance, and the design of overpressure protection, regulation, and system controls determines whether gigawatts of compute stay online. Much of this work is closer to process engineering than to conventional pipeline design, and this role owns it.

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role built for someone who runs independently, with full delegated ownership of the pipeline scope. You will establish the design basis for our pipelines and demonstrate how it ties to our downstream commitments (engine demand, swing, and availability), drive the engineering through hydraulic design, controls philosophy, and construction, and technically manage the third-party engineering firms and pipeline construction contractors doing the work. Lines are in delivery today and new lines will follow, so the role owns both the systems being built now and the reference engineering for what comes next.

You will sit within the Power and Energy technology organization, working alongside the generation engineering and commissioning teams that depend on the gas you deliver. You will be the owner's technical authority on the pipeline scope, directing the work of consultants and contractors rather than simply accepting it, and resolving the design questions where standard midstream practice does not account for a single customer whose demand can swing with AI workloads. As the accountable leader for pipeline engineering at Nscale, you will set the design basis, establish the standards, and represent Nscale's position with EPC partners, upstream operators, and executives, and you will be expected to do so from day one.

Location: Houston, TX (remote considered within the US, with regular site and vendor travel)

What You'll Be Doing

Pipeline system engineering and design basis

  • Own the design basis for Nscale's gas transmission pipelines: hydraulic design, MAOP and pressure regime, line pack and inventory strategy, routing and sizing philosophy, and expansion provisions for future lines.
  • Perform and direct steady-state and transient hydraulic modeling of the pipeline systems, and own the models as living engineering assets that answer real operating questions: inventory swing, survival time on line pack, ramp response, and curtailment scenarios.
  • Demonstrate explicitly how the pipeline design basis supports downstream commitments: engine fleet demand and turndown, campus availability requirements, and the nominations-versus-consumption balance that governs system pressure.
  • Evaluate gas storage and supply resilience options, including line pack utilization, interconnect diversity, and cross-connection strategies between lines, with clear analysis of the risk each option carries.

Process and controls engineering

  • Own the overpressure protection philosophy across the pipeline systems: regulation, monitor, slam-shut, and relief selection, justified against reliability requirements, industry practice, and regulatory obligations rather than habit.
  • Define the control philosophy at interconnects, letdown stations, and plant interfaces: pressure versus flow control, control interactions with upstream operators' facilities, and the measurement and SCADA provisions needed to run the system on inventory.
  • Apply process safety discipline to the pipeline scope: lead and support HAZOPs and design reviews, own the closure of actions, and carry management of change through design and construction.
  • Engineer the interface into the plant fuel gas systems, coordinating conditioning, letdown, and protection philosophies so pipeline and plant behave as one system.

Regulatory compliance and integrity

  • Own compliance of the pipeline designs with 49 CFR Part 192 and the applicable ASME B31 codes, including the code boundaries between jurisdictional pipeline and plant piping.
  • Establish material, welding, and construction specifications, class location and MAOP documentation, and the records discipline that a traceable, verifiable, and complete basis requires.
  • Lay the foundation for integrity management: baseline assessment planning, pigging and inspection provisions, and mainline valve philosophy, including remote actuation and its treatment in availability analysis.
  • Support commissioning and first gas: purge and pack planning, energization of the measurement and control systems, and readiness reviews in partnership with the commissioning and startup organization.

Third-party technical management

  • Technically manage the engineering consultants supporting the pipeline scope: set the design basis they work to, review and challenge their deliverables, and integrate their output into a coherent whole.
  • Direct pipeline construction contractors on technical matters: specification compliance, field queries, deviation dispositions, and as-built reconciliation.
  • Own the technical interface with upstream pipeline operators and interconnect counterparties: metering station design, control coordination, nominations behavior, and the operating agreements' technical exhibits.
  • Hold third parties to disciplined engineering, testing, and documentation, and know when their standard answer is not good enough for this application.
  • Own the scope, schedule, and budget of third-party pipeline engineering: define consultant scopes of work, review and recommend change orders and addenda, and hold firms accountable to their commitments.

Standards and cross-functional leadership

  • Develop Nscale's engineering standards, specifications, and reference designs for gas pipelines, so each new line builds on the last instead of starting over.
  • Coordinate with generation engineering on fuel gas requirements, with permitting and land teams on routing and regulatory strategy, and with commercial teams on gas supply and transportation arrangements.
  • Build and lead the internal pipeline engineering function, directing specialist consultants today and hiring and developing a team as the portfolio scales.
  • Communicate complex pipeline and process issues clearly to project leadership and executives, with honest assessments of risk and readiness, and represent Nscale's pipeline scope in design basis alignment with EPC partners, upstream operators, and customers.

About You

  • 15+ years of natural gas pipeline engineering experience across design, construction, and operations, with significant time in a lead or owner's engineer role on transmission systems, including senior accountability for the outcome of major transmission projects.
  • Deep hydraulic engineering capability, including transient modeling of gas transmission systems, and the judgment to translate model results into design and operating decisions.
  • Strong process engineering instincts: comfort with inventory-based system behavior, regulation and overpressure protection design, control philosophy development, and process safety methods such as HAZOP.
  • Working fluency with 49 CFR Part 192 and ASME B31.8, including MAOP determination, class location, and the code interfaces with plant piping under B31.1 or B31.3.
  • Hands-on experience with measurement and regulation stations, interconnects with major interstate pipelines, and the commercial mechanics of nominations and transportation that drive system behavior.
  • Experience taking pipeline scopes through construction, hydrotest, and first gas on major projects, and comfort in the field when systems misbehave.
  • Proven ability to direct engineering consultants and construction contractors, and to make technically defensible decisions under schedule pressure.
  • Demonstrated ability to own a scope independently and be delegated to with confidence: establishing the basis, setting the pace, and escalating with solutions rather than problems.
  • Proven ability to build standards, processes, and teams in a fast-scaling environment, including hiring and developing engineers.
  • Industry standing (code committee participation, technical society leadership, or equivalent) is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, or Civil Engineering or a related field; PE license preferred.
  • Willing and able to travel to project sites, vendor facilities, and construction spreads regularly (typically 25%, higher during construction and commissioning campaigns).

What We Can Offer You

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and our people are driving it.

  • Highly competitive US compensation package (base + bonus + equity), with performance reviews every 12 months
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Generous PTO plus US federal holidays
  • A career-defining opportunity to be an early member of one of the fastest growing AI infrastructure companies in the world
  • A human-first approach: We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy needed to get the job done.

Equal Opportunities Statement

At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds. If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.

For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee & Candidate Privacy Notice.

The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.

Salary Range
$170,000—$290,000 USD

title: Cloud Data Engineer | AI‑Ready Pipelines & Databricks
description:
Werken aan slimme ai gedreven data-oplossingen in de cloud, voor klanten én interne producten zoals het ilionx Dataplatform. Dát is jouw rol als Data Engineer bij ilionx.

Ben jij een Data Engineer met ervaring in tools als Python, PySpark, DBT of SQL? En werk je graag met moderne technologieën zoals Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake en Power BI? Dan hebben we binnen onze landelijke Data & AI community van ilionx volop mogelijkheden voor jou. We zoeken collega’s in onder andere Amsterdam, Woerden, Utrecht, Zwolle, Groningen, Den Bosch en Maastricht.

jouw functie als Data Engineer

Als Data Engineer bij ilionx werk je aan het ontwerpen en realiseren van schaalbare en toekomstbestendige dataoplossingen in de cloud. Je transformeert ruwe data naar waardevolle inzichten via moderne dataplatformen zoals Microsoft Fabric, Databricks en Snowflake. Je ontwikkelt data pipelines met PySpark, Python, DBT, SQL en Matillion en draagt bij aan het bouwen van AI-ready dataplatformen, dashboards en slimme datastromen.

Je werkt voor klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren zoals zorg, overheid, finance, energie, onderwijs, telecom, retail en mobiliteit. Denk aan het migreren van on-premise omgevingen naar Azure, het ontsluiten van complexe bronsystemen of het bouwen van datagedreven oplossingen die echt bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming. Ook kun je bijdragen aan interne innovaties zoals het ilionx Dataplatform of ZorgControl. Daarbij verkennen we actief hoe generatieve AI waarde toevoegt aan onze data engineeringpraktijk.

Je krijgt bij ons de ruimte om je eigen pad te kiezen. Wil je je verdiepen in Snowflake of Databricks, of juist doorgroeien naar architect? Liever coach of trainer, of je ontwikkelen richting AI en Data Science? Samen met je team en manager bepaal jij je richting!

wat bieden wij jou:

- Een salarisrange tussen de €4.500,- en €6.500,- op 40 uur met bonussysteem
- Een uitgebreide leaseregeling voor zowel auto als fiets
- Een keuze tussen werken voor de klant of het doorontwikkelen van ilionx eigen data driven producten welke als managed services worden aangeboden
- Een flexibele werkomgeving rekening houdend met jouw specifieke wensen
- Een groter wordende focus en visie op AI gedreven werken

wat vragen wij van jou:

- Een afgeronde HBO/WO diploma
- Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met BI en/of Data Engineering
- Je ziet de kansen van AI en denkt vooruit
- Kennis van en ervaring met: Python en Spark
- Kennis van: Databricks, Fabric, Snowflake, Synapse
- Kennis van dimensionaal datamodelleren en logical modelling
- Kennis van de data architecture concepten Medallion en Mesh
- Beheersing van de Nederlandse taal vloeiend in woord en geschrift

Deze eisen geven een richting aan het profiel dat wij zoeken voor deze functie. Voldoe jij niet aan alle eisen maar denk je wel dat dit de functie voor jou is? Dan nodigen wij je graag uit om te solliciteren!

het team

Bij ilionx werk je in een van onze regioteams, verspreid over ruim 10+ vestigingen en met in totaal wel ruim 300+ Data & AI specialisten! Ieder team heeft een eigen dynamiek, maar overal staan vakmanschap, kennisdelen en teamgevoel centraal. Je werkt samen met een mix van juniors, mediors en seniors met achtergronden in data engineering, analytics, BI, platform engineering en cloud.

We geloven in eigenaarschap, korte lijnen en aandacht voor elkaar. En in werkplezier: van gezamenlijke lunches en kennissessies tot sportieve uitjes, kwartaalbijeenkomsten, een warm kerstdiner én een uitstekend verzorgde wintersport!

Maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen speelt bij ons een belangrijke rol. Zeker in de zorg maken we het verschil met data. Maar ook breder zoeken we projecten waarbij we met technologie bijdragen aan mens en maatschappij.

landelijke dekking

Met wel 10+ kantoren zijn wij landelijk vertegenwoordigd en op die manier kunnen wij regionaal vanuit verschillende vestigingen het verschil maken. Sluit jij je aan bij één van onze ilionx datateams in jouw regio?

title: Product Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Engineer based in Netherlands.

This is a high-ownership Product Engineer role within a small, senior team building foundational technology for the commercial insurance market.
You will take complex problems from an initial thesis through design, implementation, deployment, and continuous iteration, with broad freedom over how solutions are built.
The role spans the full product and engineering stack, from user interfaces and APIs to data models, background jobs, and AI-powered workflows.
You will work with large-scale, structured insurance data to create intuitive products used by brokers, lenders, underwriters, and other insurance professionals.
AI is deeply embedded in the engineering workflow, and you will be expected to use modern coding agents and AI tooling to increase development speed and leverage.
With no traditional Product Manager or QA layer, Product Engineers are expected to exercise strong product judgment, challenge assumptions, and own outcomes rather than simply execute specifications.
This is an opportunity to join an ambitious, highly empowered environment where your work can have immediate impact on a rapidly evolving financial infrastructure market.

Accountabilities

  • Own product features end to end, from defining scope and identifying dependencies through development, deployment, customer adoption, and iteration.

  • Work across the full technology stack as needed, including user interfaces, APIs, data models, backend services, background jobs, and infrastructure integrations.

  • Transform complex, data-heavy insurance information into clear, intuitive interfaces that professionals can rely on in their daily workflows.

  • Lead a product squad and take responsibility for a defined area of the platform, with ownership aligned to your strongest technical and product instincts.

  • Identify dependencies on adjacent teams or systems, clearly define what is required, and proactively address potential blockers.

  • Use AI coding tools, agents, and agentic workflows extensively to accelerate development and increase engineering leverage.

  • Contribute to model evaluation and benchmarking initiatives, helping determine which AI models and approaches are appropriate for customer-facing and data-sensitive workflows.

title: QA Chapter Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a QA Chapter Lead based in Germany.

This is a senior technical QA leadership role combining hands-on engineering with responsibility for quality standards across multiple engineering squads. You’ll be embedded directly within one squad while also shaping QA strategy, automation, tooling, and testing practices across the wider engineering function. You’ll influence how quality is built into the development lifecycle, from acceptance criteria and automated testing to Definition of Done standards and CI quality gates. The role offers significant technical ownership without traditional people-management responsibilities. You’ll collaborate with QA engineers, Product Owners, Tech Leads, and engineering leadership in an Agile environment. This is an opportunity to establish scalable QA practices and directly improve the reliability and quality of complex, data-driven financial products.

Accountabilities:

  • Work as an embedded senior QA engineer within one engineering squad, actively participating in sprint planning, daily standups, reviews, retrospectives, and other squad ceremonies.
  • Define and agree on clear acceptance criteria with Product Owners before work enters each sprint.
  • Design, write, maintain, and improve automated test suites across appropriate levels, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Own the squad’s Definition of Done quality gate and ensure agreed quality criteria are consistently met before releases.
  • Define and maintain QA standards across the engineering function, including test-pyramid principles, automation tooling, naming conventions, coverage thresholds, and CI quality gates.
  • Establish onboarding processes and baseline QA expectations for engineers joining the chapter.
  • Lead a monthly QA Guild with the counterpart Chapter Lead to align standards, tooling, frameworks, and Definition of Done practices across engineering.
  • Own the selection, evaluation, evolution, and documentation of QA automation frameworks and tools.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce, improve, or retire testing technologies based on engineering needs and effectiveness.
  • Monitor and report on QA chapter health, including coverage trends, flaky-test rates, automation backlogs, and systemic quality risks.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to identify and address quality issues that affect multiple teams or the wider platform.
  • Promote a proactive quality culture in which QA is integrated into development from the beginning rather than treated as a final-stage validation function.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software QA experience, including at least 2 years in a Lead QA role with responsibility for test strategy across multiple teams.
  • Strong automation engineering skills and the ability to write maintainable, readable, production-quality test code that runs reliably in CI environments.
  • Deep experience with API testing, including REST APIs, contract testing, integration testing, and backend-focused test design.
  • Proven experience defining and maintaining QA standards within Agile product or engineering teams.
  • Experience working as an embedded QA contributor throughout the development lifecycle rather than operating solely as a final quality gate.
  • Strong understanding of Java-based backend environments, including the ability to read Java code, understand system architecture, and create effective tests for backend functionality.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineering teams and drive consistency across squads without direct line-management authority.
  • High level of technical ownership, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and commitment to engineering quality.

Strongly preferred:

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital financial services, or another environment where reliability and transaction integrity are critical.
  • Experience with performance and load testing, including API concurrency, throughput, and identifying scalability issues before production.
  • Mobile application testing experience, particularly Android.
  • Experience establishing or evolving a QA chapter, guild, community of practice, or similar cross-team QA structure.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing tools for test-case generation, regression triage, synthetic test data creation, or related QA workflows.

title: Staff Mission Solutions Engineer
description:
Staff Mission Solutions Engineer

About Us:

BlackSky is a real-time intelligence company. We own and operate the world's most advanced space-based intelligence platform and provide customers satellite imagery, automated analytics and high-frequency monitoring of strategic locations, economic assets and events from around the globe. BlackSky is trusted by the most demanding allied military and intelligence organizations and commercial companies to deliver foresight into critical matters that affect national security and the economy. BlackSky's data enables governments and businesses to see, understand and anticipate change as it happens, giving them the ultimate strategic advantage so they can act quickly. Our global team works with cutting-edge technology to make a difference around the world and prides itself on being people-first, customer-focused and fun.

We are seeking a Mission Solutions Engineer to drive technical sales for our electro-optical (EO) satellite sales portfolio, with a primary focus on international defense, and intelligence (D&I) customers. This is a field-facing, revenue-critical role that bridges deep remote sensing and satellite expertise with consultative selling — translating complex space imaging hardware, software, and communications network capabilities into sovereign mission value for customers outside the United States.

You will partner directly with Regional Business Development, Systems Engineering and Account Management leads to scope requirements, design technical solutions, deliver compelling demonstrations, and support the full sales cycle from initial qualification through contract award. This remote role reports to the Senior Director of Solutions Engineering and will have travel expectations of approximately 50%, primarily international. We may be open to a strong international candidate in or near Abu Dhabi, London, or Singapore.

Responsibilities:

Technical Sales Engagement

  • Serve as the lead technical advisor throughout the satellite sales cycle, partnering with BD Leads on international defense, intelligence, and government accounts.
  • Translate customer mission requirements (ISR, imaging constellation performance, satellite specifications, communications and latency requirements, ground software, collection planning,) into tailored proposals for procurement of satellite constellations based in BlackSky’s existing and future designs.
  • Deliver technical presentations, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept exercises to senior military, intelligence, and government stakeholders.
  • Respond to RFIs/RFPs with technical narratives, satellite specifications, and ground software architecture inputs.

Solution Design & Scoping

  • Work to understand procurement model, involvement in operations, and integration requirements for both ground and space segments.
  • Advise on integration of satellite systems into customer GEOINT/ISR systems, ground stations, and analytic tool chains.
  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering to relay field requirements and competitive intelligence from international markets.

Customer & Market Engagement

  • Build and maintain trusted technical relationships with defense ministries, intelligence services, and allied government agencies outside the US.
  • Represent the company at international defense/space trade shows, industry days, and government briefings.
  • Navigate export control data sovereignty, regional offset requirements, and foreign disclosure considerations relevant to each market.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with Contracts, Legal, and Export Compliance on deal structuring for international government sales.
  • Capture and document lessons learned, win/loss technical feedback, and competitive positioning.
  • Other job-related duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of eight (8) years of experience in solutions engineering, sales engineering, or technical account management within the commercial remote sensing, satellite imaging, or broader space industry.
  • Working knowledge of electro-optical (EO) satellite imaging systems — satellite hardware, collection planning, tasking, resolution/revisit tradeoffs, and imagery product types, ground architecture, and satellite command and control.
  • Demonstrated experience selling or supporting sales to international defense, intelligence, or government customers.
  • Understanding of (or willingness to quickly learn) regional and customer nuance as it relates to offset, export control, IP transfer, etc.
  • Familiarity with GEOINT/ISR workflows and how imagery integrates into customer analytic and operational systems.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience briefing senior military, government, or intelligence stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field (geography, GIS, remote sensing, engineering, or related) or equivalent professional experience.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally approximately 50% of the time.
  • Fluency in English required; additional regional languages a plus depending on territory.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior military, intelligence community, or government service, especially in a role involving imagery intelligence (IMINT), targeting, or ISR operations.
  • Direct experience with a commercial satellite operator or satellite services provider.
  • Existing professional network among defense ministries, intelligence services, or systems integrators in the Gulf, Europe, or Asia-Pacific.
  • Advanced degree in engineering, geography, remote sensing, space systems, or a related technical field.
  • Experience with SAR or multi-sensor fusion in addition to EO imagery.
  • Familiarity with CRM and sales engineering tools (Salesforce, technical proposal platforms).
  • Existing security clearance or eligibility for one, where applicable to the assigned territory.

Life at BlackSky for full-time benefits eligible employees in the US includes:

  • Medical, dental, vision, disability, group term life and AD&D, voluntary life and AD&D insurance
    • BlackSky pays 100% of employee-only premiums for medical, dental and vision and contributes $100/month for out-of-pocket expenses!
  • 15 days of PTO, 11 Company holidays, four Floating Holidays (pro-rated based on hire date), one day of paid volunteerism leave per year, parental leave and more
  • 401(k) pre-tax and Roth deferral options with employer match
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Employee Assistance and Travel Assistance Programs
  • Employer matching donations
  • Professional development
  • Mac or PC? Your choice!
  • Awesome swag

The anticipated salary range for candidates in Seattle, WA is $165,000-205,000 per year. The final compensation package offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on specific background and education. BlackSky is a multi-state employer, and this pay scale may not reflect salary ranges in other states or locations outside of Seattle, WA. BlackSky is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. #LI-Remote

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
Bitdefender is a cybersecurity leader delivering best-in-class threat prevention, detection, and response solutions worldwide. Guardian over millions of consumer, enterprise, and government environments, Bitdefender is one of the industry’s most trusted experts for eliminating threats, protecting privacy, digital identity and data, and enabling cyber resilience. With deep investments in research and development, Bitdefender Labs discovers hundreds of new threats each minute and validates billions of threat queries daily. The company has pioneered breakthrough innovations in antimalware, IoT security, behavioral analytics, and artificial intelligence and its technology is licensed by more than 180 of the world’s most recognized technology brands. Founded in 2001, Bitdefender has customers in 170+ countries with offices around the world. For more information, visit https://www.bitdefender.com

We are looking for a motivated QA Automation Engineer to join our growing QA team in APAC region and build the software, frameworks, and engineering practices that improve the quality, reliability, and scalability of GravityZone products.

Reporting to the QA Lead, you will design and develop automated test systems for web, API, micro-services, and backend processing workflows. You will work closely with software engineers, product managers, tech leads, and QA engineers across different countries, cultures, and time zones to improve testability and deliver high-quality software in an Agile environment.

This position is ideal for Software Engineer in Test with strong software engineering skills and quality-engineering judgment who can work independently, solve complex technical problems, and build maintainable automation at scale. Manual and exploratory testing may be performed when needed, but the primary focus is software development for testing, automation architecture, and continuous quality feedback.

You will have the opportunity to gain insight into how Bitdefender protects millions of users worldwide, from small businesses to large enterprises and law enforcement organizations, against constantly evolving cyber threats.

About the Role

  • Automation Framework and Tooling Development: Design, develop, and maintain reusable Java-based automation components, API clients, Page Object Models, test-data utilities, and diagnostic tools using Maven, TestNG, and Selenium.
  • Automated Test Development and Coverage: Build reliable automated coverage for GravityZone UI, REST/JSON-RPC APIs, backend processing, and system integrations, prioritizing critical workflows and regression risks.
  • CI/CD and Test Reliability: Integrate automated suites into Bamboo, investigate failures, reduce flaky tests, and improve execution speed and reporting. Connect automated results to TestRail for coverage and execution tracking.
  • Testability and Technical Mentorship: Collaborate with developers on testable designs, review automation code, define engineering standards, and mentor QA engineers in coding and automation practices.
  • Release Validation and Targeted Manual Testing: Support release readiness through acceptance, smoke, and exploratory testing where automation is unavailable or unsuitable. Investigate defects and contribute to release-owner activities.
  • Environment and Infrastructure Support: Provision and troubleshoot cloud and on-premise test environments and contribute to the maintenance of QA virtualization infrastructure, including Proxmox.

About You

  • 8+ years in software development, test automation, or quality engineering, with substantial hands-on experience building automated test systems.
  • Strong Java programming, object-oriented design, and debugging skills, with hands-on experience using Maven, TestNG, and Selenium WebDriver.
  • Proven ownership of automation framework architecture, including reusable libraries and Page Object Models, with maintainable test code supported by code reviews and engineering standards.
  • Experience automating web interfaces, including Web Components and Shadow DOM, alongside REST/JSON-RPC APIs, asynchronous backend workflows, and integrations; able to validate data using SQL or NoSQL queries.
  • Experience reducing flaky tests, improving execution speed, and building reliable test-data setup and cleanup. Able to integrate and troubleshoot automated suites in CI/CD pipelines, preferably Bamboo.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development and testing, including LLM-based tools, AI-generated test cases, automation code generation, test analysis, and debugging.
  • Ability to read application code, improve testability with developers, and distinguish product defects from automation or environment failures; comfortable with Git and pull-request workflows.
  • Hands-on TestRail experience managing test cases, runs, results, and Jira traceability. Experience integrating automated results through the TestRail is highly desirable.
  • Experience testing on Windows and Linux, with practical networking knowledge and familiarity with virtualized environments such as VMware or Proxmox.
  • Strong testing fundamentals and risk-based judgment, with an automation-first approach and manual or exploratory testing when needed for release validation.
  • Ability to lead technical improvements, mentor QA engineers, and collaborate across time zones, with clear written and spoken English and effective documentation in Jira and Confluence.

Bonus Points if You Have

  • ISTQB or other software testing certifications
  • Hands-on experience testing and validating applications deployed in cloud-based environments, including AWS and GCP.
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright, Cypress, or similar automation tools
  • Demonstrated maturity in adopting and applying AI technologies to improve software quality, test automation, debugging, and engineering productivity.

title: Senior Digital IC Design Engineer
description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company.

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).


Functions of the Role

This senior position operates at the critical intersection of sub-Kelvin sub-system electronics and quantum processor architectures, directly addressing the interconnect bottleneck in scalable quantum computing systems. The role spans the full digital IC design cycle—including initial microarchitecture specification, RTL development, Verilog-AMS co-simulation, physical implementation (PnR/CTS), low-power synthesis, static timing analysis (STA), and full tape-out signoff. The ultimate objective is the realization of ultra-low-power, high-density cryogenic control ICs tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computing scale-out.


  • Position Title: Senior Digital Designer (Front-End & Back-End)

  • Domain Focus: Ultra-Low-Power Cryogenic CMOS (Cryo-CMOS) Digital Control Sub-circuits

  • Design Scope: Full Lifecycle (RTL Development, AMS Co-Simulation, Physical Implementation, Low-Power Synthesis, and Tape-Out Signoff)

  • Core Chip Architecture Target: Cryogenic digital logic blocks operating at sub-Kelvin regimes (<4.2 K),


Experience - Essentials

  • Education: Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline.

  • Chip Design Experience: 5+ years of hands-on digital and mixed-signal IC design, demonstrating successful completion of at least 2 tape-outs on advanced semiconductor nodes

  • Hardware Coding: Proficiency in Verilog and SystemVerilog for synthesizable RTL development and Verilog-AMS/SystemVerilog-Real-Math for mixed-signal co-simulation and testbench environments.

  • Design Tools: Proven proficiency with industry-standard EDA toolchains (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso/Innovus/Xcelium, Synopsys Design Compiler) for mixed-signal simulation, synthesis, and verification.

  • Physical Layout: Demonstrated capability in transforming RTL into GDSII/OASIS physical layouts, floorplanning, power grid synthesis, clock tree synthesis (CTS), multi-corner multi-mode static timing analysis (MCMM STA), and physical signoff (DRC/LVS/ERC).

  • Communication & Logic Design: Experience architecting high-speed serial interconnect protocols (e.g., custom SPI, AXI, SerDes) and complex finite-state machine (FSM) control logic.

  • Low Power & Thermal Management: Deep expertise in low-power dissipation techniques (clock gating, power gating, dynamic voltage scaling) within stringent thermal lift budgets of cryogenic cooling systems.


Experience - Desirable

  • Cryogenic CMOS Experience: Hands-on experience designing, modeling, or characterizing CMOS circuits at sub-4.2 K temperatures and understanding cryo-specific transistor behavior.
  • Mixed-Signal & AMS Interfaces: Direct integration of digital logic with precision analog/RF front-ends (ADCs, DACs, LNAs, AWGs) for qubit control and readout.
  • Quantum Architecture Awareness: Familiarity with quantum control interfaces, pulse generation, error correction, or cryogenic spin qubit electronics
  • Low-Power Verification & UPF/CPF: Proficiency in power-aware simulation using IEEE 1801 UPF/CPF, formal LEC, and power signoff tools (Voltus, PrimePower).
  • Advanced Process Nodes: Experience with sub-28nm nodes, with a strong preference for FD-SOI or FinFET technologies.
  • EDA Scripting & Automation: Strong scripting skills (TCL, Python) to automate synthesis, physical design, and verification flows.
  • DFT & Silicon Bring-Up: Practical knowledge of DFT insertion (Scan, MBIST) and post-silicon laboratory bring-up, testing, and debug.


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team
  • Competitive salary and share options scheme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Group private medical insurance scheme
  • Choose your own laptop/kit
  • Life Assurance
  • Cycle-to-work Scheme
  • Flexible working
  • Central London location


EEO Statement

Quantum Motion is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate based on age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, colour, religion, disability status, marital status, pregnancy, gender reassignment or any other protected characteristics covered by the Equality Act 2010.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low-cost electricity into always-on heat and power, without supply-constrained critical minerals or multi-year construction timelines.

We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low-cost energy.

Position Summary

Antora Energy is seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive high-priority execution work across our hardware Product Development organization. Working across Design, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Field Operations, you will bring clarity to milestones, decisions, and responsibilities, helping teams resolve gaps between functions and accelerate deployment. You'll join a small, centralized TPM team that owns program infrastructure across Antora's current- and next-generation module programs.

You will own thermal battery module engineering and hardware programs ranging from clearly-bounded workstreams to more complex, cross-functional initiatives, partnering with other TPMs and functional leaders as needed. This role requires initiative, independent judgment, and the ability to influence without direct authority across functions

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Own program planning and execution: Drive module engineering programs and workstreams from early design through build, validation, and field deployment. Establish scope, milestones, owners, and next steps, and maintain momentum through completion. Build and maintain integrated schedules, track critical-path dependencies, and develop recovery plans when programs slip.
  • Coordinate across functions: Partner with Design, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Field Operations to clarify dependencies, resolve misalignments, and move open decisions and actions to closure.
  • Identify and escalate risks: Proactively surface program risks, blockers, and competing priorities before they affect timelines. Engage the appropriate stakeholders and adjust execution plans as needed.
  • Maintain clear program communication: Keep program trackers, action logs, and documentation accurate and current. Deliver concise updates on progress, risks, decisions, and next steps to cross-functional partners and leadership.
  • Develop and right-size processes: Build, adjust, or retire processes (e.g. engineering change control) based on risk - putting controls where the cost of a miss is highest, and avoiding steps that add overhead without reducing risk.
  • Apply AI to everyday execution: Build and utilize AI tools to streamline processes and speed up development work, exercising sound judgment about accuracy and when human review is needed
Key Qualifications

  • 2-6 years of experience in technical program management, engineering, or product development in a hardware environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field, with strong technical fluency in mechanical, thermal, or electrical systems
  • Experience coordinating projects that span hardware design, manufacturing, supply chain, and/or field operations
  • Demonstrated ability to define scope, organize milestones, and drive a technical program or workstream to completion.
  • Ability to build trusted cross-functional relationships, clarify responsibilities, and keep stakeholders aligned as priorities change
  • Familiarity with product development and NPI processes including design reviews, engineering validation builds, phased development programs (stage-gate), and change management principles
  • Clear verbal and written communication, including the ability to provide concise, audience-appropriate updates to technical teams and leadership
  • Comfort working through ambiguity, scoping and re-scoping defined work with limited direction, and recognizing when to seek support or escalate an issue
Additional Qualifications Desired

  • Experience independently leading complex, cross-functional hardware programs end-to-end
  • Experience in energy, industrial, or other high-temperature / high-power hardware systems
  • Experience with PLM, ERP, or MES systems (e.g., Arena, NetSuite)
  • Experience working in a startup or fast-scaling hardware environmen

Work Location: Onsite - San Jose, CA

Salary Range: $138,000 USD - $190,000 USD

Salary Basis: Annual

Please note that the salary range listed above reflects Antora Energy's estimated pay for this position. The actual salary offered will be within the posted range and determined based on several factors including but not limited to a candidate's experiences, credentials and expertise, as they pertain to the position's requirements.

In addition to a competitive base salary, Antora Energy’s Total Rewards program includes equity compensation in the form of stock options, a premium health benefits package with life and disability insurance, a 401K plan with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts, and an industry leading paid-time-off policy that features flexible and inclusive holiday observance, as well as paid volunteer time off.

      • Benefits:

  • Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.

  • Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self-help, social, and community living skills.

  • Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.

  • Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.

  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

  • Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
  • Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

title: Senior SRE Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior SRE Engineer based in United Kingdom.

This is a high-impact SRE role focused on building reliable, scalable infrastructure for an international gaming platform.
You’ll help shape DevOps and SRE practices while contributing to technical strategy and a strong engineering culture.
The role combines hands-on infrastructure engineering with observability, automation, cloud architecture, and incident management.
You’ll work closely with development teams to improve reliability, scalability, deployment processes, and CI/CD practices.
As a senior engineer, you’ll also mentor teammates and promote Kubernetes-native approaches across the engineering organization.
The environment values autonomy, proactive problem-solving, continuous improvement, and practical automation over bureaucracy.
It’s an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of reliability engineering while working with modern cloud-native technologies.

Accountabilities

  • Build and evolve DevOps and SRE practices, helping establish scalable approaches to reliability, infrastructure management, and operational excellence.

  • Contribute to the team’s technical strategy and engineering culture, promoting robust, maintainable, and automation-first practices.

  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve the gaming platform infrastructure, with a strong focus on availability, scalability, and resilience.

  • Design, operate, and enhance monitoring and observability systems, including metrics, dashboards, exporters, alerting, and reliability indicators.

  • Participate in paid on-call rotations, strengthening incident response processes and helping ensure fast, effective resolution of production issues.

  • Automate infrastructure operations and repetitive workflows to improve engineering efficiency and reduce manual intervention.

  • Partner closely with development teams to improve system reliability, scalability, CI/CD, and change delivery processes.

  • Mentor engineers and share Kubernetes-native practices, helping raise technical standards across the wider engineering community.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions and cloud infrastructure evolution, balancing performance, reliability, scalability, and operational simplicity.

  • Investigate incidents and technical issues systematically, focusing on root-cause analysis and long-term prevention rather than short-term fixes.

    • Requirements:

    • 3+ years of professional experience in DevOps, SRE, or a closely related infrastructure engineering role.

    • Deep hands-on expertise with Kubernetes and container orchestration, including operating and scaling production environments.

    • Strong experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, with an emphasis on reproducible and maintainable infrastructure.

    • Proven experience designing and supporting high-availability infrastructure and production systems.

    • Practical experience working with both SQL databases, particularly PostgreSQL, and NoSQL technologies.

    • Strong knowledge of observability stacks, including Prometheus, Grafana, exporters, and alerting systems.

    • Confident scripting and automation skills using Python and Bash.

    • Solid understanding of CI/CD, GitOps, and platform engineering principles and practices.

    • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to identify root causes, anticipate reliability risks, and develop sustainable solutions.

    • A proactive approach to improving processes, automation, infrastructure, and overall reliability engineering practices.

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working closely with software engineering teams.

    • Experience with Oracle Cloud is a plus.

    • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) certification is desirable.

    • Experience with AWS or GCP is beneficial.

    • Ability to read and understand JavaScript/TypeScript or Ruby code is an advantage.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote working model, with the option to work from dedicated hubs in Kyiv or Warsaw.

      • 20 paid working days off, public holidays, and paid sick leave to support sustainable work-life balance.

      • Medical insurance with access to leading healthcare providers.

      • Coverage for psychological support through the Pleso platform.

      • Monthly Benefit Café allowance that can be used toward hobbies, sports, and personal interests.

      • Access to team events, workshops, team-building activities, and company celebrations.

      • Individual learning and development budget for courses and professional growth.

      • Corporate English-language training, workshops, and access to an online learning library.

      • Clear career development and performance review framework, alongside mentoring and training programs.

      • High level of autonomy and freedom of action, with a culture designed to minimize unnecessary bureaucracy.

      • Opportunity to work on technology solutions built from the ground up and contribute to modern cloud-native engineering practices.

      • Collaborative, open, and proactive environment where technical ideas, feedback, and continuous improvement are encouraged.

title: Youth Dance / Cheerleading / Sports Teachers (Part-Time)
company: The Starz Program of Greater Washington
description:
Love working with kids? Looking for a flexible part-time role where you can make a real impact while building your teaching and leadership skills? Join a passionate, supportive team and spend your days bringing energy, creativity, and confidence to children across the Greater Washington, D.C. area!


The Starz Program is a nationally recognized children’s fitness enrichment program that has served communities across the country for over 20 years. Our mission is to help kids build confidence, resilience, and a love of movement through fun, engaging classes. Learn more about us at .


In this role you will teach a variety of classes to students (ages 2-12) on-site at schools and country clubs near Bethesda, MD or Arlington, VA. This role is perfect for former or current dancers, cheerleaders, and athletes with teaching experience. Many of our instructors grow with us into expanded roles in marketing, curriculum, training, and program leadership.


Core Responsibilities:

  • Lead fun, structured classes for 5–15 students at a time
  • You’ll follow our curriculum while bringing your own creativity and personality to each class.
  • Set up and clean up equipment
  • Create a positive, safe, and energetic learning environment
  • Communicate with parents, school staff, and the Starz team
  • Stay organized and prepared using provided lesson plans
  • Attend monthly meetings and trainings

What we look for in a Starz Instructor:

  • Responsible – arrives 15 minutes early to each class, can independently manage a 45-60-minute class of up to 15 students, without support of a co-teacher.
  • Professional – neat in appearance, friendly and courteous with partner site staff.
  • Enthusiastic – MUST enjoy teaching and working with young children, be able to confidently connect with children primarily ages 2-12.
  • Fun – enjoys having FUN with young children, being goofy, using your imagination, and watching children smile all while managing and teaching an effective class.
  • Reliable transportation – must have reliable transportation to and from partner sites and a valid driver’s license.
  • Organization- Instructors are given a weekly lesson plan and curriculum to follow but will need time to prepare for classes outside of the classroom.

Schedule & Commitment:

  • Teach 2-8 hours per week
  • Select the classes you want to teach each season; design your own schedule
  • Classes operate Monday-Friday between 9am-5pm
  • We’re looking for team members interested in growing with us for multiple seasons

Season Dates:

  • Fall: mid-September – mid-December
  • Winter: mid-January – mid-March
  • Spring: mid-March – mid-May
  • Optional Summer Camps: June – August (half-day or full-day)

title: Strategic Finance Manger, AI & Forecasting
description:
Location: Palo Alto, CA (hybrid)

Small business owners don't have a risk department. They spend their time and energy starting and growing a business. NEXT's mission is to help entrepreneurs thrive, and we're using AI to make business insurance simple, fast, and affordable enough that it never costs them a day of work.

We're an AI technology company that happens to also be a fully licensed insurance carrier. Because we're a full-stack carrier, AI isn't a layer bolted onto someone else's product. It's in the underwriting, the pricing, the classification, and increasingly in how the product itself gets built. We're rebuilding the core judgment loops of a hundreds-of-years old industry, and doing it with a lean team, which is exactly why AI matters.

We underwrite our own risk, build our own systems, and own the entire value chain, so the product decisions made here show up directly in what a customer pays and how fast they get covered. Since 2016 we've insured hundreds of thousands of small businesses across the country. As a subsidiary of Munich Re and ERGO, our growth is backed by the financial strength of one of the world's leading reinsurance and insurance groups.

About the role:

ERGO NEXT is building its Finance organization to be AI-native — starting with reinventing how we forecast the business from the ground up. We're looking for a Strategic Finance Manager, AI & Forecasting to help lead this transformation: someone with strong core strategic finance fundamentals who is equally excited to redesign forecasting, planning, and reporting workflows around AI/LLM-based tools rather than layering AI on top of legacy spreadsheet processes. Reporting to the Head of Revenue & Growth FP&A, this is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of strategic finance and applied AI, with the mandate to define what "AI-native FP&A" looks like at ERGO NEXT.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead the redesign of the topline revenue forecasting process from the ground up, using AI/LLM-based tools and workflows in place of legacy manual, spreadsheet-driven approaches
  • Partner with Finance and Data Science to identify, evaluate, and implement AI tools and agentic workflows that improve the speed, accuracy, and scalability of forecasting and planning
  • Drive long-range and annual planning process while building repeatable, AI-assisted modeling and reporting frameworks
  • Spearhead strategic finance activities applying AI-driven analysis to accelerate diligence and scenario modeling
  • Partner cross-functionally to define and automate KPI tracking, using AI to surface insights and recommendations faster than traditional analysis allows
  • Prepare Board materials and executive presentations, incorporating AI-generated analysis and scenario modeling to sharpen the narrative
  • Act as an internal champion and educator for AI adoption within Finance, documenting playbooks and mentoring team members as new tools and workflows are rolled out

What We Need:

  • BA/BS in finance, accounting, economics, or a quantitative discipline
  • 4–6 years of finance experience in a fast-paced environment with a track record of success (background in investment banking, corporate development, or strategic finance a plus)
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI tools (e.g., LLM-based agents, AI-powered modeling/analysis platforms) and a track record of adopting or building workflows around them — prior hands-on use of tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or similar in a finance/analytics context strongly preferred
  • Ability to break down and solve complex, ambiguous problems with strong business acumen and data-driven techniques, including comfort redesigning a process rather than just operating an existing one
  • Basic technical fluency (e.g., SQL, Python, or low-code/AI tooling) sufficient to prototype or evaluate AI-driven finance workflows a plus, though not required
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • High degree of reliability and integrity, with sound judgment operating in a newly-defined, ambiguous role
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to bring both technical and non-technical stakeholders along on a change-management journey

The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire base salaries for the position in the location(s) listed. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including, without limitation, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. ERGO NEXT employees are also potentially eligible for our annual performance-based incentive program, in addition to our benefits package, consisting of our partially subsidized medical plan, fully subsidized vision/dental options, life insurance, disability insurance, 401(k), flexible paid time off, parental leave and more.

$117,000—$158,000 USD
